paper_title: Intrinsic negative feedback as a limiting factor for the evolution of higher forms of intelligence
paper_abstract: Longstanding scientific efforts have been dedicated to answer why and how our particular intelligence is generated by our brain but not by the brain of other species. However, surprisingly little effort has been made to ask why no other species ever developed an intelligence similar to ours. Here, I explore this question based on genetic and paleontologic evidence. Contrary to the established view, this review suggests that the developmental hurdles alone are not high enough to explain the uniqueness of human intelligence (HI). As an additional explanation I propose that HI is normally not retained by natural selection, because it is, under most conditions, an intrinsically unfavourable trait. This unfavourableness, however, cannot be explained by physical constraints alone; rather, it may also be rooted in the same emotional and social complexity that is necessary for the development of HI. Thus, a major obstacle towards HI may not be solely the development of the required physical assets, but also to cope with harmful individual, social and environmental feedback intrinsically associated with this trait.
review_content:
The manuscript discusses the uniqueness of human intelligence (HI) despite its apparent evolutionary advantages. Although the theme has been tirelessly revisited by many authors, a new theory is offered, that higher intelligence is disadvantageous and kept from developing through negative feedback. The author briefly goes through the main molecular and ecological arguments for the appearance and advantages of high intelligence, showing that those are not especially uncommon or slow in evolutionary history. Therefore, none could fully justify the evolution of HI, suggesting it to be generally an unfavorable trait.

The theory is well constructed and the references support the hypothesis. Despite that, there are a few points in the manuscript that warrant attention:

Page 3 - "Brain size, structure, and complexity"
The author affirms that "In terms of genetic modifications, the development of the human brain therefore appears to be based on extending already existing features through gradual and common mechanisms, rather than being the result of a developmental quantum leap" (page 3, para 5, line 33). The example given a few lines before, of Pax6, as well as other well known genes, such as the human-specific ARHGAP11B, despite being relatively small changes, result in significant leaps in brain development. The later example of octopuses also seems to indicate a sudden change, from the moment molluscs lost their shells, which still supports the paragraph conclusion that the genetic mechanisms that allow intelligence are available to other species.

Page 5 - "Language and intelligence"
In general, this session is not clear about language being a requirement for the development of HI, a mere consequence of it, or something in between, with some contradictions. For example "It is therefore not the capacity for an articulate vocalization, but only a predisposition for it, that is essential to the evolution of HI" (page 5, para 5, line 11) and "current evidence suggests that the evolution of a HI-supporting language is not a feature strictly limited to humans or the human brain anatomy or speech production" (page 5, para 7, line 6). The conclusion is especially confusing when declaring "HI-supporting language" while the manuscript appears to state that language is not a prerequisite for HI.
About the passage:
"Let us now consider language syntax and acquisition with respect to human uniqueness. It has indeed been proposed that such properties of the human language are neither specific to language nor to humans (47,48)" (page 5, para 6, line 1). The references cited (47, 48) indicate that there may be a human-only syntax, either through universal grammar or simply an advanced form of syntax allowed by the human FLB.

Page 7 - "Conclusion and outlook"
Despite mentioning the possible negative feedback from molecular complexity, I couldn't find any examination of it in the main text. For reference: "the main barrier towards HI is not only the development of the required physical assets, but also that negative feedback from social, behavioural and molecular complexity, as well as negative environmental feedback make the development of HI increasingly unfavourable" (page 7, para 4, line 11).
I wonder if there is a link between HI and sexual selection. Although intelligence as a simple fitness indicator would be equally accessible to other animals as well, cultural and behavioral products could also have influenced mating preferences.

Finally, the text mentions the possible negative feedback of niche construction: page 7, "there might be a different type of negative feedback loop intrinsic to HI—HI might simply allow a species to become so successful in exploiting food resources that these resources become exhausted" (page 7, para 3, line 1) and again on the conclusion "we are knowingly and consciously pursuing our unsustainable development that is rapidly destroying the resources upon which we critically depend" (page 7, para 6, line 6). Despite that, HI also generates powerful positive feedback with niche construction, in which the environmental changes produced by HI favor HI itself.
paper_title_zh: 内在负反馈作为限制高阶智能演化的因素
paper_abstract_zh: 长期以来，科学界致力于解答为什么以及如何我们特定的大脑产生了智能，而其他物种的大脑却没有。然而，令人惊讶的是，几乎没有努力去探讨为什么没有其他物种发展出类似我们人类的智能。本文基于遗传学和古生物学的证据探讨了这一问题。与现有观点相反，本文认为仅凭发展障碍不足以解释人类智能（HI）的独特性。作为补充解释，我提出HI通常不会被自然选择保留，因为在大多数条件下，它本质上是一个不利的特征。然而，这种不利性不能仅通过物理限制来解释；它可能还根植于发展HI所必需的相同的情感和社会复杂性中。因此，HI的主要障碍可能不仅仅是发展所需的物理条件，还包括应对与这一特征内在相关的有害的个体、社会和环境反馈。
review_content_zh:
手稿讨论了人类智能（HI）的独特性，尽管其具有明显的进化优势。尽管许多作者不懈地重新探讨这一主题，但本文提出了一种新理论，即高智能是不利的，并通过负面反馈阻止其发展。作者简要概述了支持高智能出现和优势的主要分子和生态论点，表明这些在进化史上并不特别罕见或缓慢。因此，没有任何论点能完全解释HI的进化，暗示HI通常是一种不利特征。

该理论构建良好，参考文献支持了假设。尽管如此，手稿中仍有一些值得注意的点：

第3页 - “大脑的大小、结构和复杂性”
作者断言：“从基因修饰的角度来看，人类大脑的发展因此似乎是基于通过渐进和常见机制扩展已存在的特征，而不是发育上的量子跃迁的结果”（第3页，第5段，第33行）。几行前给出的Pax6的例子，以及其他众所周知的基因，如人类特有的ARHGAP11B，尽管变化相对较小，却导致了大脑发育的显著跃迁。后文提到的章鱼例子也似乎表明了一个突然的变化，从软体动物失去外壳的那一刻起，这仍然支持该段落的结论，即允许智能的遗传机制对其他物种也是可用的。

第5页 - “语言与智能”
总的来说，这一部分关于语言是否是HI发展的必要条件、仅仅是其结果，或介于两者之间，存在一些矛盾。例如，“因此，并非是清晰发音的能力，而只是对其的倾向，才是HI进化的关键”（第5页，第5段，第11行）以及“当前证据表明，支持HI的语言进化并非严格限于人类或人类大脑解剖结构或言语产生”（第5页，第7段，第6行）。结论尤其令人困惑，当声明“支持HI的语言”时，手稿似乎表明语言并非HI的先决条件。
关于这段话：
“现在让我们考虑语言的句法和习得与人类独特性的关系。确实有观点认为，人类语言的这些属性既非语言特有，也非人类特有”（第5页，第6段，第1行）。引用的参考文献（47, 48）表明可能存在人类独有的句法，无论是通过普遍语法还是人类FLB允许的先进句法形式。

第7页 - “结论与展望”
尽管提到了分子复杂性的可能负面反馈，我在正文主体中未能找到对此的任何考察。参考：“HI的主要障碍不仅是所需物理资产的发展，还有来自社会、行为和分子复杂性的负面反馈，以及负面环境反馈，使得HI的发展越来越不利”（第7页，第4段，第11行）。
我想知道HI与性选择之间是否存在联系。尽管智能作为简单的适应度指标对其他动物同样适用，但文化和行为产物也可能影响了择偶偏好。

最后，文本提到了生态位构建的可能负面反馈：第7页，“可能存在一种与HI内在的不同类型的负面反馈循环——HI可能仅仅使物种在利用食物资源方面如此成功，以至于这些资源被耗尽”（第7页，第3段，第1行），以及在结论中再次提到“我们有意识地追求不可持续的发展，这正在迅速摧毁我们赖以生存的关键资源”（第7页，第6段，第6行）。尽管如此，HI也在生态位构建中产生了强大的正面反馈，其中HI产生的环境变化有利于HI本身。

The argument that human-type intelligence is maladaptive fits into an existing literature, which is largely not cited.
But are the mechanisms gravitating against human intelligence in animals other than humans evolutionary?
That is much less clear.
No other species has, to our knowledge, come close to destroying the environment in the way humans have.

paper_title: Uncertainty in Graph Neural Networks: A Survey
paper_abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have been extensively used in various real-world applications. However, the predictive uncertainty of GNNs stemming from diverse sources such as inherent randomness in data and model training errors can lead to unstable and erroneous predictions. Therefore, identifying, quantifying, and utilizing uncertainty are essential to enhance the performance of the model for the downstream tasks as well as the reliability of the GNN predictions. This survey aims to provide a comprehensive overview of the GNNs from the perspective of uncertainty with an emphasis on its integration in graph learning. We compare and summarize existing graph uncertainty theory and methods, alongside the corresponding downstream tasks. Thereby, we bridge the gap between theory and practice, meanwhile connecting different GNN communities. Moreover, our work provides valuable insights into promising directions in this field.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
This paper presents a survey on uncertainty estimation, quantification and utilisation in graph machine learning.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
On the surface level, I think that this work delivers what it promises: there is a survey of a sizeable number of publications relating to GNNs and uncertainty, these publications are reasonably organised in a structure imposed by the authors, and some avenues for future work in the area are identified. From that perspective, the effort invested by the authors could be considered worthy of a publication at TMLR. However, I also consider TMLR's criteria to place surveys in a bit of a gray area. I personally think the main utility from the surveys should come not only from an enumeration and organisation of a reference list, but also for conveying a useful opinion or argumentation that practitioners can follow when deciding which method to use. Presently, the survey does not meet this criterion in my mind. In a lot of cases, a paper is simply introduced, briefly summarised in isolation, and then the survey simply moves on to the next one. It is very rare that I see the authors' own opinions and anecdotal experiences introduced, and as a result this wouldn't necessarily be a survey that would give a lot of value beyond an organisational skeleton. Additionally, I think that there are several places where additional references and contexts could have been provided to make the story more accurate and robust (see next section for suggestions).

**Requested Changes:**
A major requested change is to introduce more of the Authors' own opinions in this survey. Try to make a clear stand about which methods should be used in which circumstances, with some levels of argumentation. Additionally, it would be useful to make a stand about whether certain papers are able to properly defend their hypothesis, or more investigation may be needed. I think it might make sense to correct this attribution to DropEdge: > Rong et al. (2019) introduce DropEdge, which randomly removes a specified number of edges from the graph by drawing independent Bernoulli random variables (with a constant rate) during each training iteration. This is not completely factually correct. Rong et al. are the first to _theoretically analyse_ edge dropout, but they are definitely not the first paper to attempt edge dropout as a regulariser. I'm not sure what's the first paper to do it, but for example, even the GAT paper (Veličković et al., ICLR'18) leverages such an operator (without theoretical motivation, of course). I also believe some sections would benefit from significantly more references being discussed. The two sections that immediately come to mind as examples are **explainability** and **robustness**. Presently, the explainability discussion in the paper doesn't go far beyond GNNExplainer. While GNNExplainer was the landmark paper in this space, there's been _a lot_ of developments since then. Papers such as GraphLIME, or GCExplainer, for example, are worth discussing. Similarly, the robustness section appears to largely neglect work on robustness certification from the folks at TUM (e.g. Simon Geisler or Aleksandar Bojchevski, et al.) which would likely also be worthy of inclusion here.

**Claims And Evidence:**
No

**Audience:**
Yes
paper_title_zh: 图神经网络中的不确定性：综述
paper_abstract_zh: 图神经网络（GNNs）已被广泛应用于各种现实世界场景中。然而，GNNs的预测不确定性源于多种因素，如数据固有的随机性和模型训练误差，可能导致预测不稳定和错误。因此，识别、量化和利用不确定性对于提升模型在下游任务中的性能以及GNN预测的可靠性至关重要。本综述旨在从不确定性的角度对GNNs进行全面概述，重点强调其在图学习中的整合。我们比较和总结了现有的图不确定性理论与方法，以及相应的下游任务。由此，我们弥合了理论与实践之间的差距，同时连接了不同的GNN社区。此外，我们的工作为该领域的有前景方向提供了宝贵的见解。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
本文对图机器学习中的不确定性估计、量化和利用进行了综述。

**优点与不足：**
从表面上看，我认为这项工作实现了其承诺：对大量与GNN和不确定性相关的出版物进行了综述，这些出版物被作者以合理的结构组织，并识别了该领域未来工作的若干方向。从这个角度来看，作者投入的努力可以被认为是值得在TMLR上发表的。然而，我也认为TMLR对综述的评判标准略显模糊。我个人认为，综述的主要价值不仅应来自参考列表的列举和组织，还应在于传达有用的观点或论证，以供实践者在决定使用哪种方法时参考。目前，这篇综述在我看来并未达到这一标准。在许多情况下，论文只是被简单介绍，孤立地简要总结，然后综述就继续下一篇。很少看到作者自己的观点和轶事经验被引入，因此这篇综述除了提供一个组织框架外，并不一定能提供更多价值。此外，我认为有几处可以补充更多参考文献和背景，以使论述更加准确和稳健（具体建议见下一节）。

**请求的修改：**
一个主要的修改请求是在综述中引入更多作者自己的观点。尝试明确在不同情况下应使用哪些方法，并提供一定程度的论证。此外，对某些论文是否能够有效支持其假设，或是否需要进一步研究，也应明确表态。我认为有必要更正对DropEdge的归属：> Rong等人（2019年）介绍了DropEdge，它在每次训练迭代中通过独立伯努利随机变量（具有恒定速率）随机移除指定数量的边。这并不完全符合事实。Rong等人是首次**理论分析**边丢弃的，但他们绝非首次尝试将边丢弃作为正则化的论文。我不确定第一篇这样做的论文是哪篇，但例如，即使是GAT论文（Veličković等人，ICLR'18）也使用了这样的操作（当然没有理论动机）。我还认为某些部分会因讨论更多参考文献而显著受益。立即想到的两个例子是**可解释性**和**鲁棒性**部分。目前，论文中对可解释性的讨论并未超出GNNExplainer。虽然GNNExplainer是这一领域的里程碑论文，但此后已有大量发展。例如，GraphLIME或GCExplainer等论文值得讨论。同样，鲁棒性部分似乎在很大程度上忽略了TUM团队（如Simon Geisler或Aleksandar Bojchevski等人）在鲁棒性认证方面的工作，这些工作可能也值得在此包括。

**主张与证据：**
无

**受众：**
是

paper_title: Refinement of a mouse cardiovascular model: Development, application and dissemination
paper_abstract: European and UK legislation requires all animal procedures to be conducted with consideration to reduction, refinement and replacement. In this review, 3Rs developments are discussed in the field of platelet biology and thromboembolism. Platelet research requires the use of animal models, and mice are widely used in the field. When working in vitro , conventional light transmission techniques have been scaled down allowing reduction in animal numbers. In vivo , vascular injury models are widely used and work is ongoing to develop ex vivo approaches that use fewer animals. Thromboembolic mortality models, which inflict considerable pain and suffering, have also been used widely. A published and characterised refinement of this mortality model allows real-time monitoring of radiolabelled platelets under general anaesthesia and reduces both the severity level and the numbers of mice used in a typical experiment. This technique is more sensitive than the mortality approach and has opened up new avenues of research, which would not have been feasible by using death as an end-point. To drive uptake of real-time monitoring, a more simplistic approach has been developed involving micro-sampling and cell counting. Thromboembolic mortality models should therefore be considered obsolete due to the emergence of 3Rs models with improved scientific outcomes and that can be implemented relatively easily.
review_content:
This is an interesting and important article describing development of an improved experimental model of thromboembolism with clear potential to both replace and refine existing models. Whilst the manuscript is generally well written and presented, I do think that it could be significantly improved by revising structure and increasing 3Rs emphasis. Specific comments below.

The title of the article does not accurately reflect its content. It is too general and should be specifically focussed on thromboembolism with regard to development of an improved experimental model. The stated scientific benefits in the research highlights box could also be made more specifically and understandable on a stand-alone basis.

The article would benefit from inclusion of one of two figures to complement the text and make the article more engaging. For example, a summary of current experimental models used in platelet research with approximation of numbers of animals used would be helpful and it would also seem appropriate to include a schematic representation of the new model highlighting potential benefits.

Need for animals models: the flow of this section could be improved. I do not think that the final paragraph really fits as currently written. More specific detail should also be provided in relation to the provided NC3Rs link e.g. research group etc.

With specific regard to thromboembolism models, some discussion in relation to where these procedures are currently performed (e.g. are they permitted in the UK?) and comparison of scientific end-points between the new and existing models would be informative in order to highlight relevance and applicability.

Dissemination and uptake: this section is quite weak at present and could be improved by including discussion of e.g. current barriers to uptake and potential approaches to encourage wider implementation. At present, discussion is largely limited to the authors own collaborators and in line with NC3Rs policy more needs to be done (which I am sure that it is) to promote wide uptake of new experimental models across the field.

Abstract – specify light transmission aggregometry techniques.

Does the review provide an accurate account of the 3Rs landscape in that field / across fields?
Yes
paper_title_zh: 小鼠心血管模型的精细化：开发、应用与推广
paper_abstract_zh: 欧洲和英国立法要求所有动物实验都必须考虑到减少、优化和替代（3Rs）原则。在这篇综述中，讨论了血小板生物学和血栓栓塞领域的3Rs进展。血小板研究需要使用动物模型，而小鼠在该领域被广泛使用。在体外实验中，传统的光传输技术已经小型化，从而减少了动物的使用数量。在体内实验中，血管损伤模型被广泛使用，并且正在开发使用更少动物的外植体方法。血栓栓塞死亡率模型，因其造成显著的疼痛和痛苦，也被广泛使用。一种已发表并经过特征描述的该死亡率模型的优化方法，允许在全身麻醉下实时监测放射性标记的血小板，并减少了典型实验中使用的严重程度和小鼠数量。这种技术比死亡率方法更敏感，并开辟了新的研究途径，这是使用死亡作为终点所无法实现的。为了推动实时监测的应用，已经开发了一种更简单的方法，涉及微采样和细胞计数。因此，由于出现了具有改进科学结果且相对容易实施的3Rs模型，血栓栓塞死亡率模型应被视为过时。
review_content_zh:
这是一篇有趣且重要的文章，描述了一种改进的血栓栓塞实验模型的发展，该模型具有明确潜力来替代和优化现有模型。尽管手稿总体上写得很好且呈现得当，但我认为通过修订结构并增加3Rs（减少、优化、替代）的强调，可以显著提升其质量。具体意见如下。

文章的标题未能准确反映其内容。标题过于泛泛，应具体聚焦于改进的血栓栓塞实验模型的发展。研究亮点框中所述的科学益处也可以更具体、更易理解地独立呈现。

文章将受益于增加一两个图表以补充文本，使文章更具吸引力。例如，总结当前血小板研究中使用的实验模型及其所用动物数量的大致情况将有所帮助，同时似乎也应包括一个新模型的示意图，突出其潜在益处。

动物模型的需求：这一部分的流畅性可以改进。我认为最后一段按目前写法并不合适。还应提供更多具体细节，例如与所提供的NC3Rs链接相关的研究组等。

具体到血栓栓塞模型，讨论这些程序目前在哪里进行（例如在英国是否允许？）以及新模型与现有模型之间科学终点的比较，将有助于突出其相关性和适用性。

传播和采纳：目前这一部分相当薄弱，可以通过讨论例如当前采纳的障碍和鼓励更广泛实施的潜在方法来改进。目前讨论主要限于作者自己的合作者，根据NC3Rs政策，需要做更多工作（我相信已经在做）以促进新实验模型在整个领域的广泛采纳。

摘要——明确光传输聚集技术。

该评论是否准确描述了该领域/跨领域的3Rs现状？
是的

paper_title: General guidelines for biomedical software development
paper_abstract: Most bioinformatics tools available today were not written by professional software developers, but by people that wanted to solve their own problems, using computational solutions and spending the minimum time and effort possible, since these were just the means to an end. Consequently, a vast number of software applications are currently available, hindering the task of identifying the utility and quality of each. At the same time, this situation has hindered regular adoption of these tools in clinical practice. Typically, they are not sufficiently developed to be used by most clinical researchers and practitioners. To address these issues, it is necessary to re-think how biomedical applications are built and adopt new strategies that ensure quality, efficiency, robustness, correctness and reusability of software components. We also need to engage end-users during the development process to ensure that applications fit their needs. In this review, we present a set of guidelines to support biomedical software development, with an explanation of how they can be implemented and what kind of open-source tools can be used for each specific topic.
review_content:
This review focuses on an important topic in modern bioinformatics: good practices for software development. As the authors note, there is a growing body of data derived from experimental studies that requires automated analysis. The analysis is often carried out using custom software, written by first-time or inexperienced programmers, and results in unsupported, sub-optimal, or duplicated code. As the authors also mention, several groups have tried to put forward a collection of tips and guidelines to help researchers in developing ‘proper’ software. This review offers a similar set of guidelines, targeted specifically at the field of biomedical informatics, and draws on the experience of the authors on building their own tools.

The suggestions cover seven topics, from management to in-depth software development tips, and do a very good job at explaining their importance and their take on what constitutes a good approach. The authors also give very good examples of software tools to help readers setup a development environment. These range from the usual ‘use GitHub’ to TravisCI, Sphinx, and Docker. One suggestion would be to integrate some of these tools in Figure 1, to give readers a visual cue where these tools fit in each topic/step. The authors also provide a very nice summarized view of the release process, namely licensing and distribution (e.g. using Docker), and the follow-up maintainance.

There is one less positive aspect of this review, which is anyway transversal to most such attempts at ‘guidelines’ for bioinformatics software development. As the authors note, most of these tools are created to solve one very specific problem, or process a very specific dataset. These are not amenable to test-driven development, or to continuous integration. More importantly, most of the authors of these tools/scripts are biologists, not programmers, which usually translates to a lack of interest in proper programming etiquette. Thus, I believe that it is important to show and teach such users very very simple programming rules, namely about how to make their code readable for others. For example, in the Python world, a simple recommendation to use ‘flake8’ to check for PEP8 coding standards and an editor (e.g. Atom, Sublime) that can do real-time code checks (typos, unused variables, indentation issues, etc). There is no need to suggest quasi-professional IDEs, as these will likely scare users away!

All in all, as a biologist doing bioinformatics and doing his best to follow proper software guidelines, I find reviews like this one very important to the field. They should probably feature in a ‘starting package’ to new PhD students in many labs. As an added suggestion, the authors could think of putting these guidelines in practice and follow up with a simple workshop/tutorial series, a la software carpentry, even if in webinar format.
paper_title_zh: 生物医学软件开发通用指南
paper_abstract_zh: 当今大多数生物信息学工具并非由专业软件开发人员编写，而是由希望解决自身问题的人们所开发，他们利用计算解决方案，并尽可能花费最少的时间和精力，因为这些仅是达成目的的手段。因此，目前有大量软件应用可供使用，这阻碍了识别每个工具的实用性和质量的任务。同时，这种情况也阻碍了这些工具在临床实践中的常规应用。通常，它们尚未充分开发，无法被大多数临床研究人员和从业者使用。为解决这些问题，有必要重新思考生物医学应用的构建方式，并采用确保软件组件质量、效率、健壮性、正确性和可重用性的新策略。我们还需要在开发过程中吸引最终用户参与，以确保应用符合他们的需求。在这篇综述中，我们提出了一套支持生物医学软件开发的指导原则，并解释了如何实施这些原则以及针对每个特定主题可以使用哪些开源工具。
review_content_zh:
本综述聚焦于现代生物信息学中的一个重要议题：软件开发良好实践。正如作者所指出的，源自实验研究的数据体量不断增长，需要自动化分析。这种分析通常由首次或缺乏经验的程序员编写的定制软件来完成，导致代码缺乏支持、次优或重复。作者还提到，多个团队试图提出一系列提示和指南，以帮助研究人员开发“规范”的软件。本综述提供了一套类似的指南，专门针对生物医学信息学领域，并借鉴了作者在构建自身工具方面的经验。

建议涵盖七个主题，从管理到深入的软件开发技巧，并很好地解释了其重要性和对良好方法的看法。作者还提供了非常好的软件工具示例，帮助读者设置开发环境。这些工具包括常见的“使用GitHub”到TravisCI、Sphinx和Docker。一个建议是将其中一些工具整合到图1中，为读者提供每个主题/步骤中这些工具的视觉提示。作者还提供了发布过程的简洁视图，即许可和分发（例如使用Docker），以及后续的维护。

本综述有一个不太积极的方面，这通常是大多数生物信息学软件开发“指南”尝试中的普遍问题。正如作者所指出的，大多数这些工具是为了解决一个非常具体的问题，或处理一个非常特定的数据集。这些工具不适合测试驱动开发或持续集成。更重要的是，这些工具/脚本的作者大多是生物学家，而非程序员，这通常意味着对规范编程礼仪缺乏兴趣。因此，我认为向这类用户展示和教授非常简单的编程规则非常重要，尤其是如何使他们的代码对他人可读。例如，在Python领域，一个简单的建议是使用“flake8”检查PEP8编码标准，并使用可以进行实时代码检查（如拼写错误、未使用变量、缩进问题等）的编辑器（例如Atom、Sublime）。没有必要推荐准专业IDE，因为这可能会吓跑用户！

总的来说，作为一名从事生物信息学并尽力遵循规范软件指南的生物学家，我认为这类综述对领域非常重要。它们可能应该作为许多实验室新博士生的“入门包”内容。作为附加建议，作者可以考虑将这些指南付诸实践，并跟进一系列简单的研讨会/教程，类似于软件木工，即使是以网络研讨会形式。

paper_title: Effects of evidence-based clinical practice guidelines in cardiovascular health care quality improvements: A systematic review
paper_abstract:
Background: The development of evidence-based clinical practice guidelines (EB-CPGs) has increasing global growth; however, the certainty of impact on patients and health systems, as well as the magnitude of the impact, is not apparent. The objective of this systematic review was to assess the effectiveness of the application of EB-CPGs for the improvement of the quality of health care in three dimensions: structure, process and results in the patient for the management of cardiovascular disease. 
 Methods: We followed the methods described by the Cochrane Handbook and present a descriptive analysis because of the high heterogeneity found across the included studies. We searched the Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials, MEDLINE and EMBASE databases, as well as the grey literature, between 1990 and June 2016. No language restrictions were applied. Only randomised clinical trials (RCTs) were selected. Three authors independently carried out the data extraction, using a modified version of the Cochrane Effective Practice and Organization of Care form. 
 Results: Of the total of 84 interventions included in the nine RCTs evaluated, three (4%) were related to health care structure, 54 (64%) to the health care delivery process and 27 (32%) to patient outcomes. Regarding the impact of using the EB-CPGs, in 55 interventions (65%), there were no significant differences between control and experimental groups. In four interventions (5%), the result favoured the control group, and the result favoured the intervention group on 25 of the interventions (30%). 
 Conclusions: This systematic review showed that EB-CPGs could be useful to improve the process and structure of health care and, to a lesser extent, to improve the patients’ outcomes. After analysing many studies, we could have one more hypothesis for further research, which could shed more light upon those undiscovered variables that might interfere with the use of the EB-CPGs. 
 Registration: PROSPERO CRD42013003589
review_content:
Thank you for the invitation to review this well-conducted systematic review.
The study under review is very interesting and necessary for the Clinical Practice Guidelines (CPGs) community and for the implementation science and healthcare quality communities.
I would like to congratulate the authors for this difficult challenge with some minor comments to contribute to improve the content and message of this necessary study

ABSTRACT: Conclusion
  * "There are probably still undiscovered variables that interfere with the use of the CPGs".
    That could not be a conclusion from the study, given that the aim of the work was not to study factors and conditions that facilitates the implementation of CPG neither the conditions to change professional behavior. No data on these issues are reported, then no conclusion could be provided.
    A coherent conclusion could be the need to improve and systematize this kind of implementation studies.

Introduction: pag 3, para 4, left column
  * "After an exhaustive search, only two systematic reviews (SR) we found on this topic,"

    It is needed to provide both references

RESULTS: pag 3, 4 and figure 1. Study identification and selection.
  * "Of these, we selected 96 studies after assessing the full texts".

    It is needed, in order to strengthen the transparency and reproducibility of the work, to display in an extended data appendix, the full reference list of rejected originals and reasons to be rejected (96 found minus 9 selected = 87 rejected). It should be clarified what is meant in the figure 1 tab "# 87 of studies to include in other analyzes".

Pag 4, left column, para 3, rows 4-6:
  * "When assessing the full-text articles, we found that many were cluster trials"

    There is no clear reasons to reject RCT clusters studies, when the intervention could be randomized to cluster offices, and the outcomes effect measured at individual patient level. It is a well-accepted methodology in implementation science, given that can control for bias and non-measured variables. (Please see 2 references provided: Eccles and Romero).1,2

Pag 5, Table 1, Rows 2-4 and Column 5:
  * "Certainty of the evidence (GRADE)"

    It is difficult to understand why the certainty of evidence for the outcomes "time without flow" and "delay to start CPR" are classified differently when, as displayed in the explanations, the bias and systematic errors are the same, and there is not a loss of patients to follow up. It is true that both effects measure score different statistical significance, but with data provided the readers feel with the same certainty (either moderate or low) that one effect is significantly different from the control group, and for the other outcomes (delay) there are not differences with the control group.

Pag 6, Table 2, Rows 2-4 and Column 5:
  * "Certainty of the evidence (GRADE)"

    The same reasoning for the difficulty to understand why are classified differently the certainty of evidence for the outcomes "LDL cholesterol" and "Total cholesterol".

Discussion: Pag 7, para 2, rows 7-13
  * "This fact could lead us to assume that researchers have given more importance to the evaluation of using (or not using) the recommendations in the area of the process, instead of their direct impact on the patient health".

    Another explanation could be to emphasize that it use to be easier to measure process of care than patient health outcomes. These health outcomes take a longer period of observations than to measure how professionals adopt CPG recommendations. That can explain the "preferences" of researchers.

Conclusions
  * The same considerations exposed in the abstract regarding the sentences "There are probably still undiscovered variables that interfere with the use of the CPGs".

    That could not be a conclusion from the study, given that was not the aim of the work to study factors and conditions that facilitates the implementation of CPG neither the conditions to change professional behavior. No data on these issues are reported, them no conclusion could be provided.

    A coherent conclusion could be the needs to improve and systematize these kinds of implementation studies.
paper_title_zh: 基于证据的临床实践指南对心血管健康护理质量改进的影响：系统综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：基于证据的临床实践指南（EB-CPGs）的发展在全球范围内日益增长；然而，其对患者和卫生系统的影响程度及其影响大小尚不明确。本系统评价的目的是评估应用EB-CPGs在三个维度上改善心血管疾病管理中卫生服务质量的有效性：结构、过程和患者结果。

方法：我们遵循Cochrane手册中描述的方法，并因纳入研究间存在高度异质性而进行描述性分析。我们检索了Cochrane对照试验中心注册库、MEDLINE和EMBASE数据库，以及1990年至2016年6月间的灰色文献。未设置语言限制。仅选择随机对照试验（RCTs）。三名作者独立进行数据提取，使用修改后的Cochrane有效实践和护理组织表格。

结果：在评估的九项RCTs中，共纳入84项干预措施，其中三项（4%）与卫生保健结构相关，54项（64%）与卫生保健服务过程相关，27项（32%）与患者结果相关。关于使用EB-CPGs的影响，在55项干预措施（65%）中，对照组和实验组之间无显著差异。在四项干预措施（5%）中，结果有利于对照组，而在25项干预措施（30%）中，结果有利于干预组。

结论：本系统评价显示，EB-CPGs可能有助于改善卫生保健的过程和结构，并在较小程度上改善患者结果。在分析多项研究后，我们可能为后续研究提出了一个新假设，这可能会揭示那些可能干扰EB-CPGs使用的未发现变量。

注册：PROSPERO CRD42013003589
review_content_zh:
感谢您邀请我评审这篇精心进行的系统综述。
所评审的研究非常有趣且对临床实践指南（CPGs）社区以及实施科学和医疗质量社区来说是必要的。
我想祝贺作者们应对这一艰难挑战，并提出一些小建议以改进这项必要研究的内容和传达的信息。

摘要：结论
* “可能仍存在未发现的变量干扰CPGs的使用”。
这不能作为研究的结论，因为该工作的目的并不是研究促进CPGs实施的因素和条件，也不是研究改变专业行为的条件。报告中没有涉及这些问题的数据，因此无法提供结论。
一个连贯的结论可能是需要改进和系统化这类实施研究。

引言：第3页，第4段，左栏
* “经过详尽搜索，我们仅发现两篇关于这一主题的系统综述（SR）”。

需要提供这两篇参考文献。

结果：第3、4页及图1。研究的识别与选择。
* “在评估全文后，我们选择了96项研究”。

为了加强工作的透明度和可重复性，需要在扩展数据附录中展示被拒绝原始文献的完整参考列表及拒绝原因（96项发现减去9项选择 = 87项拒绝）。应澄清图1标签中“# 87项研究用于其他分析”的含义。

第4页，左栏，第3段，第4-6行：
* “在评估全文文章时，我们发现许多是群集试验”。

没有明确理由拒绝RCT群集研究，当干预可以随机分配到群集办公室，并且结果效应在个体患者水平上测量时。这是实施科学中一种被广泛接受的方法，因为它可以控制偏差和非测量变量。（请参阅提供的2篇参考文献：Eccles和Romero）。1,2

第5页，表1，第2-4行及第5列：
* “证据的确定性（GRADE）”。

难以理解为何“无血流时间”和“开始CPR的延迟”这两个结果的证据确定性分类不同，因为如解释所示，偏差和系统误差相同，且没有患者失访。确实，两个效应的测量得分具有不同的统计学显著性，但根据提供的数据，读者对其中一个效应与对照组显著不同以及另一个结果（延迟）与对照组无差异的确定性感受相同（无论是中等还是低）。

第6页，表2，第2-4行及第5列：
* “证据的确定性（GRADE）”。

同样难以理解为何“LDL胆固醇”和“总胆固醇”这两个结果的证据确定性分类不同。

讨论：第7页，第2段，第7-13行：
* “这一事实可能使我们认为，研究者更重视评估在过程领域使用（或不使用）建议，而不是其直接对患者健康的影响”。

另一种解释可能是强调测量护理过程通常比测量患者健康结果更容易。这些健康结果需要更长的观察期，而测量专业人员采纳CPGs建议则不需要。这可以解释研究者的“偏好”。

结论
* 与摘要中提到的“可能仍存在未发现的变量干扰CPGs的使用”相同的考虑。

这不能作为研究的结论，因为该工作的目的并不是研究促进CPGs实施的因素和条件，也不是研究改变专业行为的条件。报告中没有涉及这些问题的数据，因此无法提供结论。

一个连贯的结论可能是需要改进和系统化这类实施研究。

paper_title: Review of recent lung biomarkers of potential harm/effect for tobacco research
paper_abstract: Biomarkers of potential harm (BoPH) are indicators of biological perturbations which may contribute to the pathophysiology of disease. In this review, we critically assessed the published data on lung-related BoPH in human lung disease for potential use in evaluating the effects of tobacco and nicotine products. A Scopus literature search was conducted on lung disease biomarkers used in a clinical setting over the last 10 years. We identified 1171 papers which were further screened using commercial software (Sciome SWIFT-Active Screener) giving 68 publications that met our inclusion criteria (data on the association of the biomarker with cigarette smoking, the impact of smoking cessation on the biomarker, and differences between smokers and non-smokers), the majority of which investigated chronic obstructive pulmonary disease. Several physiological and biochemical measures were identified that are potentially relevant for evaluating the impact of tobacco products on lung health. Promising new candidates included blood biomarkers, such as surfactant protein D (SP-D), soluble receptor for advanced glycation end products (sRAGE), skin autofluorescence (SAF), and imaging techniques. These biomarkers may provide insights into lung disease development and progression; however, all require further research and validation to confirm their role in the context of tobacco and nicotine exposure, their time course of development and ability to measure or predict disease progression.
review_content:
This review is focused on analyzing existing literature on COPD biomarkers of potential harm emphasizing its impact on tobacco products and lung health outcomes. Without integrating data from the potential of reduced-risk tobacco product studies, the authors’ claim that these findings from COPD biomarkers will benefit tobacco product research are not valid. It will be important for the authors to keep the focus of this review based on known biomarkers of COPD and smoking-related lung disease.

Major Comments:
 1. Framing this in the title/abstract as an unbiased review evaluating BoPH for use in general tobacco research seems inaccurate when the literature search used to select articles explicitly required one of the lung disease-associated words “COPD or Emphysema or Bronchitis or Asthma or Obstruct”. Much of the text focuses explicitly on biomarkers of COPD and in some cases the intersection of smoking and COPD, but there is not much discussion of biomarkers that differ with tobacco use specifically.
 2. In terms of BoPH associated with tobacco use itself, the biomarkers discussed do not give a complete picture. This could be improved by widening the search criteria mentioned above or changing the text to reflect the clear COPD/lung disease focus of this review.
 3. Many of the findings mentioned in this review do not include significance values, and several do not even mention whether the findings were significant. Subject numbers are also missing from several findings. Data tables summarizing findings are not present for several sections. Adding more actual results/statistical significance will make this article much more useful.
 4. The one table that includes statistical values for biomarkers does not include any direct comparisons between smokers and non-smokers.
 5. Details about study designs could be explained (in the text or in summary tables) to improve clarity (i.e., defining terms such as “sustained quitters”, “ever-smokers”, etc.).
 6. Including a separate section on epigenomic biomarkers (i.e., DNA methylation) from peripheral blood, lung tissues, and other sample types if any. Additionally, novel circulating biomarkers (extracellular vesicles/exosomes) and their contents (miRNAs and proteins) affected in smokers and COPD compared to non-smokers will be important to consider. This would be an important area where more research is needed for the identification of early biomarkers of lung disease as well as identifying potential for a reduced-risk tobacco product. The limitations in biomarker literature should be clearly defined and how to overcome this in future studies should be discussed later in the review before the conclusion section.
 7. Most of the biomarker studies compiled/discussed in this review seem to be very old (> 10 years). It is not clear if there are no new studies that replicated the prior findings in a larger cohort that were not included based on a thorough literature search.
 8. Unable to find any reference from 2020-2022 regarding COPD biomarkers. Relatively fewer references are included from 2016 to 2019. Authors should avoid citations of the article describing the basic procedures and reviews. The purpose of a review is to update the current literature in light of their focused review of the literature. Please refrain from citing older review articles and try to give importance to original research articles under appropriate sections.
 9. There is a lack of coherence and integration of findings in chronological order for specific sample types described under each section. This should be carefully addressed during the revision.
Minor Comments:
 1. Important keywords appear to be misspelled in the first paragraph of the brief methods section and should be corrected for clarity (“Smok*” and “Measur*”).
 2. Additionally, what do asterisks after keywords imply? This is unclear in the text.
 3. There are a few typos e.g., “Peribranchial” which need to be checked and corrected.
 4. Sometimes, the study details were provided without mentioning the key findings from the study. i.e., (Kimura et al. 2017) described in the CT scan section.
 5. Any insight on imaging findings from modified risk tobacco products will be important to include and discuss based on current literature.
 6. The sample type used for analysis is not indicated when the findings are described (Rana et al., 2010).
 7. The biomarker is a single word, not “bio-marker”.
 8. Format the table with missing information (sample size for all the citations should be included). Additionally, the comments section should be labelled as ‘Key Findings’ and the reference citation can be moved to the last column. The title of table 1 should include COPD. This table should not mention general biomarkers and include only COPD-related studies.
 9. Including schematic figures based on identified COPD biomarkers from different sample types based on current literature summarized in this review would be informative to readers who are new to this field.
paper_title_zh: 烟草研究中潜在危害/效应的近期肺生物标志物综述
paper_abstract_zh: 潜在危害生物标志物（BoPH）是生物扰动的指标，可能对疾病的病理生理学有所贡献。在这篇综述中，我们批判性地评估了已发表的有关人类肺部疾病中与肺相关的BoPH数据，以探讨其在评估烟草和尼古丁产品影响中的潜在应用。我们对过去10年在临床环境中使用的肺部疾病生物标志物进行了Scopus文献检索。我们共识别出1171篇论文，通过商业软件（Sciome SWIFT-Active Screener）进一步筛选，得到68篇符合我们纳入标准的出版物（包括生物标志物与吸烟的相关性、戒烟对生物标志物的影响以及吸烟者与非吸烟者之间的差异），其中大多数研究了慢性阻塞性肺病。我们识别出几种生理和生化指标，这些指标可能对评估烟草产品对肺部健康的影响具有潜在相关性。有前景的新候选生物标志物包括血液生物标志物，如表面活性蛋白D（SP-D）、可溶性晚期糖基化终产物受体（sRAGE）、皮肤自体荧光（SAF）以及成像技术。这些生物标志物可能为肺部疾病的发病和进展提供见解；然而，所有这些标志物都需要进一步的研究和验证，以确认其在烟草和尼古丁暴露背景下的作用、其发展时间进程以及衡量或预测疾病进展的能力。
review_content_zh:
### 综述内容翻译

本综述旨在分析现有关于慢性阻塞性肺病（COPD）潜在危害生物标志物的文献，强调其对烟草产品和肺部健康结果的影响。如果不整合来自减害烟草产品研究的潜在数据，作者声称这些来自COPD生物标志物的发现将有利于烟草产品研究的观点是不成立的。对于作者来说，重要的是保持本综述的焦点基于已知的COPD和吸烟相关肺部疾病的生物标志物。

#### 主要评论：
1. 在标题/摘要中将此综述定位为对BoPH在一般烟草研究中应用的客观评价，似乎是不准确的，因为用于选择文章的文献检索明确要求包含与肺部疾病相关的词汇“COPD或肺气肿或支气管炎或哮喘或阻塞性”。大部分文本明确聚焦于COPD的生物标志物，有时涉及吸烟与COPD的交叉点，但关于烟草使用特异性的生物标志物讨论较少。
2. 就烟草使用本身的BoPH而言，所讨论的生物标志物并未提供完整图景。可以通过扩大上述检索标准或修改文本以反映本综述明确的COPD/肺部疾病焦点来改进。
3. 本综述中提到的许多发现未包括显著性值，有些甚至未提及发现是否显著。多个发现中缺少受试者数量。几部分内容缺乏总结发现的数据表格。增加更多实际结果/统计显著性将使本文更有用。
4. 包含生物标志物统计值的唯一表格未包括吸烟者与非吸烟者之间的直接比较。
5. 研究设计的细节可以在文本或总结表格中解释，以提高清晰度（例如，定义“持续戒烟者”、“曾经吸烟者”等术语）。
6. 如果有的话，应包括关于外周血、肺组织和其它样本类型中表观遗传生物标志物（如DNA甲基化）的独立部分。此外，考虑吸烟者和COPD患者与非吸烟者相比，新型循环生物标志物（细胞外囊泡/外泌体）及其内容物（miRNA和蛋白质）的影响也很重要。这是识别早期肺部疾病生物标志物以及确定减害烟草产品潜力的一个重要研究领域。生物标志物文献的局限性应明确界定，并在综述的结论部分之前讨论如何在未来的研究中克服这些局限性。
7. 本综述中汇编/讨论的大部分生物标志物研究似乎非常陈旧（>10年）。不清楚是否有新的研究在大规模队列中复制了之前的发现，而这些研究未基于全面的文献检索被包括在内。
8. 未找到2020-2022年间关于COPD生物标志物的任何参考文献。2016至2019年的参考文献相对较少。作者应避免引用描述基本程序和综述的文章。综述的目的是在聚焦文献综述的基础上更新当前文献。请避免引用较旧的综述文章，并尽量在适当部分重视原创研究文章。
9. 在每个部分下描述的特定样本类型的发现缺乏连贯性和按时间顺序的整合。修订时应仔细解决这一问题。

#### 次要评论：
1. 简要方法部分第一段中的重要关键词似乎拼写错误，应更正以明确（“Smok*”和“Measur*”）。
2. 此外，关键词后的星号意味着什么？这在文本中不明确。
3. 有一些错别字，例如“Peribranchial”，需要检查并更正。
4. 有时，提供了研究细节但未提及研究的关键发现。例如，在CT扫描部分提到的（Kimura等人，2017）。
5. 基于当前文献，包括并讨论关于改良风险烟草产品的影像学发现将很重要。
6. 描述发现时未指明用于分析的样本类型（Rana等人，2010）。
7. 生物标志物是一个单词，不是“bio-marker”。
8. 格式化缺失信息的表格（所有引用的样本大小应包括在内）。此外，评论部分应标记为“关键发现”，参考文献引用可以移至最后一列。表1的标题应包括COPD。此表格不应提及一般生物标志物，仅包括与COPD相关的研究。
9. 基于本综述中总结的当前文献，包括基于不同样本类型识别的COPD生物标志物的示意图将对新入该领域的读者有所帮助。

reasons: This could be improved by widening the search criteria mentioned above or changing the text to reflect the clear COPD/lung disease focus of this review.
Most of the biomarker studies compiled/discussed in this review seem to be very old (> 10 years).
Relatively fewer references are included from 2016 to 2019.

Please refrain from citing older review articles and try to give importance to original research articles under appropriate sections.

This would be an important area where more research is needed for the identification of early biomarkers of lung disease as well as identifying potential for a reduced-risk tobacco product.

Important keywords appear to be misspelled in the first paragraph of the brief methods section and should be corrected for clarity (“Smok*” and “Measur*”).
Additionally, what do asterisks after keywords imply?
This is unclear in the text.
There are a few typos e.g., “Peribranchial” which need to be checked and corrected.
Sometimes, the study details were provided without mentioning the key findings from the study.
The sample type used for analysis is not indicated when the findings are described (Rana et al., 2010).
The biomarker is a single word, not “bio-marker”.
Data tables summarizing findings are not present for several sections.
The one table that includes statistical values for biomarkers does not include any direct comparisons between smokers and non-smokers.
There is a lack of coherence and integration of findings in chronological order for specific sample types described under each section.
This should be carefully addressed during the revision.
Format the table with missing information (sample size for all the citations should be included).
Additionally, the comments section should be labelled as ‘Key Findings’ and the reference citation can be moved to the last column.
The title of table 1 should include COPD.
This table should not mention general biomarkers and include only COPD-related studies.
Any insight on imaging findings from modified risk tobacco products will be important to include and discuss based on current literature.

Including schematic figures based on identified COPD biomarkers from different sample types based on current literature summarized in this review would be informative to readers who are new to this field.

paper_title: The Konark Temple’s Construction: A Critical Review of the Historical, Cultural, and Scientific Evidence
paper_abstract: Drawing from historical accounts, cultural practices, archaeological discoveries, and indigenous technical knowledge, the research presents a critical review of varied aspects of the construction of the Konark temple and provides future research directions. To fulfil the purpose, documents were sourced from Scopus, Google Scholar, and ancient texts and palm leaves. Findings suggest the legacy of Narasimhadeva I, the Hindu monarch who remained undefeated during his reign, safeguarded the kingdom from encroaching Muslim rulers. The narrative highlights the bravery of a faithful elephant that revived the king on the battlefield. The Konark temple was built with the dual purpose of showcasing the glory of his victory and devotion to the Sun God. The ancient artisans’ knowledge, skills, and commitment were crucial in erecting this tallest temple structure. The investigation further illuminates the use of sea routes for transporting monumental stones, the ingenuity in laying the temple’s foundation, the selection of high-grade stones, the monumental task of lifting colossal stones, like the world’s heaviest stone hoisted to a height of about two hundred feet, the use of rust-resistant iron, and the application of advanced astronomical knowledge by ancient artisans. The study provides insights into ancient engineering ingenuity, encouraging further exploration of the enduring legacy of the Konark temple’s construction.
review_content:
Thoroughness & Scope – The article provides an extensive review of historical, cultural, and scientific aspects of the Konark Temple’s construction. The depth of research and integration of multiple sources, including historical texts, archaeological findings, and indigenous knowledge, is commendable.
Interdisciplinary Approach – The combination of historical analysis, engineering insights, and cultural narratives enriches the discussion. However, a more structured comparison with contemporary temple architecture across different regions of India could provide additional context.
Scientific and Engineering Aspects – The discussion on iron usage and rust-resistant techniques is fascinating. It would be helpful to include a comparison with other ancient iron structures, such as the Iron Pillar of Delhi, to establish technological linkages.

Specific Comments:
Historical Narratives & Myths – While the study effectively explores historical accounts and folklore, some claims (such as the floating deity using magnets) require additional corroboration from scientific sources or metallurgical studies.
Methodology Clarification – The systematic review method is well described, but the inclusion criteria for selecting historical texts, palm leaf manuscripts, and indigenous narratives should be elaborated. How were these sources validated for accuracy?
Illustrations & Figures – The inclusion of figures is helpful in visualizing the temple’s architectural layout. However, some of them lack detailed captions or references to their sources (e.g., Figure 5’s sketch of the temple in its complete state).
Construction Techniques & Materials – The identification of Khondalite, Laterite, and Chlorite stones is insightful. However, the decay rate comparison with Western structures like St. Paul’s Cathedral might need more quantitative backing with geological studies.
Maritime & Transportation Hypothesis – The theory of stone transportation via sea routes is intriguing. Have geological or sedimentary studies been conducted along these proposed routes to confirm ancient maritime trade or transport links?
References: Lafta Farhan S.et.al. 2022 (Ref 1) This study discusses the transformation of historical city centers and could provide a comparative perspective on the cultural and architectural sustainability of heritage sites, similar to the preservation efforts and architectural significance discussed in the Konark Temple study.
paper_title_zh: 《科纳克神庙的建造：对历史、文化及科学证据的批判性回顾》
paper_abstract_zh: 从历史记载、文化实践、考古发现和本土技术知识中汲取灵感，本研究对科纳克寺庙建造的多个方面进行了批判性回顾，并提出了未来的研究方向。为实现研究目的，文献资料来源于Scopus、Google Scholar以及古代文本和棕榈叶手稿。研究发现，未尝败绩的印度教君主纳拉辛哈德瓦一世留下的遗产，保护了王国免受入侵的穆斯林统治者的威胁。叙事突显了一头忠诚大象在战场上救活国王的英勇行为。科纳克寺庙的建造旨在双重目的：展示其胜利的荣耀和对太阳神的虔诚。古代工匠的知识、技能和奉献对于竖立这座最高寺庙结构至关重要。调查进一步揭示了使用海路运输巨石、寺庙地基铺设的巧妙设计、高等级石材的选择、提升巨石的艰巨任务（如将世界上最重的石头提升到约二百英尺的高度）、耐锈铁的使用以及古代工匠对先进天文学知识的运用。该研究为古代工程智慧的洞察提供了依据，鼓励进一步探索科纳克寺庙建造的持久遗产。
review_content_zh:
全面性与范围 – 该文章对科纳克神庙建造的历史、文化和科学方面进行了广泛的综述。研究的深度和整合多种来源的能力，包括历史文本、考古发现和本土知识，值得称赞。
跨学科方法 – 历史分析、工程见解和文化叙事的结合丰富了讨论内容。然而，与印度不同地区当代寺庙建筑进行更有结构的比较，可以提供额外的背景信息。
科学与工程方面 – 关于铁的使用和防锈技术的讨论非常引人入胜。若能包括与其他古代铁结构（如德里的铁柱）的比较，以建立技术联系，将会有所帮助。

具体评论：
历史叙述与神话 – 虽然该研究有效地探讨了历史记载和民间传说，但某些说法（如浮动的神像使用磁铁）需要来自科学来源或冶金研究的进一步佐证。
方法澄清 – 系统综述方法描述得当，但选择历史文本、棕榈叶手稿和本土叙事的纳入标准应详细说明。这些来源是如何验证其准确性的？
插图与图表 – 包含图表有助于可视化寺庙的建筑布局。然而，其中一些图表缺乏详细的标题或来源引用（例如，图5中寺庙完整状态的草图）。
建造技术与材料 – 对Khondalite、Laterite和Chlorite石头的识别具有洞察力。然而，与西方结构如圣保罗大教堂的衰变率比较，可能需要更多地质研究的定量支持。
海上与运输假设 – 通过海路运输石头的理论引人入胜。是否沿这些拟议路线进行了地质或沉积物研究，以确认古代海上贸易或运输联系？
参考文献：Lafta Farhan S.等，2022（参考文献1）本研究讨论了历史城市中心的转变，可以为遗产地的文化可持续性和建筑重要性提供比较视角，类似于科纳克神庙研究中讨论的保护努力和建筑意义。

paper_title: Mislabeled examples detection viewed as probing machine learning models: concepts, survey and extensive benchmark
paper_abstract: Mislabeled examples are ubiquitous in real-world machine learning datasets, advocating the development of techniques for automatic detection. We show that most mislabeled detection methods can be viewed as probing trained machine learning models using a few core principles. We formalize a modular framework that encompasses these methods, parameterized by only 4 building blocks, as well as a Python library that demonstrates that these principles can actually be implemented. The focus is on classifier-agnostic concepts, with an emphasis on adapting methods developed for deep learning models to non-deep classifiers for tabular data. We benchmark existing methods on (artificial) Completely At Random (NCAR) as well as (realistic) Not At Random (NNAR) labeling noise from a variety of tasks with imperfect labeling rules. This benchmark provides new insights as well as limitations of existing methods in this setup.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
1. The paper introduces a novel modular framework for detecting mislabeled examples in datasets. This framework is parameterized by four core components, providing a unified perspective that encompasses most existing mislabeled detection methods. 2. A comprehensive survey of existing mislabeled detection methods is provided, where these methods are categorized and compared within the proposed framework. The survey includes methods designed for both deep learning models and classical machine learning algorithms. 3. The authors contribute a Python library that implements the modular framework. 4. The paper includes an extensive empirical evaluation, benchmarking a variety of mislabeled detection methods on datasets with different types of labeling noise.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
**Strengths** 1. The paper presents a unified, modular framework for detecting mislabeled examples in datasets, and releases a library for fast implementation and benchmarking. 2. The paper offers a thorough review of existing mislabeled detection methods, providing valuable insights into their strengths and weaknesses. 3. The empirical results reveal important findings, such as the limitations of existing methods in handling complex noise structures and the potential benefits of certain detection strategies. These insights are valuable for guiding future research in this area. **Weaknesses** 1. Dependency on Clean Validation Sets: The effectiveness of the detection methods often hinges on the availability of clean validation sets for hyperparameter tuning. In real-world scenarios where such clean data may not be accessible, the practical utility of these methods could be significantly constrained. 2. Omission of Recent Works: The paper's survey, as illustrated in Table 1, primarily focuses on methods developed no later than 2023, with most benchmarked detection methods dating before 2022. To offer a truly comprehensive survey, it is essential to include more recent works, such as the detection method for text data discussed in [R1]. Furthermore, given the paper's emphasis on text data, benchmarking "natural" label noise in popular RLHF datasets, as examined in [R2], would be particularly relevant. 3. Information Loss in Stochastic Case Handling: In Section 2.1.2, titled "Stochastic Case: The True Concept is Defined as a Probability Distribution," the paper discusses using a threshold to convert a probability into a hard label. This approach results in significant information loss, potentially limiting the effectiveness of the method. [R1] Unmasking and improving data credibility: A study with datasets for training harmless language models. ICLR 2024. [R2] Training a helpful and harmless assistant with reinforcement learning from human feedback. 2022.

**Requested Changes:**
Please revise the paper according to the comments above.

**Claims And Evidence:**
Yes

**Audience:**
Yes
paper_title_zh: 将错标样本检测视为探测机器学习模型：概念、综述及广泛基准测试
paper_abstract_zh: 错标样本在现实世界的机器学习数据集中普遍存在，这促使了自动检测技术的发展。我们表明，大多数错标检测方法可以被视为利用少数核心原理对训练好的机器学习模型进行探测。我们形式化了一个模块化框架，该框架涵盖了这些方法，仅由4个构建模块参数化，并开发了一个Python库，展示了这些原理实际上是可以实现的。重点在于分类器无关的概念，特别强调将针对深度学习模型开发的方法适配到非深度分类器，用于表格数据。我们在（人工的）完全随机（NCAR）以及（现实的）非随机（NNAR）标签噪声的各种任务上对现有方法进行了基准测试，这些任务具有不完美的标签规则。这一基准测试提供了关于现有方法在此设置中的新见解及其局限性。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
1. 论文引入了一种新颖的模块化框架，用于检测数据集中的错误标记样本。该框架由四个核心组件参数化，提供了一个统一的视角，涵盖了大多数现有的错误标记检测方法。
2. 提供了对现有错误标记检测方法的全面综述，这些方法在提出的框架内被分类和比较。综述包括针对深度学习模型和经典机器学习算法设计的方法。
3. 作者贡献了一个实现模块化框架的Python库。
4. 论文包含广泛的实证评估，对不同类型的标记噪声数据集上的多种错误标记检测方法进行了基准测试。

**优点和缺点：**
**优点**
1. 论文呈现了一个统一的、模块化的框架，用于检测数据集中的错误标记样本，并发布了一个用于快速实现和基准测试的库。
2. 论文对现有的错误标记检测方法进行了彻底的回顾，提供了关于其优缺点的宝贵见解。
3. 实证结果揭示了重要发现，例如现有方法在处理复杂噪声结构方面的局限性以及某些检测策略的潜在益处。这些见解对于指导该领域的未来研究具有重要价值。

**缺点**
1. 依赖清洁验证集：检测方法的有效性通常依赖于清洁验证集的可用性以进行超参数调优。在现实场景中，此类清洁数据可能无法获取，这些方法的实际效用可能受到显著限制。
2. 省略近期工作：如表格1所示，论文的综述主要关注于2023年及以前开发的方法，大多数基准测试的检测方法早于2022年。为了提供真正全面的综述，必须包括更多近期工作，例如[R1]中讨论的文本数据检测方法。此外，鉴于论文对文本数据的强调，基准测试[R2]中考察的流行RLHF数据集中的“自然”标签噪声将特别相关。
3. 随机情况处理中的信息损失：在第2.1.2节“随机情况：真实概念被定义为概率分布”中，论文讨论了使用阈值将概率转换为硬标签的方法。这种方法导致显著的信息损失，可能限制方法的有效性。
[R1] Unmasking and improving data credibility: A study with datasets for training harmless language models. ICLR 2024.
[R2] Training a helpful and harmless assistant with reinforcement learning from human feedback. 2022.

**请求的修改：**
请根据上述评论修改论文。

**声明和证据：**
是

**受众：**
是

paper_title: The role of salivary contents and modern technologies in the remineralization of dental enamel: a narrative review
paper_abstract: Human enamel once formed cannot be biologically repaired or replaced. Saliva has a significant role in remineralization of dental enamel. It not only has a buffering capacity to neutralize the oral cavity’s low pH generated after acidic encounters, but also acts as a carrier of essential ions, such as fluoride, calcium and phosphate, which have a positive role in enamel’s remineralization. This review discusses how salivary contents, like proteins and enzymes, have a natural role in enamel’s mineralization. In addition, the presence of ions, such as fluoride, calcium and phosphate, in saliva further enhances its capability to remineralize the demineralized enamel surface. The review further examines modern innovative technologies, based on biomimetic regeneration systems, including dentin phosphoproteins, aspartate-serine-serine, recombinant porcine amelogenin, leucine-rich amelogenin peptide and nano-hydroxyapatite, that promote enamel remineralization. Fluoride boosters like calcium phosphates, polyphosphates, and certain natural products can also play an important role in enamel remineralization.
review_content:
It is a well executed review. There are a few suggestions which could improve the overall impact of the review:
 1. Adding a schematic summarizing the de-mineralization and re-mineralization of dental enamel would improve the overall impact of the article.
 2. Was this a systematic review? If not mention that it is a narrative review based on published literature.
 3. A table summarizing the various recent techniques in re-mineralization along with each of their advantages and limitations would be vital for the article.
 4. The article seems to end abruptly. Kindly add a couple of sentences on prospects of further research as the concluding sentence.
The above-mentioned corrections are just suggestions to improve the overall quality of the article. I recommend the authors consider implementing the recommendations.
paper_title_zh: 唾液成分与现代技术在牙釉质再矿化中的作用：叙述性综述
paper_abstract_zh: 人类牙釉质一旦形成，无法进行生物修复或替换。唾液在牙釉质的再矿化中起着重要作用。它不仅具有缓冲能力，可以中和口腔在接触酸性物质后产生的低pH值，还作为必需离子的载体，如氟化物、钙和磷酸盐，这些离子在牙釉质的再矿化中具有积极作用。本文综述了唾液中的成分，如蛋白质和酶，在牙釉质矿化中的天然作用。此外，唾液中存在的离子，如氟化物、钙和磷酸盐，进一步增强了其再矿化脱矿牙釉质表面的能力。本文还探讨了基于生物仿生再生系统的现代创新技术，包括牙本质磷酸蛋白、天冬氨酸-丝氨酸-丝氨酸、重组猪釉原蛋白、富含亮氨酸的釉原蛋白肽和纳米羟基磷灰石，这些技术能促进牙釉质的再矿化。氟化物增强剂如磷酸钙、多磷酸盐以及某些天然产品也在牙釉质再矿化中发挥重要作用。
review_content_zh:
这是一篇执行得很好的综述。有几点建议可以提升综述的整体影响力：
1. 添加一个总结牙齿釉质脱矿和再矿化的示意图，将提升文章的整体影响力。
2. 这是一篇系统综述吗？如果不是，请注明这是一篇基于已发表文献的叙述性综述。
3. 一个总结各种近期再矿化技术及其各自优缺点和局限性的表格，对文章至关重要。
4. 文章似乎突然结束。请在结尾处添加几句关于未来研究前景的句子。
上述提到的修改仅为提升文章整体质量的建议。我建议作者考虑实施这些建议。

reasons: What is the reason for choosing 35 years and two databases Google Scholar and PubMed?
As some of the studies that may be some important papers published in journals indexed in other databases will be missing.

The article seems to end abruptly.

Was this a systematic review? If not mention that it is a narrative review based on published literature.

paper_title: Epidemiology of mental health problems in COVID-19: a review
paper_abstract: The novel coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) has become a pandemic affecting health and wellbeing globally. In addition to the physical health, economic, and social implications, the psychological impacts of this pandemic are increasingly being reported in the scientific literature. This narrative review reflected on scholarly articles on the epidemiology of mental health problems in COVID-19. The current literature suggests that people affected by COVID-19 may have a high burden of mental health problems, including depression, anxiety disorders, stress, panic attack, irrational anger, impulsivity, somatization disorder, sleep disorders, emotional disturbance, posttraumatic stress symptoms, and suicidal behavior. Moreover, several factors associated with mental health problems in COVID-19 are found, which include age, gender, marital status, education, occupation, income, place of living, close contact with people with COVID-19, comorbid physical and mental health problems, exposure to COVID-19 related news and social media, coping styles, stigma, psychosocial support, health communication, confidence in health services, personal protective measures, risk of contracting COVID-19, and perceived likelihood of survival. Furthermore, the epidemiological distribution of mental health problems and associated factors were heterogeneous among the general public, COVID-19 patients, and healthcare providers. The current evidence suggests that a psychiatric epidemic is cooccurring with the COVID-19 pandemic, which necessitates the attention of the global health community. Future epidemiological studies should emphasize on psychopathological variations and temporality of mental health problems in different populations. Nonetheless, multipronged interventions should be developed and adopted to address the existing psychosocial challenges and promote mental health amid the COVID-19 pandemic.
review_content:
Thank you for giving me the opportunity to review this article reporting the epidemiology of mental health problems in COVID-19. This is an important well-written article that will contribute to the literature in public health. The authors have done a great job putting this together and I would recommend that this review is published.

I would also recommend that authors take their time to go through the article and correct any grammatical errors in the manuscript.

Also, words such as psychological impact, psychological dimensions and psychological stress should not be used interchangeably with mental health if it is not probably a direct quote. For example, the sentence “psychological dimensions of COVID-19 are yet to be understood” could be rephrased as the mental health burden of COVID-19. Another statement “COVID-19 may have impacted psychological health among COVID-19 positive individuals” could also be rephrased. The consistency in the usage of mental health throughout the manuscript will make it easier for readers who are not expertise in this area to understand what the article is reporting.

Furthermore, please indicate in the limitations section that most of the included studies were conducted in countries/places that reported most of the early cases of COVID-19.
paper_title_zh: COVID-19中精神健康问题的流行病学：综述
paper_abstract_zh: 2019年新型冠状病毒病（COVID-19）已成为影响全球健康和福祉的大流行病。除了对身体健康、经济和社会的影响外，这一大流行病的心理影响在科学文献中日益被报道。本文通过叙述性综述，反思了关于COVID-19中心理健康问题流行病学的学术文章。现有文献表明，受COVID-19影响的人群可能面临沉重的心理健康问题负担，包括抑郁症、焦虑症、压力、恐慌发作、非理性愤怒、冲动性、躯体化障碍、睡眠障碍、情绪困扰、创伤后应激症状和自杀行为。此外，还发现了与COVID-19中心理健康问题相关的多个因素，包括年龄、性别、婚姻状况、教育程度、职业、收入、居住地、与COVID-19患者的密切接触、共病的身体和心理健康问题、接触COVID-19相关新闻和社交媒体、应对方式、污名、社会心理支持、健康沟通、对卫生服务的信心、个人防护措施、感染COVID-19的风险和感知生存可能性。此外，心理健康问题及其相关因素的流行病学分布在普通公众、COVID-19患者和医疗保健提供者之间是异质的。现有证据表明，精神疾病流行与COVID-19大流行并存，这需要全球卫生社区的重视。未来的流行病学研究应强调不同人群中心理病理学变异和心理健康问题的时态性。尽管如此，应开发和采用多方面的干预措施，以应对现有的社会心理挑战，并在COVID-19大流行期间促进心理健康。
review_content_zh:

此外，请在局限性部分指出，大多数纳入的研究是在报告了大多数早期COVID-19病例的国家/地区进行的。

paper_title: Methodological literature on the reporting of systematic reviews of health economic evaluations: a scoping review protocol
paper_abstract:
Systematic reviews of health economic evaluations play a crucial role in informing evidence-based healthcare decisions, yet they lack standardized reporting guidelines. A project has been initiated that aims to extend the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) guideline for systematic reviews of health economic evaluations (PRISMA-EconEval). This scoping review forms a foundation for the PRISMA-EconEval project, aiming to identify, map, and extract candidate reporting items from the methodological literature. 
 The scoping review will follow the PRISMA Extension for Scoping Reviews (PRISMA-ScR) Checklist and involve comprehensive searches in databases such as PubMed MEDLINE, Embase, and Web of Science, covering the period from 2015 to 2024. Supplementary searching, reference checking and citation searching will target grey literature, overlooked studies and evidence prior to 2015. Inclusion criteria will focus on methodological papers that provide frameworks or recommendations for reporting systematic reviews of health economic evaluations and enhanced case studies that critically discuss methods and reporting structures. The extracted data will be coded and analyzed to produce an initial list of candidate reporting items, structured according to conventional sections of a systematic review (e.g., title, abstract, methods, results). This initial list will be used in the subsequent stages of the project and disseminated through a peer-reviewed publication and presentations at international conferences. 
 The outcome of this scoping review will significantly contribute to the development of a comprehensive PRISMA-EconEval reporting guideline, aimed at enhancing the transparency, consistency, and quality of systematic reviews of health economic evaluations, and provide an essential tool for authors, editors, peer-reviewers, and stakeholders.
review_content: This paper presents the protocol for a scoping review of systematic reviews of health economic evaluations, with the aim of informing the development of a PRISMA "add-on" for reporting of SRs of health economic evaluations. The manuscript is clear and well written. The methods proposed are sound. I have no comments or edits.
paper_title_zh: 健康经济评估系统评价报告的方法学文献：一项范围综述协议
paper_abstract_zh:
健康经济评估的系统评价在支持循证医疗决策中发挥着至关重要的作用，然而它们缺乏标准化的报告指南。已启动一个项目，旨在扩展《系统评价和荟萃分析的首选报告项目》（PRISMA）指南，以涵盖健康经济评估的系统评价（PRISMA-EconEval）。本范围综述为PRISMA-EconEval项目奠定了基础，旨在识别、映射并从方法学文献中提取候选报告项目。

范围综述将遵循《PRISMA范围综述扩展》（PRISMA-ScR）清单，并在PubMed MEDLINE、Embase和Web of Science等数据库中进行全面搜索，涵盖2015年至2024年的时间段。补充搜索、参考文献检查和引文搜索将针对灰色文献、被忽视的研究以及2015年之前的证据。纳入标准将重点关注提供健康经济评估系统评价报告框架或建议的方法学论文，以及批判性讨论方法和报告结构的高级案例研究。提取的数据将被编码和分析，以生成初步的候选报告项目清单，该清单按照系统评价的常规部分进行结构化（例如，标题、摘要、方法、结果）。这一初步清单将在项目的后续阶段中使用，并通过同行评审的出版物和国际会议上的演讲进行传播。

本范围综述的结果将显著促进全面PRISMA-EconEval报告指南的开发，旨在提高健康经济评估系统评价的透明度、一致性和质量，并为作者、编辑、同行评审员和利益相关者提供重要工具。
review_content_zh: 本文介绍了对卫生经济评估系统评价的范围审查协议，旨在为开发用于报告卫生经济评估系统评价的PRISMA“附加组件”提供信息。手稿清晰且撰写良好。所提出的方法是合理的。我没有意见或修改建议。

paper_title: Aspiration in injections: should we continue or abandon the practice?
paper_abstract: Aspiration during any kind of injection is meant to ensure that the needle tip is at the desired location during this blind procedure. While aspiration appears to be a simple procedure, it has generated a lot of controversy concerning the perceived benefits and indications. Advocates and opponents of aspiration both make logically sound claims. However, due to scarcity of available data, there is no evidence that this procedure is truly beneficial or unwarranted. Keeping in view the huge number of injections given worldwide, it is important that we draw attention to key questions regarding aspiration that, up till now, remain unanswered. In this review, we have attempted to gather and present literature on aspiration both from published and non-published sources in order to provide not only an exhaustive review of the subject, but also a starting point for further studies on more specific areas requiring clarification. A literature review was conducted using the US National Institute of Health’s PubMed service (including Medline), Google Scholar and Scopus. Guidelines provided by the World Health Organization, Safe Injection Global Network, International Council of Nursing, Center for Disease Control, US Federal Drug Agency, UK National Health Services, British Medical Association, Europe Nursing and Midwifery Council, Public Health Agency Canada, Pakistan Medical Association and International Organization of Standardization recommendations 7886 parts 1-4 for sterile hypodermics were reviewed for relevant information. In addition, curricula of several medical/nursing schools from India, Nigeria and Pakistan, the US pharmacopeia Data from the WHO Program for International Drug Monitoring network in regard to adverse events as a result of not aspirating prior to injection delivery were reviewed. Curricula of selected major medical/nursing schools in India, Nigeria and Pakistan, national therapeutic formularies, product inserts of most commonly used drugs and other possible sources of information regarding aspiration and injections were consulted as well.
review_content:
The manuscript is intelligently written and authors have provided a literature review of need of pre-injection aspiration and discussed its utility in clinical practice. However, we would like to make a few pertinent observations:

The authors have not concluded the review article and it would be appreciated if they could summarize their observations from the literature review and provide an appropriate conclusion giving the readers an insight into the necessity of pre-injection aspiration.

Grammatical error in abstract: medical/-nursing schools... needs to be replaced with medical/nursing.

Grammatical error in literature review (methodology) - first line - An literature review to be replaced by A literature review.

Grammatical error in Findings of guidelines and recommendation (injection of medication) - Page 6 - ..Msc Nursing in India does not elaborated on injection techniques needs to be replaced with did not elaborate injection techniques.

In review of ISO guidelines, ISO section 5.3 - Page 6 - ...vaccine or medication into the syringe prior to aspiration to be replaced by ....prior to injection.

Spelling errors in Table 2 including Diphtheria and Tetanus in second row need to be rectified.
paper_title_zh: 注射中的抽吸：我们应该继续还是放弃这一做法？
paper_abstract_zh: 在任何类型的注射过程中，抽吸的目的是确保在盲操作过程中针尖位于预期位置。尽管抽吸看似是一个简单的程序，但它关于其感知益处和适应症的争议却很大。抽吸的支持者和反对者都提出了逻辑上合理的论点。然而，由于可用数据的稀缺，没有证据表明这一程序确实有益或无必要。考虑到全球范围内注射的数量巨大，我们有必要关注关于抽吸的关键问题，这些问题至今仍未得到解答。在这篇综述中，我们试图收集并呈现来自已发表和未发表来源的关于抽吸的文献，不仅提供一个对该主题的详尽回顾，也为进一步研究需要澄清的更具体领域提供一个起点。文献回顾通过使用美国国立卫生研究院的PubMed服务（包括Medline）、Google Scholar和Scopus进行。审查了世界卫生组织、安全注射全球网络、国际护理理事会、疾病控制中心、美国联邦药品管理局、英国国家医疗服务体系、英国医学协会、欧洲护理与助产士理事会、加拿大公共卫生署、巴基斯坦医学协会和国际标准化组织关于无菌皮下注射的推荐标准7886部分1-4的相关信息。此外，还审查了印度、尼日利亚和巴基斯坦的几所医学院/护理学院的课程，美国药典数据，以及世界卫生组织国际药物监测网络关于未在注射前抽吸导致的不良事件的资料。还参考了印度、尼日利亚和巴基斯坦选定的主要医学院/护理学院的课程、国家治疗配方、最常用药物的产品说明书以及其他关于抽吸和注射的可能信息来源。
review_content_zh:
手稿撰写得非常聪明，作者们提供了关于预注射抽吸需求的文献综述，并讨论了其在临床实践中的实用性。然而，我们想提出几点相关的观察意见：

作者们没有对综述文章进行总结，如果他们能从文献综述中总结他们的观察结果，并提供一个适当的结论，使读者对预注射抽吸的必要性有所了解，将不胜感激。

在审查ISO指南时，ISO第5.3节 - 第6页 - ...在抽吸前将疫苗或药物注入注射器需要替换为....在注射前。

A clear conclusion with feasible recommendations to come to evidence pro or con, or at least a nuancing in the pro and con of pre-injection aspiration would certainly contribute, as this is not really expressed.

In review of ISO guidelines, ISO section 5.3 - Page 6 - ...vaccine or medication into the syringe prior to aspiration to be replaced by ....prior to injection.
