paper_title: Resources, challenges and way forward in rare mitochondrial diseases research
paper_abstract: Over 300 million people are affected by about 7000 rare diseases globally. There are tremendous resource limitations and challenges in driving research and drug development for rare diseases. Hence, innovative approaches are needed to identify potential solutions. This review focuses on the resources developed over the past years for analysis of genome data towards understanding disease biology especially in the context of mitochondrial diseases, given that mitochondria are central to major cellular pathways and their dysfunction leads to a broad spectrum of diseases. Platforms for collaboration of research groups, clinicians and patients and the advantages of community collaborative efforts in addressing rare diseases are also discussed. The review also describes crowdsourcing and crowdfunding efforts in rare diseases research and how the upcoming initiatives for understanding disease biology including analyses of large number of genomes are also applicable to rare diseases.
review_content: This is a very good and informative review paper, which summarized nicely on the resources on research of mitochondrial diseases ranging from clinical setting to basic science.
paper_title_zh: "罕见线粒体疾病研究中的资源、挑战及前进方向"
paper_abstract_zh: 全球约有7000种罕见病，影响超过3亿人。在推动罕见病研究和药物开发方面存在巨大的资源限制和挑战。因此，需要创新方法来识别潜在的解决方案。本综述重点关注近年来为分析基因组数据以理解疾病生物学而开发的资源，特别是在线粒体疾病的背景下，鉴于线粒体是主要细胞通路的核心，其功能障碍会导致广泛的疾病谱。还讨论了研究小组、临床医生和患者合作平台的优势，以及社区协作努力在应对罕见病方面的优势。综述还描述了罕见病研究中的众包和众筹努力，以及即将到来的理解疾病生物学的倡议，包括大量基因组的分析，这些也同样适用于罕见病。
review_content_zh: 这是一篇非常优秀且信息丰富的综述文章，很好地总结了从临床环境到基础科学关于线粒体疾病研究的资源。

reasons: I would suggest the authors to compare the available databases of the mitochondrial research and may provide a better summary.

paper_title: Post-traumatic stress in the wake of the COVID-19 pandemic: a scoping review
paper_abstract:
Background: Post-traumatic stress symptoms (PTSS), as well as post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) itself, are common sequelae of disasters, including disease outbreaks such as the COVID-19 pandemic. Understanding their frequency and correlates is essential to developing preventive, therapeutic and supportive measures in a time of crisis. 
 Methods: A scoping review of the literature pertaining to PTSS and PTSD in relation to COVID-19 was carried out with the primary objective of assessing the frequency of PTSS/PTSD and the factors associated with it, and the secondary objective of summarizing expert recommendations in this field. For this purpose, PubMed and Embase literature databases were searched using the terms “COVID-19”, “nCoV-2”, “post-traumatic stress disorder”, “PTSS”, “PTSD” and “traumatization” in various combinations. A total of 10 relevant publications were found, which were tabulated and organized into original research on PTSS/PTSD (n = 7) and expert opinions or reviews (n = 3). 
 Results: The frequency of PTSS ranged from 7-34%, depending on study population and methodology. Gender, marital status, physical symptoms, and a prior psychiatric diagnosis were associated with the severity of PTSS. Expert opinions highlighted the prolonged nature of the impact of COVID-19, the need for long-term preventive and treatment strategies, and the need for innovation and collaboration in research and dissemination of information. 
 Conclusions: The COVID-19 outbreak is likely to leave a large number of persons suffering from PTSD in its wake. The above results may help us to identify those at risk in order to deliver preventive or early therapeutic interventions.
review_content:
The paper reads well, the methods are appropriate and the author should consider the following suggestions to improve the paper:
 1. The rationale for choosing a scoping review over a systematic review can be briefly explained.
 2. It would be good to state the exclusion criteria under the “Search Methodology” section as well.
paper_title_zh: COVID-19大流行后的创伤后应激：一项范围综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：创伤后应激症状（PTSS）以及创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）本身是灾难的常见后遗症，包括如COVID-19大流行等疾病爆发。了解其频率和相关因素对于在危机时期制定预防、治疗和支持措施至关重要。

方法：对与COVID-19相关的PTSS和PTSD文献进行了范围综述，主要目的是评估PTSS/PTSD的频率及其相关因素，次要目的是总结该领域的专家建议。为此，使用“COVID-19”、“nCoV-2”、“创伤后应激障碍”、“PTSS”、“PTSD”和“创伤化”等术语在PubMed和Embase文献数据库中进行检索。共找到10篇相关出版物，将其制表并分为原创性PTSS/PTSD研究（n = 7）和专家意见或综述（n = 3）。

结果：PTSS的频率范围为7-34%，取决于研究人群和方法学。性别、婚姻状况、身体症状以及既往精神疾病诊断与PTSS的严重程度相关。专家意见强调了COVID-19影响的长期性，需要长期的预防和治疗策略，以及在研究和信息传播中需要创新和合作。

结论：COVID-19爆发很可能在其后续留下大量患有PTSD的人群。上述结果可能有助于我们识别那些处于风险中的人，以便提供预防或早期治疗干预。
review_content_zh:
论文读起来很流畅，方法也恰当，作者应考虑以下建议以提升论文质量：
1. 可以简要说明选择范围综述而非系统综述的理由。
2. 在“搜索方法”部分也应说明排除标准。

reasons: The time of selection of the articles is very short, I would ask if it is your interest in indexing it, that the search will increase until September or October 2020, since a lot of information has been generated in this regard and not including it would be wasting the article.
You could also compare how it has occurred in different parts of the world since it is a global problem.
It is an interesting article that presents useful information on the subject of COVID-19. It is well presented, only it has a methodological error, which limits the results and its scope
The paper reads well, the methods are appropriate and the author should consider the following suggestions to improve the paper:
It would be good to state the exclusion criteria under the “Search Methodology” section as well.
The rationale for choosing a scoping review over a systematic review can be briefly explained.

paper_title: Monkeypox (mpox) in immunosuppressed patients
paper_abstract: The World Health Organization (WHO) proclaimed a public health emergency in July 2022 due to the emergence of Mpox (formerly monkeypox) while the globe was still dealing with the COVID-19 epidemic. The characteristics of mpox in immunocompetent individuals are well-characterized, despite difficulties in diagnostics, immunization, and access to treatment that persist in low-income countries. Patients with weakened immune systems are more likely to spread an illness and die from it than healthy people because they cannot mount a protective immune response against it, such as a neutralizing IgG and poxvirus-specific Th1 response. A health warning on severe mpox in people who are immunocompromised due to Human Immunodeficiency virus (HIV) and other illnesses was released by the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) on September 29, 2022. The advice does not specifically include primary immunodeficiency, but it does define other immunocompromising disorders as “having autoimmune disease with immunodeficiency as a clinical component”. Both those with healthy immune systems and those with weakened immune systems, such as those who are immunosuppressed, older people, children, etc., have encountered serious health issues, but the latter group is more likely to do so. According to the advisory, “of the people with severe mpox manifestations for whom CDC has been consulted, the majority have had HIV with CD4 counts 200 cells/ml, indicating substantial immunosuppression”. However, new cases are still expected to be discovered, especially in low-income countries with limited access to diagnosis, treatment, and prevention, and where a large percentage of the mpox-infected population also has advanced HIV infection. Thus, further research is always needed to determine the best way to treat mpox in immunocompromised people. In this context, we discussed /reviewed the mpox clinical presentation, available treatment options and current preventive guidelines in immunocompromised patients.
review_content:
Thank You for Giving me the opportunity for reviewing the manuscript. This is a very nicely described article. My comments are given below:

1. Introduction is written in detail. In the introduction please add about the MPOX in immunocompromised patient (in short). If there is any published cases on it, then authors can write it in short in the introduction part.

2. "The first case of Mpox was reported by the United Kingdom Health Security Agency (UKHSA) in the United Kingdom." Please add a reference.

3. An image of mechanism can be added at Transmission and replication part. (Pathophysiology).

4. In Ongoing MPXV outbreak 2022 part, one image of world map can be added with the color differentiation of cases.

5. In HIV, can we see CD4 count before injecting the vaccine? In that case, in what CD4 count, we can give vaccine? Is there any study on it? If not this paper can recommend this idea for the future. (If authors support my concept of CD4).

6. Conclusion and future aspects are written very well.

7. The paper has a good discussion on Mpox Vaccine. If authors agree my idea about CD4, can add as a recommendations

8. Is it possible to have an info graph on the topic? The Clinicians will get to know the treatment procedure quickly in ward. Like if an immunocompromised patient got admitted with Mpox. How the treatment should be given. What are the drug of choices. PCR is the test of Choice, please add that also in the management and info graph parts.

This is a nicely written and detail review on this topic. Information are written nicely with proper citations. This is a much needed discussion and the paper has filled that void successfully. This paper will be very much helpful for the scientific societies.
paper_title_zh: 免疫抑制患者中的猴痘（mpox）
paper_abstract_zh: 世界卫生组织（WHO）于2022年7月宣布因Mpox（原名猴痘）的出现而进入公共卫生紧急状态，当时全球仍在应对COVID-19大流行。尽管在低收入国家仍存在诊断、免疫和获取治疗方面的困难，但免疫健全个体中Mpox的特征已得到充分描述。免疫系统减弱的患者比健康人更有可能传播疾病并死于该病，因为他们无法产生保护性免疫反应，例如中和性IgG和痘病毒特异性Th1反应。美国疾病控制与预防中心（CDC）于2022年9月29日发布了对因人类免疫缺陷病毒（HIV）和其他疾病而免疫受损人群患严重Mpox的健康警告。该建议并未特别包括原发性免疫缺陷，但确实将其他免疫受损疾病定义为“具有免疫缺陷作为临床组成部分的自身免疫性疾病”。无论是免疫系统健康的人群还是免疫系统减弱的人群（如免疫抑制者、老年人、儿童等），都遇到了严重的健康问题，但后者更有可能出现这些问题。根据该建议，“在CDC咨询的患有严重Mpox表现的人群中，大多数患有HIV且CD4计数为200细胞/毫升，表明存在显著的免疫抑制”。然而，预计仍会发现新病例，特别是在低收入国家，这些国家在诊断、治疗和预防方面的获取有限，且很大比例的Mpox感染人群同时患有晚期HIV感染。因此，需要进一步研究以确定治疗免疫受损人群Mpox的最佳方法。在此背景下，我们讨论/回顾了免疫受损患者中Mpox的临床表现、可用的治疗选项和当前的预防指南。
review_content_zh:
感谢您给我审阅手稿的机会。这是一篇描述得非常详细的文章。我的评论如下：

1. 引言部分写得非常详细。在引言中请简要添加关于免疫受损患者中MPOX的内容。如果有相关已发表的病例，作者可以在引言部分简要提及。

2. “英国卫生安全局（UKHSA）在英国报告了首例Mpox病例。”请添加参考文献。

3. 在传播和复制部分（病理生理学）可以添加一张机制图。

4. 在“2022年持续MPXV疫情”部分，可以添加一张世界地图图像，并用颜色区分病例。

5. 在HIV部分，我们能否在注射疫苗前查看CD4计数？在这种情况下，CD4计数达到多少时可以接种疫苗？是否有相关研究？如果没有，本文可以推荐这一想法供未来研究（如果作者支持我的CD4概念）。

6. 结论和未来展望部分写得非常好。

7. 论文对Mpox疫苗进行了很好的讨论。如果作者同意我的CD4观点，可以作为建议添加。

8. 是否可以制作一个关于该主题的信息图表？临床医生可以快速了解病房中的治疗流程。例如，如果一名免疫受损患者因Mpox入院，应如何进行治疗，首选药物是什么。PCR是首选检测方法，请在管理和信息图表部分也添加这一点。

这是一篇关于该主题写得很好且详细的综述。信息撰写得当，引用准确。这是一次非常必要的讨论，论文成功地填补了这一空白。这篇论文将对科学界非常有帮助。

reasons: However, I would like to recommend to add more details on the underlying mechanisms of pathophysiological details in immunocompromised individuals.
This literature review beautifully explains the recently discovered monkeypox infection in the context of immunocompromised patients.

paper_title: Nonconventional opponents: A review of malaria and leishmaniasis among United States Armed Forces
paper_abstract: As the United States military engage with different countries and cultures throughout the world, personnel become exposed to new biospheres as well. There are many infectious pathogens that are not endemic to the US, but two of particular importance are Plasmodium and Leishmania, which respectively cause malaria and leishmaniasis. These parasites are both known to cause significant disease burden in their endemic locales, and thus pose a threat to military travelers. This review introduces readers to basic life cycle and disease mechanisms for each. Local and military epidemiology are described, as are the specific actions taken by the US military for prevention and treatment purposes.
review_content: Reviewer 1 Basic reporting Authors use the English language appropriately. Suggestions for modifying writing were minimal. The authors use several old and current references, adequate to the context of the study, but also suggest the inclusion of relevant works to complement some points of writing. Experimental design Article content is within the Aims and Scope of the Journal. Careful investigation with good writing. Methods need better description to replicate. Already done. Thank you - Is the Survey Methodology consistent with a comprehensive, unbiased coverage of the subject? More and less. - If not, what is missing? The authors can further detail the study methodology. We have revised the survey methodology. We believe the revised version well meet the requirements of reviewer. Comments for the author The manuscript presents a revision character and the results and conclusions contemplate the proposed objective. I make some considerations, however, to improve writing, especially some parts of the text. - Abstract (lines 57 to 58): Visceral leishmaniasis has been extensively studied in the world, especially in endemic countries as Brazil, so I think it is pertinent for the authors to clarify that the disease is still little addressed in the US. Done - Introduction (lines 84 to 86): The authors should tell when soldiers were negatively affected and cite sources consistent with the statement. We have added references to buttress the statement (Fukuda et al., 2011; Faulde et al., 2018). - Survey Methodology (lines 112 to 119): For this topic I make some suggestions. I believe that the authors can write in more detail what publications were considered for the review (if only original articles, common and/or systematic revisions, prior notes, brief communications, meta-analyzes, etc.). I also think it pertinent for the authors to cite the period of time considered for reading the references used (were articles sought from 1980 until today? Was a criterion of temporal selection of these studies used?). Another point that could be approached by the authors was the languages that these selected papers presented (English, Spanish, French, etc.) and the exclusion criteria of the researches that were not selected for review. Done. The whole section has been rewritten. We believe reviewer will appreciate the clarifications - Malaria (lines 125 to 128): The authors refer to a 2017 update that revealed 32 cases of malaria infection among US military personnel stationed overseas. How many soldiers there were among 32 cases? I find it interesting to situate the reader on this percentage of infection. The authors did not list the number of service men and women stationed at these locations viz a viz the number infected with malaria. However, these numbers are consistent with observations in previous years (Armed Forces Health Surveillance Branch, 2018) - Malaria (Causes) (lines 150 to 152): I suggest that the authors better explain this passage by highlighting that in the past, malaria was known as tertian or quartan fever, depending on the parasite species. This was related to the way in which the fever occurred in the patients after about 15 days: in the case of the tertian, the fever occurred every 48 hours (P. vivax, P. falciparum and P. ovale), and in the case of quartan, every 72 hours (P. malariae). The authors can cite references from malaria. While we understand reviewer concerns, we think it is best to leave comments as is, with slight modification to the sentence, to clarify that clinical malaria in the United States presents with symptoms similar to the flu. - Leishmania (Causes) (lines 225 to 228): In this topic I make two considerations. The authors can cite the metacyclic promastigote forms as infective for the vertebrate hosts during the blood meal of sandfly. The authors can also cite the diffuse cutaneous form as one of the clinical forms of tegumentary leishmaniasis. Done - Leishmania (Causes) (lines 232 to 234): I suggest rewriting this sentence in other words. I considered the phrase confusing to my understanding. Done - Leishmania (Causes) (lines 234 to 238): I suggest that the authors can cite more current US military infection data, since in the topic "Prevention and Treatment" (lines 261 to 262) the authors cite "Rowland 2015" as a reference in the passage "The reduced incidence rate of recent years has been attributed to better equipment and an emphasis on personal protective measures". What is this most current incidence rate? Done. We have also added a new reference (Stahlman et al., 2017) - Leishmania (Symptoms) (lines 241 to 242): This information is true: "Lesions can be self-resolving, as is often the case in many cases of CL", without treatment? I think that the authors can look for new references to better detail this statement. Done, new references added - Leishmania (Prevention and Treatment) (lines 286): The authors refer to recent reports of treatment failures in South and Latin America leishmaniasis, but do not cite any reference to this consideration. Done, new references added - Other: Military Canine Leishmaniasis (lines 312 to 314): The authors comment on a larger study volume in Mediterranean region and Brazil, however, could have cited some researches, including current studies of disease burden that have been published. Done, new references added - Conclusions (line 376): The authors can remove the word “are” from italics. Done Reviewer: Maria Sonia Ares Gomez Comments for the author This manuscript summarizes a literature search about malaria and leishmaniasis in the US military personnel. As strictly a literature review, the objectives are clear but the methods were not properly described. I have missed some of the most important and recent publications in both diseases and the searching method seems to be biased to more clinical than epidemiological publications. Overall, the paper is well-written and the results would be useful for future plans of improving malaria and leishmaniasis control. Specific comments: Line 57 - I will not use the term canine leishmaniasis since you are talking about human leishmaniasis caused by leishmania infantum, for which the main reservoir are dogs. The diseases in dogs is known as canine leishmaniasis in humans in some regions is known as zoonotic visceral leishmaniasis (ZVL) but can also be named as human visceral leishmaniasis caused by L. infantum. Done Line 115 - The methodology should be more specific and include details about the searching methods. All the subject directed key words should be included. The list of words used must be limited otherwise the search will be impossible to manage. The word “etc” does not provide precise information. The methods must also include if two or three words were search at the same time and what link was used (AND/OR). Done. The whole section has been rewritten Line 161 – this reference is missing (Yohannes et al., 2016) Done Line 181 - please add that has been observed in “rats” We cannot locate the section reviewer is referring to. We did a word search of the manuscript and “rats” does not exist. Line 181 refers to synergism upon simultaneous exposure to DEET and permethrin in humans. Line 237 – Could you please add how the % of CL in British, Dutch and German soldiers compares with the % of CL in American soldiers? This was not reported in the same way for the American soldiers. The data is generalized for other members of the International Security Assistance Force (ISAF) Line 288 - Please add a reference Done Line 291 - None of these 2 references is about the role of dogs as the main reservoir for leishmania infantum. Please include more appropriate references We appreciate reviewer insight; references replaced Line 291-297 - Leishmania infantum is responsible for Zoonotic Visceral Leishmaniasis in humans and rarely induced cutaneous symptoms. Some of the references used here are not appropriate, please read these 2 publications and consider to introduced them in this section (Burza et al., 2018) (Quinnell and Courtenay, 2009) Done, Thank you Line 314 - Please add a reference here Done Line 330 -331- Current Leishmania vaccines in dogs have been highly questioned as a prevention strategy since don’t stop transmission and only reduce clinical symptoms. Please include some precaution to this statement. Done, thank you. Vaccine efficacy is reported as a qualifying statement and a reference is specifically moved to support the statement that canine vaccination programs have demonstrated efficacy in reducing human disease burden
paper_title_zh: 非常规对手：美国武装部队中疟疾和利什曼病的综述
paper_abstract_zh: 随着美国军队与世界各地不同国家和文化的接触，人员也会接触到新的生物圈。许多传染性病原体在美国并非地方性流行，但特别重要的有两种：分别是引起疟疾的疟原虫和引起利什曼病的利什曼原虫。这些寄生虫在其地方性流行区域均已知会造成显著的疾病负担，因此对军事旅行者构成威胁。本综述向读者介绍了每种寄生虫的基本生命周期和疾病机制。描述了地方和军队的流行病学情况，以及美国军队为预防和治疗目的所采取的具体行动。
review_content_zh:
审稿人1 基本报告 作者恰当地使用了英语。对写作的修改建议很少。作者使用了多个旧的和当前的参考文献，适合研究的背景，但也建议包含相关作品以补充一些写作点。实验设计 文章内容在期刊的目标和范围内。调查细致，写作良好。方法需要更详细的描述以便复制。已完成。谢谢 - 调查方法是否与全面、无偏见的主题覆盖一致？有多有少。 - 如果不一致，缺少什么？作者可以进一步详细说明研究方法。我们已经修订了调查方法。我们相信修订版能满足审稿人的要求。对作者的意见 手稿具有修订性质，结果和结论符合预定目标。然而，我提出一些考虑，以改进写作，尤其是文本的某些部分。 - 摘要（第57至58行）：内脏利什曼病在世界上已被广泛研究，特别是在巴西等流行国家，因此我认为作者有必要澄清该病在美国仍较少被关注。已完成 - 引言（第84至86行）：作者应说明士兵何时受到负面影响，并引用与该声明一致的来源。我们已添加参考文献以支持该声明（Fukuda等人，2011年；Faulde等人，2018年）。 - 调查方法（第112至119行）：对于这个话题，我提出一些建议。我认为作者可以更详细地写出哪些出版物被考虑用于综述（是否仅原创文章、常见和/或系统综述、先前注释、简短通讯、元分析等）。我也认为作者引用考虑阅读参考文献的时间段是恰当的（是从1980年至今寻找文章吗？是否使用了这些研究的时间选择标准？）。另一个作者可以探讨的点是这些选定论文所用的语言（英语、西班牙语、法语等）以及未选入综述的研究的排除标准。已完成。整个部分已重写。我们相信审稿人会欣赏这些澄清 - 疟疾（第125至128行）：作者提到2017年的一项更新，显示在海外驻扎的美国军事人员中有32例疟疾感染。这32例中有多少是士兵？我觉得向读者说明这一感染比例很有趣。作者没有列出驻扎在这些地点的男女军人总数与感染疟疾的人数。 然而，这些数字与往年观察结果一致（武装部队健康监测分支，2018年）——疟疾（原因）（第150至152行）：我建议作者更好地解释这一段落，强调在过去，疟疾根据寄生虫种类被称为间日疟或三日疟。这与患者在大约15天后发热的方式有关：在间日疟的情况下，发热每48小时发生一次（P. vivax, P. falciparum和P. ovale），而在三日疟的情况下，每72小时发生一次（P. malariae）。作者可以引用疟疾的相关参考文献。虽然我们理解审稿人的担忧，但我们认为最好保持评论原样，并对句子进行轻微修改，以澄清美国临床疟疾的症状与流感相似。——利什曼病（原因）（第225至228行）：在这个话题上我有两点考虑。作者可以引用血液餐期间沙蝇对脊椎动物宿主具有感染性的后循环前鞭毛虫形式。作者还可以引用弥漫性皮肤型作为 tegumentary 利什曼病的临床形式之一。已完成——利什曼病（原因）（第232至234行）：我建议用其他词语重写这个句子。我觉得这个短语对我的理解有混淆。已完成——利什曼病（原因）（第234至238行）：我建议作者可以引用更当前的美国军事感染数据，因为在“预防和治疗”话题（第261至262行）中，作者引用“Rowland 2015”作为“近年来发病率降低归因于更好的设备和强调个人防护措施”的参考。最新的发病率是多少？已完成。我们还添加了新的参考文献（Stahlman等人，2017年）——利什曼病（症状）（第241至242行）：这条信息是真实的：“损害可以自行消退，正如许多CL病例常见的那样”，未经治疗？我认为作者可以寻找新的参考文献来更好地详细说明这一说法。已完成，添加了新的参考文献——利什曼病（预防和治疗）（第286行）：作者提到南美和拉丁美洲利什曼病治疗失败的近期报告，但没有引用任何参考来支持这一考虑。已完成，添加了新的参考文献——其他：军事犬利什曼病（第312至314行）：作者评论了地中海地区和巴西的更大研究量，然而，可以引用一些研究，包括已发表的当前疾病负担研究。已完成，添加了新的参考文献——结论（第376行）：作者可以删除斜体中的“are”一词。已完成审稿人：Maria Sonia Ares Gomez对作者的评论本文总结了关于美国军事人员疟疾和利什曼病的文献检索。作为纯粹的文献综述，目标明确，但方法描述不当。 我错过了一些关于这两种疾病的重要且最新的出版物，而且搜索方法似乎偏向于临床而非流行病学的出版物。总体而言，这篇论文写得很好，其结果对于未来改善疟疾和利什曼病控制的计划将非常有用。具体意见如下：

第57行 - 我不会使用“犬利什曼病”这一术语，因为你在谈论的是由婴儿利什曼原虫引起的人类利什曼病，其主要宿主是狗。狗的疾病被称为犬利什曼病，而在某些地区，人类的这种疾病被称为动物源性内脏利什曼病（ZVL），但也可以命名为由L. infantum引起的人类内脏利什曼病。已修改。

第115行 - 方法论应更加具体，并包括关于搜索方法的细节。所有主题导向的关键词都应包括在内。使用的词汇列表必须有限制，否则搜索将无法管理。“等等”一词不提供精确信息。方法还必须包括是否同时搜索了两个或三个词以及使用了什么链接（AND/OR）。已修改。整个部分已重写。

第161行 - 此引用缺失（Yohannes等人，2016）。已添加。

第181行 - 请添加“在‘大鼠’中”的观察结果。我们无法找到审稿人提到的部分。我们对稿件进行了关键词搜索，但“大鼠”一词不存在。第181行指的是人类同时暴露于DEET和氯菊酯时的协同作用。已修改。

第237行 - 你能否添加英国、荷兰和德国士兵中CL的百分比与美国士兵中CL的百分比的比较？对于美国士兵，这一数据并未以相同方式报告。该数据是对国际安全援助部队（ISAF）其他成员的概括。已修改。

第288行 - 请添加引用。已添加。

第291行 - 这两个引用都不是关于狗作为婴儿利什曼原虫主要宿主的作用。请包括更合适的引用。感谢审稿人的洞察；引用已替换。

第291-297行 - 婴儿利什曼原虫是人类动物源性内脏利什曼病的病原体，很少引起皮肤症状。此处使用的一些引用不合适，请阅读这两篇出版物并考虑将其引入本节（Burza等人，2018）（Quinnell和Courtenay，2009）。已修改，谢谢。

第314行 - 请在此处添加引用。已添加。

第330-331行 - 目前狗的利什曼病疫苗作为预防策略受到了高度质疑，因为它们不能阻止传播，只能减轻临床症状。请对此声明增加一些谨慎措辞。已修改，谢谢。疫苗效能在声明中作为限定性陈述报告，并特别移动引用以支持犬疫苗接种计划在减少人类疾病负担方面的有效性。

reasons: The authors use several old and current references, adequate to the context of the study, but also suggest the inclusion of relevant works to complement some points of writing.
I have missed some of the most important and recent publications in both diseases and the searching method seems to be biased to more clinical than epidemiological publications.
Line 288 - Please add a reference
Line 314 - Please add a reference here
Line 291 - None of these 2 references is about the role of dogs as the main reservoir for leishmania infantum. Please include more appropriate references

Line 291-297 - Leishmania infantum is responsible for Zoonotic Visceral Leishmaniasis in humans and rarely induced cutaneous symptoms. Some of the references used here are not appropriate, please read these 2 publications and consider to introduced them in this section (Burza et al., 2018) (Quinnell and Courtenay, 2009)
Authors use the English language appropriately.
Suggestions for modifying writing were minimal.
Overall, the paper is well-written and the results would be useful for future plans of improving malaria and leishmaniasis control.
Careful investigation with good writing.

paper_title: COVID-19 in pregnancy: What do we really know?
paper_abstract: Coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic, caused by severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2), continues to escalate worldwide and has become a pressing global health concern. This article comprehensively reviews the current knowledge on the impact of COVID-19 over pregnant women and neonates, as well as current recommendations for their management. We also analyse previous evidences from viral respiratory diseases such as SARS, Middle East respiratory syndrome, and influenza that may help to guide clinical practice during the current pandemic. We collected 23 case reports, case series, and case-control studies (18 from China) comprising 174 pregnant women with COVID-19. The majority of mothers showed a clinical presentation of the disease similar to that of non-infected adults. Preliminary evidences point towards a potentially increased risk of pregnancy adverse outcomes in women with COVID-19, with preterm delivery the most frequently observed (16.7%) followed by fetal distress (9.77%). The most commonly reported adverse neonatal outcomes included respiratory symptoms (7.95%) and low birth weight (6.81%). A few studies reported other maternal comorbidities that can influence these outcomes. Mothers with other comorbidities may be at higher risk of infection. Mother-to-child transmission of SARS-CoV-2 appears unlikely, with no study observing intrauterine transmission, and a few cases of neonatal infection reported a few hours after birth. Although the WHO and other health authorities have published interim recommendations for care and management of pregnant women and infants during COVID-19 pandemic, many questions remain open. Pregnant women should be considered in prevention and control efforts, including the development of drugs and vaccines against SARS-CoV-2. Further research is needed to confirm the exact impact of COVID-19 infection during pregnancy. To fully quantify this impact, we urgently need to integrate the current knowledge about viral characteristics, epidemiology, disease immunopathology, and potential therapeutic strategies with data from the clinical practice.
review_content:
I congratulate the authors for the extensive work on the review on COVID-19 effects upon pregnancy and maternal and neonatal outcomes.

I have few but essential comments for improving the text.

In the abstract: "a clinical presentation of the disease" is used. Please rephrase this sentence to make it more accessible.

Why describing the impact of other viral respiratory infections? Please add a sentence to justify your choice beside the lack of COVID-19 knowledge also in this part of the text.

This insight on other coronaviruses and pregnancy is very interesting. Nevertheless, it adds little information about the management of the current COVID-19 disease.

Were letters, perspectives, and reviews included in your data extraction/shortlisted papers?

You write: "The results of a point-of-care lung-ultrasound examination were found to correlate with CT findings in one pregnant women; and therefore, this technique has been proposed as a tool to facilitate the triage of mothers with suspected COVID-19" but were the articles case reports or studies? Were there statistical analysis?

In the conclusions you could discuss more recent literature and evidence regarding the administration of vaccines to pregnant women.

I also advice an update with more recent case studies and other databases for the search.
paper_title_zh: 妊娠期COVID-19：我们真正了解多少？
paper_abstract_zh: 2019冠状病毒病（COVID-19）大流行，由严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2（SARS-CoV-2）引起，持续在全球范围内升级，已成为紧迫的全球健康问题。本文全面回顾了目前关于COVID-19对孕妇和新生儿影响的知识，以及当前对她们管理的建议。我们还分析了来自严重急性呼吸综合征（SARS）、中东呼吸综合征和流感等病毒性呼吸道疾病的先前证据，这些证据可能有助于指导当前大流行期间的临床实践。我们收集了23篇病例报告、病例系列和病例对照研究（其中18篇来自中国），涉及174名感染COVID-19的孕妇。大多数母亲的临床表现与非感染成人相似。初步证据指向COVID-19孕妇可能增加的妊娠不良结局风险，早产最为常见（16.7%），其次是胎儿窘迫（9.77%）。最常见的围产儿不良结局包括呼吸症状（7.95%）和低出生体重（6.81%）。少数研究报告了可能影响这些结局的其他母体合并症。有其他合并症的母亲可能感染风险更高。SARS-CoV-2的母婴传播似乎不太可能，没有研究观察到宫内传播，少数新生儿感染病例在出生后几小时报告。尽管世界卫生组织和其他卫生机构已发布关于COVID-19大流行期间孕妇和婴儿护理和管理的临时建议，但仍有许多问题悬而未决。孕妇应在预防和控制工作中被考虑，包括开发针对SARS-CoV-2的药物和疫苗。需要进一步研究以确认COVID-19感染对妊娠的确切影响。为全面量化这一影响，我们迫切需要将当前关于病毒特性、流行病学、疾病免疫病理学和潜在治疗策略的知识与临床实践数据相结合。
review_content_zh:
我祝贺作者在关于COVID-19对妊娠及母婴结局影响的综述中所做的广泛工作。

我有几点但至关重要的意见以改进文本。

在摘要中：“疾病的临床表现”被使用。请重新措辞这句话，使其更易理解。

为何描述其他病毒性呼吸道感染的影响？请在文本的这一部分也添加一句来证明你的选择，而不仅仅是缺乏对COVID-19的了解。

关于其他冠状病毒和妊娠的见解非常有趣。然而，它对当前COVID-19疾病管理的相关信息增加不多。

在你们的数据提取/精选论文中是否包括了信件、观点和综述？

你们写道：“在一例孕妇中，床旁肺部超声检查的结果被发现与CT发现相关；因此，这项技术已被提议作为辅助分诊疑似COVID-19母亲的工具”，但这些文章是病例报告还是研究？是否有统计分析？

在结论中，你们可以讨论更多关于孕妇接种疫苗的最新文献和证据。

我也建议更新更多最新的案例研究和用于搜索的其他数据库。

reasons: Were letters, perspectives, and reviews included in your data extraction/shortlisted papers?
In the conclusions you could discuss more recent literature and evidence regarding the administration of vaccines to pregnant women.
I also advice an update with more recent case studies and other databases for the search.
This insight on other coronaviruses and pregnancy is very interesting.
Nevertheless, it adds little information about the management of the current COVID-19 disease.
Were there statistical analysis?
In the abstract: "a clinical presentation of the disease" is used.
Please rephrase this sentence to make it more accessible.
I have few but essential comments for improving the text.
Please add a sentence to justify your choice beside the lack of COVID-19 knowledge also in this part of the text.
But were the articles case reports or studies? Were there statistical analysis?
Finally, I would suggest to extend more the Conclusions, specially to better discuss the current and future implications of the COVID-19 on pregnancy.

paper_title: Innovative approaches to benign prostatic hyperplasia management: Options beyond conventional treatment strategies
paper_abstract: This review explored Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia (BPH), a prevalent condition among aging males to elucidate its multifaceted nature and emerging treatment options. It meticulously examined the pathophysiology, risk factors, and clinical presentation of BPH to shed light on its profound impact on the quality of patients’ lives. The review comprehensively presented management strategies, including pharmacological and surgical interventions, emphasizing the importance of tailored or individualized treatment plans. Furthermore, it scrutinized the emergence of technologies like laser therapy and minimally invasive procedures for their efficacy and safety profiles in managing BPH. The review culminates by underscoring the imperative for ongoing research endeavors to refine therapeutic approaches and optimize outcomes for individuals grappling with BPH to pave the way for enhanced patient care and well-being.
review_content:
Management of BPH is one of the most common interventions in urology, this review discusses the newest and uncommon treatment strategies.

I have some comments:
- Please use abbreviations when needed (i.e., use BPH instead of benign prostatic hyperplasia) in all text. Only first clarification is needed. Please check that all abbreviations are declared when first mentioned.

- Introduction "the Rezum Water Vapor Therapy together with the UroLift System, have drawn a lot of interest since they relieve symptoms more effectively than standard surgery". This is incorrect, studies have proven comparable symptoms relief outcomes and still need further confirmation.

- "lacunculation": What does this term mean...please clarify?

- Standard management approaches: the paragraph is very limited providing only summarised list of some of the current therapies, both pharmacological and surgical. Please expand it.

- Emerging therapeutic strategies: again, the paragraph is very limited and does not provide any constructive and new information. New techniques are only partially included and just mentioned, with no informative content.

- Addressing complications and comorbidities: this paragraph is redundant and little informative.
paper_title_zh: 良性前列腺增生管理的创新方法：超越传统治疗策略的选项
paper_abstract_zh: 本综述探讨了良性前列腺增生（BPH），这是一种在老年男性中常见的疾病，旨在阐明其多方面的性质和新兴的治疗方案。它细致地考察了BPH的病理生理学、风险因素和临床表现，以揭示其对患者生活质量产生的深远影响。综述全面介绍了管理策略，包括药物和手术治疗，强调制定个性化治疗计划的重要性。此外，它还深入研究了激光治疗和微创手术等技术的出现，评估其在管理BPH中的有效性和安全性。综述最终强调，持续的研究努力对于完善治疗方法、优化BPH患者的治疗效果至关重要，从而为提升患者护理和福祉铺平道路。
review_content_zh:
良性前列腺增生（BPH）的管理是泌尿外科最常见的干预措施之一，本综述讨论了最新和罕见的治疗策略。

我有以下几点意见：
- 请在需要时使用缩写（即，使用BPH代替良性前列腺增生）在所有文本中。只需首次澄清即可。请检查所有缩写在首次提及时均已声明。

- 引言中“Rezum水蒸气疗法与UroLift系统一起，因其比标准手术更有效地缓解症状而引起了广泛关注”。这是不正确的，研究表明症状缓解效果相当，仍需进一步确认。

- “lacunculation”：这个术语是什么意思……请澄清？

- 标准管理方法：该段落非常有限，仅提供了当前一些疗法（包括药物和手术）的概要列表。请扩展。

- 新兴治疗策略：同样，该段落非常有限，未提供任何建设性和新信息。新技术仅部分包含且仅提及，没有信息内容。

- 处理并发症和合并症：该段落冗余且信息量少。

paper_title: Exploring the Synergistic Potential of Pectin-Chitosan Composites for Advanced Drug Delivery and Biomedical Implant Applications: A Comprehensive Review and Future Perspectives
paper_abstract: The polysaccharides pectin and chitosan are derived from the fruit peels and exoskeletons of crustaceans and insects, respectively. Their biocompatibility and renewability make them suitable for use in food products. The size of the swelling and degradation of these cells can be controlled using different combinations. Pectin and chitosan are useful as medication delivery systems, where they can be integrated to control the dosages and residence times of pharmaceuticals. They have a wide range of applications such as wound dressings, body fat reducers, tissue engineering agents, and drug delivery agents. Addressing teeth loss with the use of dental implants is a critical element of dental care. In most cases, healing is time-consuming and painful. As a result of adding new materials to the implant surface, the healing process would accelerate, and medications would be delivered to the implant site with greater efficiency.
review_content:
Comments:
1. Abstract need to be rewrite and should well organized. Also, authors need to check for statement like swelling and degradation of cells.
2. The current review article is too general and need to be updated with current studies and recent advancement.
3. Authors, need to discuss and analyze the reported data for various physico-chemiccal, mechanical and biological outcomes of various developed and evaluated implants through in-vitro and in-vivo studies.
4. Authors, need to highlight various reported pectin and chitosan based drug delivery system such as nanoparticles, hydrogels etc. Also, need to discuss advantages and challenges.
5. Overall, authors need to revise the complete manuscript with some reported data, compare the reported work and allow the reader to get insight on recent trends in development of pectin and chitosan based drug delivery system and implants for biomedical applications. Also, authors need to add few figures to improve the quality of the manuscript and to build interest of readers.
paper_title_zh: 探索果胶-壳聚糖复合材料在先进药物递送和生物医学植入应用中的协同潜力：全面综述与未来展望
paper_abstract_zh: 果胶和壳聚糖这两种多糖分别来源于水果皮和甲壳类动物及昆虫的外骨骼。它们的生物相容性和可再生性使其适用于食品产品。通过不同的组合可以控制这些细胞的膨胀和降解尺寸。果胶和壳聚糖作为药物递送系统非常有用，它们可以整合在一起以控制药物的剂量和驻留时间。它们具有广泛的应用，如伤口敷料、体脂减少剂、组织工程剂和药物递送剂。使用牙科植入物来解决牙齿缺失问题是牙科护理的关键要素。在大多数情况下，愈合过程耗时且痛苦。通过在植入物表面添加新材料，愈合过程将加速，并且药物将以更高的效率递送到植入部位。

paper_title: Interventions and implementation considerations for reducing pre-treatment loss to follow-up in adults with pulmonary tuberculosis: A scoping review
paper_abstract:
Background 
 Tuberculosis (TB) is a leading cause of death worldwide with over 90% of reported cases occurring in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). Pre-treatment loss to follow-up (PTLFU) is a key contributor to TB mortality and infection transmission. 
 
 
 Objectives 
 We performed a scoping review to map available evidence on interventions to reduce PTLFU in adults with pulmonary TB, identify gaps in existing knowledge, and develop a conceptual framework to guide intervention implementation. 
 
 
 Methods 
 We searched eight electronic databases up to February 6 2024, medRxiv for pre-prints, and reference lists of included studies. Two review authors independently selected studies and extracted data using a predesigned form. We analysed data descriptively, presented findings in a narrative summary and developed a conceptual framework based on the Practical, Robust Implementation, and Sustainability Model to map the factors for effective intervention implementation. 
 
 
 Results 
 We reviewed 1262 records and included 17 studies. Most studies were randomized controlled trials (8/17, 47%). Intervention barriers included stigma and inadequate resources; enablers included mobile phones and TB testing and results on the same day. We identified eight interventions that reduced PTLFU: treatment support groups; mobile notifications; community health workers; integrated HIV/TB services; Xpert MTB/RIF as the initial diagnostic test; computer-aided detection with chest radiography screening; active linkage to care; and multi-component strategies. 
 
 
 Conclusion 
 Given the variation of healthcare settings, TB programs should consider contextual factors such as user acceptability, political commitment, resources, and infrastructure before adopting an intervention. Future research should utilize qualitative study designs, be people-centred, and include social and economic factors affecting PTLFU.
review_content:
Introduction
Authors have summarized the effects of various interventions undertaken in high TB burden settings to address PTLFU among adult Pulmonary TB patients and the barriers and enables thereof, using standard review methods. Using the synthesized evidence, they also developed a framework as a guide for reducing PTLFU. Therefore, this publication would be of great significance. It is very well written with good flow for easy understandability of health care workers and administrators at all levels.
Minor comments are as under:-
  * Para 1: May update the data-figures as per the latest Global TB Report
  * There is some repetition in 1st para of ‘results”
  * Treatment support Group: This evidence is from just one district of India, has to be stated accordingly.
  * Likewise for other studies, the geographical level/target group in which evidence was generated has to be mentioned.
paper_title_zh: 成人肺结核患者治疗前失访减少的干预措施及实施考量：一项范围综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景
结核病（TB）是全球主要的死亡原因之一，超过90%的报道病例发生在低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs）。治疗前失访（PTLFU）是导致结核病死亡和感染传播的关键因素。

目的
我们进行了一项范围综述，以梳理关于减少成人肺结核PTLFU的干预措施的证据，识别现有知识中的空白，并开发一个概念框架以指导干预实施。

方法
我们检索了截至2024年2月6日的八个电子数据库、medRxiv上的预印本以及纳入研究的参考文献列表。两名综述作者独立选择研究并使用预先设计的表格提取数据。我们进行了描述性数据分析，以叙述性摘要形式呈现结果，并基于实用、稳健实施和可持续性模型（Practical, Robust Implementation, and Sustainability Model）开发了一个概念框架，以映射有效干预实施的因素。

结果
我们审阅了1262条记录，纳入了17项研究。大多数研究为随机对照试验（8/17，47%）。干预障碍包括污名化和资源不足；促进因素包括手机和同日结核病检测及结果。我们确定了八项减少PTLFU的干预措施：治疗支持小组；移动通知；社区卫生工作者；整合的HIV/TB服务；Xpert MTB/RIF作为初始诊断测试；计算机辅助检测结合胸部放射筛查；主动联系照护；以及多组件策略。

结论
鉴于医疗环境的多样性，结核病项目在采用干预措施前应考虑情境因素，如用户接受度、政治承诺、资源和基础设施。未来的研究应采用定性研究设计，以人为中心，并包括影响PTLFU的社会和经济因素。

paper_title: Evaluation of cognitive load in team sports: literature review
paper_abstract: In team sports, load management has become one of the most common areas of investigation, given that effective control over load is the key to being able to optimize performance and avoid injuries. Despite the constant evolution and innovation in the latest theories, we can see a clear tendency in load management that focuses on physiological and mechanical aspects and neglects its cognitive character, which generates the variability inherent in the performance of athletes in a changing environment. Indicators of response that inform methods of control over cognitive load can include cognitive, physiological and behavioral indicators. However, limited investigations exist to support the reliability of each indicator regarding cognitive load. For this reason, the objective of this literature review is to present strategies used to manage cognitive load in team sports, as well as the indicators utilized for such a proposition and their relationships in specific contexts.

paper_title_zh: 团队运动中认知负荷评估：文献综述
paper_abstract_zh: 在团队运动中，负荷管理已成为最常见的研究领域之一，因为有效的负荷控制是优化表现和避免伤病的关键。尽管最新理论不断演变和创新，但我们仍可看到负荷管理中存在一种明显倾向，即侧重于生理和机械方面，而忽视了其认知特性，这导致了运动员在变化环境中表现出的内在变异性。用于告知控制认知负荷方法反应的指标可以包括认知、生理和行为指标。然而，支持每个指标在认知负荷方面的可靠性的研究有限。因此，本文献综述的目的是介绍团队运动中用于管理认知负荷的策略，以及用于此类提议的指标及其在特定情境中的关系。

paper_title: Explicating collegiality and change management in neoliberalism during the dynamics of higher education institutions: A Systematic Literature Review using PRISMA Checklist
paper_abstract:
Background 
    The neoliberal approach to higher education management has significantly transformed collegiality and university governance. This study identifies and analyzes how and where these changes have occurred, as well as their impact on the efficiency and competitiveness of universities. It addresses existing research gaps and provides new insights for adaptation strategies. 
  
  
    Methods 
    We selected all retrieved sources based on the keywords and analyzed all the documents we obtained. This study obtained data from Scopus retrieved on October 27, 2023. There are 416 sources were retrieved in Scopus Database within 1971 to 2023 publication year, then 662 documents were obtained. This study utilized bibliometric analysis to ensure a structured review of the literature on collegiality, change management, and neoliberalism in higher education. 
  
  
    Results 
    The findings show that organizational management, leadership, education, technology, curriculum, innovation, organizational change, decision-making, and human beings are significant trajectories of neoliberalism in higher education. 
  
  
    Conclusions 
    This study offers other constructs for accelerating leadership success in higher education. This relates to how change leadership can navigate changes resulting from neoliberal ideology.
review_content:
Although the article presents interesting research results, the overall development and documentation is deficient. It seems that the text is written more as an essay than a paper. Adjustments need to be made in order to have a more coherent, synthetic and robust text that is more in line with the format of a paper. Based on the reviewers' comments, some important changes have been made, but the overall impression is that the article lacks coherent and consistent linkage and documentation between theory, research questions and discussion of results.
Specifically, the introduction is lengthy and descriptive. It does not provide sufficiently the problematic and the state of the art of the research purpose until the end of the section. Data from different countries and institutions are not interrelated and commented. I think it is necessary the writers to state how the three research questions are interconnected and related theoretically. The arguments need a more thorough and concise documentation and critique. Nor it is clear what theoretical background will inform the research. In the section of "Literature review" the change management aspects and theories are not connected and/or commented upon with the ideology of neoliberalism and the restructurings of the NPM in higher education institutions.
In both sections introduction and literature review, as well as in discussion section, the bibliographical references that substantiate the arguments are presented in successive serialized references and not synthetically, while they are often repeated in the text without a clear and organic integration and connection with the main research questions.
In the "Methods" section it would be useful for the authors to mention the tools they used, such as Prisma and bias assessment in the design subsection where they mention the method selection.
The "Results" are well presented while the figures and the visualisations facilitate reader and illustrate sufficiently the research findings.
The discussion section is well developed and documented. Nevertheless, the findings are not directly related to the first and third research questions. In the section of "Conclusions" a general summary is given, but the authors' position and critical stance on the subject is missing.
Finally, a language check is needed for spelling, syntax and punctuation errors (eg "Lewis Change instead of Lewin's", double parentesis as in ((Nasution, Prasojo, Jannah, & Yumitro, 2020)).
paper_title_zh: 在高等教育机构动态中阐释新自由主义下的同事关系与变革管理：基于PRISMA清单的系统文献综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景
新自由主义高等教育管理方法显著改变了大学的同事关系和治理结构。本研究识别并分析了这些变化发生的方式和地点，以及它们对大学效率和竞争力的影响。它填补了现有研究的空白，并为适应策略提供了新的见解。

方法
我们根据关键词选择了所有检索到的来源，并分析了我们获取的所有文档。本研究的数据来自2023年10月27日检索的Scopus数据库。在1971年至2023年的出版年份内，Scopus数据库中检索到416个来源，然后获取了662个文档。本研究采用文献计量分析，以确保对高等教育中同事关系、变革管理和新自由主义的文献进行结构化综述。

结果
研究结果表明，组织管理、领导力、教育、技术、课程、创新、组织变革、决策和人类是新自由主义在高等教育中的显著轨迹。

结论
本研究为加速高等教育领导力成功提供了其他构念。这与变革领导如何应对新自由主义意识形态带来的变化有关。
review_content_zh:
尽管文章呈现了有趣的研究结果，但整体发展和文献记录存在不足。文本似乎更像是一篇散文而非论文。需要进行调整，以使文本更加连贯、综合和稳健，更符合论文的格式。根据评审者的意见，已进行了一些重要修改，但总体印象是文章在理论、研究问题和结果讨论之间的连贯性和一致性联系及文献记录不足。

具体而言，引言部分冗长且描述性过强。直到该部分末尾，仍未充分提供研究问题的难点和现状。来自不同国家和机构的数据未相互关联和评论。我认为作者需要阐明三个研究问题在理论上的相互联系。论证需要更全面和简洁的文献记录和批评。也不清楚将指导研究的理论背景是什么。在“文献综述”部分，变革管理方面和理论与新自由主义意识形态及高等教育机构的新公共管理（NPM）重组未连接和/或评论。

在引言和文献综述部分，以及讨论部分，支撑论证的参考文献以连续的序列化引用呈现，而非综合性地呈现，且在文本中经常重复，缺乏与主要研究问题的清晰和有机整合与联系。

在“方法”部分，作者提及所使用的工具（如Prisma和偏差评估）将有助于在设计子部分中说明方法选择。

“结果”部分呈现良好，图表和可视化有助于读者理解并充分说明研究发现。

讨论部分发展充分且文献记录完备。然而，发现结果并未直接关联到第一和第三个研究问题。在“结论”部分，给出了总体概述，但缺少作者对主题的立场和批判性观点。

最后，需要进行语言检查，以纠正拼写、语法和标点错误（例如“Lewis Change”应为“Lewin's”，双括号如((Nasution, Prasojo, Jannah, & Yumitro, 2020))）。

paper_title: Learning from Cochrane systematic reviews: what improvements do these suggest for the design of trials?
paper_abstract:
Background:  Many randomised trials have serious methodological flaws that fatally undermine their results, which makes the research wasteful. This is of concern for many, including those doing systematic reviews that include trials. Cochrane systematic reviews have a section called ‘  Implications for research ’, which allows authors of the review to present their conclusions on how future research might be improved. Looking at these conclusions might highlight priority areas for improvement. 
 Methods:  We focused on the Cochrane Schizophrenia Review Group and the Multiple sclerosis and rare diseases of the central nervous system Review Group (the MS Review Group).  Reviews with citation dates between 2009 and 2019 were identified and the recommendations of review authors in ‘  Implications for research’  were put into categories. 
 Results:  Between 2009 and 2019 we identified 162 reviews for the Schizophrenia Review Group and 43 reviews for the MS Review Group. We created 22 categories of recommendations in total, of which 12 were common to both groups. The five most used categories were the same for both: better choice of outcomes; better choice of intervention/comparator; longer follow-up; larger sample size; use of validated scales.  Better choice of outcomes and/or intervention/comparator was recommended in over 50% of reviews. Longer follow-up and larger sample size were recommended in over a third, with use of validated scales being suggested in around a fifth of reviews. There was no obvious pattern of improvement over time for trials included in systematic reviews published by both groups. 
 Conclusions:  We suggest that trialists working in these and other areas ask themselves, or are compelled to do so by others (e.g. funders), why they have chosen their outcomes, intervention and comparator, whether follow-up is long enough, if the sample size is big enough and whether the scales they choose to measure their outcomes are appropriate.
review_content:
Pirosca and colleagues have examined the 'Implications for research' section of 205 Cochrane reviews published between 2009 to 2019 from two editorial groups. The five most used categories were the same for both editorial groups: better choice of outcomes; better choice of intervention/comparator; longer follow-up; larger sample size; use of validated scales. Better choice of outcomes and/or better choice of intervention/comparator was recommended in over half of reviews; longer follow-up and larger sample size were recommended in over a third; and use of validated scales being suggested in around a fifth of reviews.

I think the authors should also discus their interesting findings from the point of view: how good are the Cochrane authors? E.g. we know from numerous studies (e.g., Rebecca M Turner et al.) that 80% to 90% of all Cochrane reviews do not reach a fair meta-analytic sample size providing the necessary power to assess medium large and small (but still clinically relevant) intervention effects. How come then that almost 66% of reviews do not mention larger sample sizes?
paper_title_zh: 从Cochrane系统评价中学习：这些对试验设计提出了哪些改进建议？
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：许多随机试验存在严重的方法学缺陷，这些缺陷严重削弱了其结果的有效性，导致研究资源的浪费。这对于包括进行系统评价的研究人员在内的许多人来说是一个值得关注的问题。Cochrane系统评价中有一个名为“研究启示”的部分，允许评价作者提出对未来研究改进的建议。审视这些建议可能会突出需要优先改进的领域。

方法：我们重点关注了Cochrane精神分裂症评价小组和中枢神经系统多发性硬化症及罕见病评价小组（MS评价小组）。我们识别了2009年至2019年间引用的评价，并将评价作者在“研究启示”中的建议进行分类。

结果：在2009年至2019年间，我们识别了精神分裂症评价小组的162篇评价和MS评价小组的43篇评价。我们总共创建了22个建议类别，其中12个类别是两个小组共有的。使用最多的前五个类别对两个小组来说是相同的：更好的结局选择；更好的干预/比较剂选择；更长的随访期；更大的样本量；使用验证过的量表。超过50%的评价建议改进结局和/或干预/比较剂的选择。超过三分之一的评价建议延长随访期和增加样本量，约五分之一的评价建议使用验证过的量表。在两个小组发表的系统评价中包含的试验，没有明显的随时间改进的趋势。

结论：我们建议在这些及其他领域工作的试验研究人员自行反思，或由他人（例如资助者）促使其反思，为何选择特定的结局、干预和比较剂，随访期是否足够长，样本量是否足够大，以及他们选择的用于测量结局的量表是否合适。
review_content_zh:
皮罗斯卡及其同事考察了2009年至2019年间由两个编辑组发表的205篇Cochrane综述中的“对研究的启示”部分。两个编辑组最常使用的五个类别相同：更好的结局选择；更好的干预/比较选择；更长的随访期；更大的样本量；使用经过验证的量表。超过一半的综述推荐了更好的结局选择和/或更好的干预/比较选择；超过三分之一的综述推荐了更长的随访期和更大的样本量；大约五分之一的综述建议使用经过验证的量表。

我认为作者还应该从以下角度讨论他们有趣的发现：Cochrane作者的素质如何？例如，我们从众多研究（如Rebecca M Turner等人的研究）中知道，80%到90%的Cochrane综述未能达到公平的元分析样本量，从而提供必要的效力来评估中等、大和小的（但仍有临床意义的）干预效果。那么，为何几乎66%的综述没有提及更大的样本量呢？

paper_title: School health assessment tools: a systematic review of measurement in primary schools
paper_abstract: Background. This systematic review aimed to investigate the psychometric properties of the school health's assessment tools in primary schools through COSMIN Risk of Bias checklist. We examined the studies that have addressed the measurement properties of school-health instruments to give a clear overview of the quality of all available tools measuring school health in primary schools. This systematic review was registered in PROPERO with the Registration ID: CRD42020158158.
review_content: Reviewer 2 (Anonymous) Thanks to the reviewer for the useful comments. Changes and editions are described below. Please observe that our answers are in bold type and direct references to the text are in green. The references to the text are in the format page xx, § xx, lines xx-xx and point to the TRACK CHANGES version. Basic reporting Thank you for the opportunity to review your manuscript! The authors address a critical issue regarding school health assessment and how the work fits into the broaden the knowledge of school health promotion. Major relevant literature has been appropriately referenced. Other suggestions: Title: Shouldn’t only the first alphabet of the first word be capitalized? We edited the title capitalization (page 1, line 1): “School health assessment tools: a systematic review of measurement in primary schools” WHO Health-Promoting Schools Framework and WHO health-promoting components were mentioned in the article. If they present the same concept, I suggest authors to maintain consistency throughout the article. At this revision due to the logical comments of reviewers we removed ‘’WHO Health-Promoting School Framework or components” as an inclusion criteria, instead all school health factors are included. Since at our systematic search we have searched for “school health”, all studies investigated a tool, index, scale, questionnaire, and instruments that have been conducted in primary schools are included in this study. Therefore, we changed the ‘’WHO Health-Promoting School Framework or components” to “school health factors”. Table 1. Please list studies reviewed in chronological order; use the correct format for Table 1 title. We listed the articles in chronological order, the Table 1 turned to Table 2 and its title was edited: “Table 2. Characteristics of studies investigating psychometric properties of school health instruments” Several grammar errors were identified. Please correct them throughout the manuscript. For example, line 305. Grammar errors have been corrected. The whole paper has been revised for language. Citations in the references should follow the guideline and format provided by the journal. In-text citations and reference citations have been edited based on journal guideline. Experimental design I hope the following suggestions will help improve the quality of the study. In the methods section, some information needs further clarifications. Criteria for selection (2), the instruments should measure the WHO health-promoting components (at least four of the eight components). Authors introduced several models suggesting various components of school health. I wonder why the WHO health-promoting components were used? What are those eight components proposed by WHO health-promoting? I suggest authors to address them in the literature review. Also, what is the rationale of at least four of eight components should be met? Please explain. Shouldn’t those WHO health-promoting components be used as terms other than “school health” to search for additional potential articles? Thank you for these beneficial comments, there is not any reason to insist on a specific model in this systematic review, so we substitute “school health factors” criteria for “WHO health-promotion components”. Therefore “at least four of eight components” has been removed. It should be mentioned that our systematic search has been searching for all school health models. In fact, all of the studies drawn from our systematic search have had that “at least four components of eight components of WHO model” and our double inquires and investigations showed that all of the school health studies that have been development or evaluation studies (regardless to their model) in primary schools are included in this study. Please refer to (page 4, lines 141-142): “The criteria for the selection of the studies included in this systematic review were those that: (1) developed an instrument(s) to measure school health; (2) the instruments should measure the school health factors; (3) evaluated at least one of the psychometric properties described in COSMIN Risk of Bias checklist for a school health instrument; (4) the instruments were constructed for primary school children; (5) were original research journal articles (i.e., book chapters, thesis and case studies were excluded); and (6) were in English. All articles that were not available online in full text were also excluded from the study.” Criteria for selection (4), please help me understand the rationale of the focus on primary school students? Why were middle and high schools excluded? If primary school was chosen, I suggest that authors improve the description in literature review to provide justification for your study. We specifically selected primary schools to make the study focused and more precise, and the other reason is that my (Maryam Kazemitabar) studies and interest have been in primary schools, and I am somehow experienced in primary school issues and the instrument I am developing for my thesis is for primary schools, I have concentrated on this for about 2 years. The following lines from background refer to literature regarding importance of childhood health and health at school (page 3, lines 68-80): “Childhood consists of the golden years of everyone’s life influencing many aspects of the rest of their lives among which health is of utmost importance. That is why the impact of childhood health status on adulthood health has been widely investigated (Wang & Shen, 2016; Ballard et al. 2015; Peneau et al., 2017; Kalmakis & Chandler, 2015; Mehlhausen-Hassoen & Winstok, 2019). The World Health Organization defines health as “a state of complete physical, mental and social well-being and not merely the absence of disease or infirmity” (WHO, 1948). In this regard, the World Health Organization emphasizes the necessity of sufficient healthcare during this period of life (Bravo-Sanzana, Salvo & Mieres-Chacaltana, 2015). Indeed, since children spend a tremendous time at school, the significance of providing a healthy environment at school in all aspects seems undeniable (Pedersen, 2019; Albert, 2019). Regarding the importance of childhood health, studies have suggested that healthy students learn better and they acquire better educational outcomes (Neumann, 2017; Lindegaard Nordin, Jourdan & Simovska, 2019; Anderson et al., 2017; Scott & Karberg, 2016).” The term “evaluation” was used in the search (line 151). It should be added to line 148. Thanks for reminding this, “evaluation” has been added to search procedure section (page 5, lines 158-160): “The terms searched were: “school health”, “health-promoting schools”, “coordinated school health”, “psychometric properties”, “reliability”, “validity”, “tool”, “scale”, “index”, “instrument”, “evaluation”, and “questionnaire”.” Validity of the findings If authors can clarify the issues mentioned in Experimental design section, the findings of the study will make more sense. The recommended comments mentioned in Experimental design have been considered. We are thankful for these precious comments. Results: Please make sure that the description and numbers of articles described in the Study Selection section aligns with Figure 1. We updated the figure along with the text descriptions.
paper_title_zh: 学校健康评估工具：小学测量方法的系统综述
paper_abstract_zh: 背景。本系统评价旨在通过COSMIN风险评估清单探讨小学学校健康评估工具的心理测量特性。我们审查了已对学校健康工具的测量特性进行研究的相关文献，以清晰地概述所有可用的小学学校健康测量工具的质量。该系统评价已在PROSPERO注册，注册编号为：CRD42020158158。
review_content_zh:
审稿人2（匿名）感谢审稿人提供的宝贵意见。以下是对修改和编辑的描述。请注意，我们的回答用粗体字表示，直接引用文本的部分用绿色标注。文本引用的格式为“第xx页，§ xx，第xx-xx行”，并指向“TRACK CHANGES”版本。

**基本报告**

感谢有机会审阅您的稿件！作者探讨了学校健康评估的关键问题，以及这项工作如何拓宽对学校健康促进知识的理解。相关的主要文献已适当引用。

其他建议：

**标题**：是否应该只有第一个单词的首字母大写？我们修改了标题的首字母大写（第1页，第1行）：“School health assessment tools: a systematic review of measurement in primary schools”

文章中提到了WHO健康促进学校框架和WHO健康促进成分。如果它们代表同一概念，建议作者在全文中保持一致性。根据审稿人的合理意见，我们在此次修订中删除了“WHO健康促进学校框架或成分”作为纳入标准，而是包括了所有学校健康因素。由于在我们的系统搜索中，我们搜索了“学校健康”，因此所有在小学进行的工具、指数、量表、问卷和仪器的调查都包含在本研究中。因此，我们将“WHO健康促进学校框架或成分”改为“学校健康因素”。

**表1**：请按时间顺序列出所审查的研究；使用正确的表1标题格式。我们将文章按时间顺序列出，表1变为表2，其标题也进行了修改：“表2. 调查学校健康工具心理测量特性的研究特征”

发现了多处语法错误。请在全文中进行修正。例如，第305行。语法错误已修正。全文已进行语言修订。

参考文献中的引用应遵循期刊提供的指南和格式。文中引用和参考文献引用已根据期刊指南进行编辑。

**实验设计**

希望以下建议能帮助提高研究的质量。在方法部分，某些信息需要进一步澄清。

**选择标准（2）**，工具应测量WHO健康促进成分（至少八个成分中的四个）。作者介绍了多种模型，提出了学校健康的不同成分。我想知道为什么使用WHO健康促进成分？WHO健康促进提出了哪八个成分？建议作者在文献综述中加以说明。此外，至少满足八个成分中的四个的依据是什么？请解释。是否应该使用这些WHO健康促进成分作为“学校健康”以外的术语来搜索其他潜在文章？

感谢这些有益的评论，在这篇系统综述中没有理由坚持特定的模型，所以我们用“学校健康因素”标准替代了“WHO健康促进成分”。因此，“至少八个成分中的四个”已被删除。应该提到的是，我们的系统搜索涵盖了所有学校健康模型。事实上，从我们的系统搜索中抽取的所有研究都符合“至少八个成分中的四个的WHO模型”，我们的双重查询和调查表明，所有在小学进行的学校健康研究（无论其模型如何）的开发或评估研究都包含在本研究中。请参考（第4页，第141-142行）：“纳入本系统综述的研究选择标准为：（1）开发了用于测量学校健康的工具；（2）工具应测量学校健康因素；（3）评估了COSMIN偏倚风险清单中描述的至少一项学校健康工具的心理测量特性；（4）工具是为小学生构建的；（5）是原创研究期刊文章（即，排除书籍章节、论文和案例研究）；（6）为英文文章。所有无法在线获取全文的文章也被排除在研究之外。”

**选择标准（4）**，请帮助我理解为何专注于小学生？为什么排除中学和高中？如果选择了小学，我建议作者在文献综述中改进描述，为研究提供依据。

我们特别选择小学以使研究更加聚焦和精确，另一个原因是我的（Maryam Kazemitabar）研究和兴趣一直在小学，我在这方面有一定经验，并且我正在为我的论文开发的工具也是针对小学的，我在这方面已经专注了大约两年。以下背景部分的行文涉及关于童年健康和学校健康重要性的文献（第3页，第68-80行）：“童年是每个人生命中的黄金岁月，影响其余生许多方面，其中健康最为重要。这就是为什么童年健康状况对成年期健康的影响已被广泛研究（Wang & Shen, 2016; Ballard et al. 2015; Peneau et al., 2017; Kalmakis & Chandler, 2015; Mehlhausen-Hassoen & Winstok, 2019）。世界卫生组织将健康定义为‘一种完全的身体健康、精神健康和社会福祉的状态，而不仅仅是没有疾病或虚弱’（WHO, 1948）。在这方面，世界卫生组织强调在这一生命阶段提供充足医疗保健的必要性（Bravo-Sanzana, Salvo & Mieres-Chacaltana, 2015）。事实上，由于儿童在学校度过大量时间，因此在各方面提供健康学校环境的重要性似乎不容否认（Pedersen, 2019; Albert, 2019）。关于童年健康的重要性，研究表明健康的学生学习更好，教育成果也更好（Neumann, 2017; Lindegaard Nordin, Jourdan & Simovska, 2019; Anderson et al., 2017; Scott & Karberg, 2016）。”

在搜索中使用了“评估”一词（第151行）。应将其添加到第148行。感谢提醒，已将“评估”添加到搜索程序部分（第5页，第158-160行）：“搜索的术语包括：‘学校健康’、‘健康促进学校’、‘协调学校健康’、‘心理测量特性’、‘可靠性’、‘有效性’、‘工具’、‘量表’、‘指数’、‘仪器’、‘评估’和‘问卷’。”

**结果的有效性**

如果作者能澄清实验设计部分提到的问题，研究的发现将更有意义。已考虑推荐的评论。感谢这些宝贵的意见。

paper_title: Neural Collapse: A Review on Modelling Principles and Generalization
paper_abstract: Deep classifier neural networks enter the terminal phase of training (TPT) when training error reaches zero and tend to exhibit intriguing Neural Collapse (NC) properties. Neural collapse essentially represents a state at which the within-class variability of final hidden layer outputs is infinitesimally small and their class means form a simplex equiangular tight frame. This simplifies the last layer behaviour to that of a nearest-class center decision rule. Despite the simplicity of this state, the dynamics and implications of reaching it are yet to be fully understood. In this work, we review the principles which aid in modelling neural collapse, followed by the implications of this state on generalization and transfer learning capabilities of neural networks. Finally, we conclude by discussing potential avenues and directions for future research.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
This paper presents a survey of recent results concerning the phenomenon of neural collapse. It summarizes the findings of a number of recent works and contrasts their assumptions, problem settings, and resulting findings to give an over-arching view of the research landscape. Additionally, the paper discusses the implications of neural collapse on generalization and transfer learning, drawing from the findings of

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
**Strengths:** - The paper consolidates a quickly-developing body of work into a single document, allowing the reader to easily compare results in a variety of settings. This is aided in particular by the parallel structure of the subsections found in section 3. - The paper provides helpful intuitions to the reader in the interpretation of many technical results. The additional space provided by the TMLR format allows for greater discussion than would be permitted in a conference paper, allowing for a more didactic approach. - The coverage of the literature seems quite thorough: while neural collapse is not my main research focus, I am somewhat familiar with the area and didn't notice any glaring omissions. **Weaknesses:** In contrast to other TMLR submissions I have read, this paper does not offer any novel theoretical or empirical results: instead, it provides a didactic summary of existing work on neural collapse. While surveys can certainly be useful tools to help bring people up to speed on an emerging literature, this one in particular faces two principal limitations: the field of neural collapse is still very nascent and so the burden of reading the literature is relatively light, and the paper doesn't provide much significant insight above and beyond that provided by the works it discusses. - While the paper claims to "analyse NC modelling techniques by unifying them under a common set of principles,", I was not able to determine what exactly this common set of principles was that was missing from the literature. Most of Section 3 seems to consist of summarizing the contributions of prior works according to their primary theoretical result, followed by a discussion of their interaction with the loss landscape. Aside from the shared notation, I don't see what additional principles are added by this paper on top of the contributions that already exist in the cited works. - It is not always clear where a derivation is new (and is thus replicating prior results under a unified framework) vs where it closely follows the cited text. In most cases that I dug into the latter seemed to be the case. - Section 4 seems to be largely an expanded summary of two papers by Galanti (et al.), for which it takes up disproportionate space. This is particularly salient given that the practical relevance of the generalization bounds discussed in this section is quite limited.

**Requested Changes:**
- Section 3 should more clearly delineate where the derivations are pulled from prior work and where the "from the ground up" modeling principle is being used to reproduce prior results. - The tables of results are a nice way to concisely summarize the contributions of a number of papers, however simply showing whether or not the authors conducted a type of analysis (as in Table 1) is not a particularly helpful format. Instead, what would be more useful is to directly compare theoretical results -- e.g. what types of NC properties are guaranteed, or what dynamics are followed by the gradent flow. - Section 4 should justify its large use of space for what appear to be relatively loose generalization bounds which hold in a relatively limited number of settings. Additionally, the discussion of transfer should be better-motivated: at the moment, the transfer result places very strong assumptions on the distribution of classes seen during training which makes the setting closer to a multitask iid setting than the generic distribution shift considered more broadly as the transfer learning setting.

**Claims And Evidence:**
Yes

**Audience:**
Yes

**Rebuttal Comments:**
Answer to Review of Paper758 by Reviewer cr7x #1: We are grateful for the detailed review of our manuscript by the reviewer and for the positive comments. **Reviewer:** While the paper claims to "analyse NC modelling techniques by unifying them under a common set of principles,", I was not able to determine what exactly this common set of principles was that was missing from the literature. Most of Section 3 seems to consist of summarizing the contributions of prior works according to their primary theoretical result, followed by a discussion of their interaction with the loss landscape. Aside from the shared notation, I don't see what additional principles are added by this paper on top of the contributions that already exist in the cited works **Answer:** Thank you for bringing up this confusion. We have adjusted our claims in the updated manuscript (text highlighted in blue) to clarify that we are not presenting any novel principles to unify the current modelling techniques. Instead, we present a review based on the existing principles of unconstrained features and local elasticity. Additionally, to avoid confusion due to UFM terminology, we have mentioned a brief note on the initial efforts that propose UFM and the N-layer peeled model in Section 3. **Reviewer:** It is not always clear where a derivation is new (and is thus replicating prior results under a unified framework) vs where it closely follows the cited text. In most cases that I dug into the latter seemed to be the case **Answer:** We have updated every section of the manuscript to clearly state whether we are reviewing existing work or presenting our own calculations. Additionally, we have deferred the analysis on ReLU networks and batch normalization for UFM settings to the Appendix to keep the reader on track with the UFM analysis in section 3.1.5. **Reviewer:** Section 4 seems to be largely an expanded summary of two papers by Galanti (et al.), for which it takes up disproportionate space. This is particularly salient given that the practical relevance of the generalization bounds discussed in this section is quite limited. **Answer:** Thank you for this suggestion. We have refined this section by removing figures and deleting text which is not significant in our presentation but was using up disproportionate space. However, since our aim is to present intuitive ideas (of the limited works on NC + generalization bounds) in a self-contained manuscript, the definitions, assumptions and setup for the generalization bounds seem to occupy up to 2 pages with the relevant figures in the updated manuscript. Please let us know if there is any additional scope for enhancement. **Reviewer:** The tables of results are a nice way to concisely summarize the contributions of a number of papers, however simply showing whether or not the authors conducted a type of analysis (as in Table 1) is not a particularly helpful format. Instead, what would be more useful is to directly compare theoretical results -- e.g. what types of NC properties are guaranteed, or what dynamics are followed by the gradient flow **Answer:** Thank you for the suggestion. We have modified Table 1 to summarize and compare the approaches based on the modelling technique, regularization/weight constraints, loss functions, class distribution constraints, the main approach for analysis, the NC properties that the body of work derives/analyses and finally the experiments columns have been updated to reflect empirical analysis relevant to NC. Especially, we have added the `Approach` and `NC` column which directly compares the key techniques used by the authors and the NC properties that they guarantee. Additionally note that although most of the approaches derive NC1-3 properties in their results, it is sufficient as Papyan et al. (2020) showed that NC1-2 imply NC3-4. **Reviewer:** Section 4 should justify its large use of space for what appear to be relatively loose generalization bounds which hold in a relatively limited number of settings. Additionally, the discussion of transfer should be better-motivated: at the moment, the transfer result places very strong assumptions on the distribution of classes seen during training which makes the setting closer to a multitask iid setting than the generic distribution shift considered more broadly as the transfer learning setting **Answer:** The spacing issue has been addressed in the above comment. Additionally, we agree with the reviewer that the assumptions are quite strongly related to the i.i.d setting for class conditional probabilities. We have updated section 4.3 to highlight this assumption before diving into the setup and results.
paper_title_zh: 神经坍缩：建模原理与泛化性能综述
paper_abstract_zh: 深度分类神经网络在训练误差达到零时进入训练的终端阶段（TPT），并倾向于表现出有趣的神经坍缩（NC）特性。神经坍缩本质上代表一种状态，即最终隐藏层输出的类内变异性极小，且其类均值形成一个等角紧框架的单纯形。这使得最后一层的行为简化为最近类中心决策规则。尽管这种状态简单，但达到该状态的动态过程及其影响尚未完全理解。在本研究中，我们回顾了有助于建模神经坍缩的原理，随后探讨了这种状态对神经网络泛化能力和迁移学习能力的影响。最后，我们通过讨论未来研究的潜在途径和方向来总结全文。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
本文对近期关于神经坍缩现象的研究成果进行了综述。它总结了多项近期工作的发现，并对比了它们的假设、问题设置和所得结果，提供了一个全面的研究概览。此外，本文还讨论了神经坍缩对泛化和迁移学习的影响，借鉴了相关研究的发现。

**优点与不足：**
**优点：**
- 本文将快速发展的研究内容整合成单一文档，使读者能够轻松比较各种设置下的结果。特别是第3节的子节平行结构对此有很大帮助。
- 本文为读者提供了有助于理解许多技术结果的直观解释。TMLR格式提供的额外空间允许进行比会议论文更深入的讨论，从而采用更具教学性的方法。
- 文献覆盖面似乎相当全面：虽然神经坍缩不是我的主要研究方向，但我对此领域有一定了解，并未发现明显的遗漏。

**不足：**
- 与我阅读的其他TMLR投稿相比，本文没有提供任何新颖的理论或实证结果：相反，它对现有关于神经坍缩的工作进行了教学性总结。尽管综述可以作为帮助人们快速了解新兴文献的有用工具，但本文特别面临两个主要限制：神经坍缩领域仍处于非常初期的阶段，因此阅读文献的负担相对较轻，且本文在所讨论工作的基础上没有提供太多有意义的额外见解。
- 尽管本文声称要“通过将NC建模技术统一在共同的原则下进行分析”，但我无法确定这些共同原则具体是什么，且在现有文献中缺失。第3节的大部分内容似乎是对先前工作贡献的总结，按照它们的主要理论结果进行分类，然后讨论它们与损失景观的相互作用。除了共享的符号外，我不清楚本文在已有贡献的基础上增加了哪些额外原则。
- 通常不清楚哪些推导是新的（即在统一框架下复制先前结果），哪些是紧密跟随引用文本的。在我深入研究的多数情况下，后者似乎更为普遍。
- 第4节似乎主要是对Galanti（等）两篇论文的扩展总结，占据了不成比例的空间。特别是考虑到本节讨论的泛化界限在实际应用中的相关性相当有限。

**请求的修改：**
- 第3节应更清楚地划分哪些推导来自先前工作，哪些是“从零开始”的建模原则，用于重现先前结果。
- 结果表格是简洁总结多篇论文贡献的好方法，但仅显示作者是否进行了某种分析（如表格1）的格式并不特别有用。更有用的是直接比较理论结果——例如，哪些类型的NC属性是保证的，或者梯度流遵循哪些动态。
- 第4节应为其所讨论的相对宽松且在有限设置中成立的泛化界限占用大量空间进行合理化。此外，迁移讨论应更有动机：目前，迁移结果对训练期间所见类别的分布提出了非常强的假设，使得该设置更接近多任务i.i.d设置，而非更广泛考虑的迁移学习设置中的通用分布偏移。

**声明与证据：**
是

**受众：**
是

**反驳意见：**
对Reviewer cr7x关于Paper758的评审意见#1的回复：我们感谢评审员对我们手稿的详细评审和积极评论。
**评审员：** 尽管本文声称要“通过将NC建模技术统一在共同的原则下进行分析”，但我无法确定这些共同原则具体是什么，且在现有文献中缺失。第3节的大部分内容似乎是对先前工作贡献的总结，按照它们的主要理论结果进行分类，然后讨论它们与损失景观的相互作用。除了共享的符号外，我不清楚本文在已有贡献的基础上增加了哪些额外原则。
**回复：** 感谢您提出这一困惑。我们在更新后的手稿中（蓝色高亮文本）调整了我们的声明，以澄清我们并未提出任何新颖原则来统一当前的建模技术。相反，我们基于现有的无约束特征和局部弹性原则进行了综述。此外，为避免因UFM术语引起的混淆，我们在第3节中简要提及了最初提出UFM和N层剥离模型的努力。
**评审员：** 通常不清楚哪些推导是新的（即在统一框架下复制先前结果），哪些是紧密跟随引用文本的。在我深入研究的多数情况下，后者似乎更为普遍。
**回复：** 我们已更新手稿的每一节，明确说明我们是在回顾现有工作还是呈现我们自己的计算。此外，我们将对ReLU网络和批量归一化在UFM设置下的分析推迟到附录，以使读者专注于第3.1.5节中的UFM分析。
**评审员：** 第4节似乎主要是对Galanti（等）两篇论文的扩展总结，占据了不成比例的空间。特别是考虑到本节讨论的泛化界限在实际应用中的相关性相当有限。
**回复：** 感谢这一建议。我们通过删除不重要的文本和图表精简了这一节，这些内容占用了不成比例的空间。然而，由于我们的目标是 在自包含的手稿中呈现直观想法（关于NC + 泛化界限的有限工作），泛化界限的定义、假设和设置在更新后的手稿中占据了约2页的相关图表。请告知是否有进一步改进的空间。
**评审员：** 结果表格是简洁总结多篇论文贡献的好方法，但仅显示作者是否进行了某种分析（如表格1）的格式并不特别有用。更有用的是直接比较理论结果——例如，哪些类型的NC属性是保证的，或者梯度流遵循哪些动态。
**回复：** 感谢建议。我们已修改表格1，以总结和比较基于建模技术、正则化/权重约束、损失函数、类别分布约束、主要分析方法、所得/分析的NC属性以及与NC相关的实证分析的approach。特别是，我们添加了“Approach”和“NC”列，直接比较了作者使用的关键技术和他们保证的NC属性。此外，请注意，尽管大多数方法在结果中推导了NC1-3属性，但这是足够的，因为Papyan等人（2020）表明NC1-2隐含NC3-4。
**评审员：** 第4节应为其所讨论的相对宽松且在有限设置中成立的泛化界限占用大量空间进行合理化。此外，迁移讨论应更有动机：目前，迁移结果对训练期间所见类别的分布提出了非常强的假设，使得该设置更接近多任务i.i.d设置，而非更广泛考虑的迁移学习设置中的通用分布偏移。
**回复：** 上述评论中已解决空间问题。此外，我们同意评审员的观点，即假设与类条件概率的i.i.d设置密切相关。我们已更新第4.3节，在深入设置和结果之前突出这一假设。

paper_title: Revisiting food-sourced vitamins for consumer diet and health needs: A perspective review from vitamin classification, metabolic functions, absorption, utilization, to balancing nutritional requirements
paper_abstract: The significant attention gained by food-sourced vitamins has provided insights into numerous current researches, for instance, the potential reversal of epigenetic age using a diet and lifestyle intervention, the balance between food and dietary supplements in the general population, the role of diet and food intake in age-related macular degeneration, and the association of dietary supplement use, nutrient intake and mortality among adults.
review_content: Reviewer 1 Basic reporting No comment Experimental design 1. The "Survey Methodology" part seems vague, which needs more details for the readers to fully understand how authors performed the survey. For examples, in line 159-160, "we applied discretion to strike a balance between the year of publication and the relevance of the information." Yet, it is not clear what is the specific strategy they use. What's the threshold for year of publication? How they determine the relevance? The authors should clarify this with details in the text. Reply: Thank you very much for your comments. We are sorry for not expressing the content clearly. The ‘Survey Methodology’ section has been rewritten in the revised manuscript and it is now clear. However, concerning publication year, only very few old research articles (Davidson, 1984; Evans & Lacey, 1986; DeLuca, 1986) were considered because of their relevance to the objective of this review. 2. Based on my understanding, the main research items, according to line 151 are vitamin absorption, transportation of vitamin, and cellular uptake of the vitamin. Yet, in my following reading of the paper, I got very limited new knowledge in these areas. Majority of the content goes to the detailed introduction of different vitamins which can be found in many popular science articles on the internet. I would suggest the authors focused more on the research findings in the specific research items they mentioned in the method. Reply: Thank you very much for your comments. We have updated these sections according to your suggestion. However, in order not to deviate from the scope of this perspective review, we have made a great effort in this revised manuscript to limit our discussion of findings for vitamin absorption and utilization (transportation and cellular uptake) to the context of water- and fat-soluble vitamins, without considering the individual vitamins one after the other. 3. As for the presentation of the data, I think there are too many figures, I would suggest the authors put the structures of different vitamins into one figure. Reply: Thank you very much. We have integrated all vitamin structures into one figure as you have suggested. Validity of the findings 4. In line 589-592, the author claims "This paper provides insight for future reviews/studies, which should help to further establish the intricacies underpinning how fat- and water-soluble vitamins interact within the food component matrix, as influenced by its absorption, transport, and cellular uptake." However, I don't see enough content to support their conclusion. In my opinion, the review provides very limited novel insights or raise any unresolved questions in the field. The authors should discuss more about the key questions that need to be addressed as well as gaps that need to be filled in the future. Reply: Thank you for your comments. We are sorry that we did not express the content clearly. We have now revised the entire manuscript and brought in additional insightful discourse that can help provide some reasonings that underpin many unresolved questions, for instance, the impact of vitamin interaction with food components in a food matrix, as well as how to strike a balance between food-sourced vitamins and dietary supplements. These we believe are among key questions that need to be addressed. This is now more robust and helps to support the conclusion as well as prospects suggested in this work Comments for the author 5. Generally, the review provide very comprehensive introduction to the food-sourced vitamins in regarding to their classification, sources, functions, etc. However, the review seems unbalanced, which loses focus on its scientific domain. The authors should reshape their writings to make it more suitable for a scientific review rather than a popular science article. Reply: Thank you very much for your comment and suggestion. Thanks to your very constructive feedback, as well as other reviewers, we have now revised this work. We are convinced you will find it well balanced, with a stronger focused scientific review, worthy of acceptance for publication.

发现的有效性：
4. 在第589-592行，作者声称“本文为未来的综述/研究提供了见解，这有助于进一步确立脂肪溶性维生素和水溶性维生素在食品成分基质中相互作用的复杂性，受其吸收、运输和细胞摄取的影响。”然而，我没有看到足够的内容来支持他们的结论。在我看来，该综述在领域内提供了非常有限的创新见解或提出任何未解决的问题。作者应更多地讨论需要解决的关键问题以及未来需要填补的空白。
回复：感谢您的评论。我们为内容表达不清表示歉意。我们现在已对整个稿件进行了修订，并引入了额外的有见地性论述，这有助于提供一些理由来支撑许多未解决的问题，例如，维生素与食品成分在食品基质中的相互作用的影响，以及如何在食品来源的维生素和膳食补充剂之间取得平衡。我们认为这些问题是需要解决的关键问题。现在这一点更加稳固，有助于支持本工作中提出的结论和前景。
作者评论：
5. 总体而言，该综述对食品来源的维生素的分类、来源、功能等提供了非常全面的介绍。然而，该综述似乎不够平衡，失去了其科学领域的焦点。作者应重塑他们的写作，使其更适合科学综述而不是科普文章。
