paper_title: Oligodendrocytes, BK channels and the preservation of myelin
paper_abstract: Oligodendrocytes wrap multiple lamellae of their membrane, myelin, around axons of the central nervous system (CNS), to improve impulse conduction. Myelin synthesis is specialised and dynamic, responsive to local neuronal excitation. Subtle pathological insults are sufficient to cause significant neuronal metabolic impairment, so myelin preservation is necessary to safeguard neural networks. Multiple sclerosis (MS) is the most prevalent demyelinating disease of the CNS. In MS, inflammatory attacks against myelin, proposed to be autoimmune, cause myelin decay and oligodendrocyte loss, leaving neurons vulnerable. Current therapies target the prominent neuroinflammation but are mostly ineffective in protecting from neurodegeneration and the progressive neurological disability. People with MS have substantially higher levels of extracellular glutamate, the main excitatory neurotransmitter. This impairs cellular homeostasis to cause excitotoxic stress. Large conductance Ca2 + -activated K +  channels (BK channels) could preserve myelin or allow its recovery by protecting cells from the resulting excessive excitability. This review evaluates the role of excitotoxic stress, myelination and BK channels in MS pathology, and explores the hypothesis that BK channel activation could be a therapeutic strategy to protect oligodendrocytes from excitotoxic stress in MS. This could reduce progression of neurological disability if used in parallel to immunomodulatory therapies.
review_content:
This review summarizes the current literature on the role of excitotoxic stress, myelination, and BK channels in MS pathology. The topic is timely and important. The manuscript is well written. However, there are a couple of concerns:
 1. The authors stated that "preserving myelin might provide a better neuroprotective strategy than remyelination". In fact, this manuscript concentrates on demyelination, rather than remyelination. It could be better to replace remyelination with demyelination in the title.
 2. This manuscript concentrates on demyelination, particularly in MS. It is important to summarize the current literature on mechanisms governing mature oligodendrocyte viability in MS and its animal models. Recent studies demonstrate the critical roles of PERK, NF-kB, among other signaling pathways in modulating oligodendrocyte viability and demyelination in MS and its animal models. These studies should be cited and discussed.
paper_title_zh: 少突胶质细胞、BK通道与髓鞘的保存
paper_abstract_zh: 少突胶质细胞将其膜的多层薄片——髓鞘，包裹在中枢神经系统（CNS）的轴突周围，以改善冲动传导。髓鞘合成是特化和动态的，能够响应局部神经元的兴奋。微小的病理损伤足以引起显著的神经元代谢障碍，因此髓鞘的保存对于保护神经网络是必要的。多发性硬化症（MS）是CNS中最常见的脱髓鞘疾病。在MS中，针对髓鞘的炎症攻击（被认为是自身免疫性的）导致髓鞘退化和少突胶质细胞丢失，使神经元变得脆弱。当前的治疗方法主要针对显著的神经炎症，但在保护神经退化和进行性神经功能障碍方面大多无效。MS患者细胞外谷氨酸水平显著升高，谷氨酸是主要的兴奋性神经递质。这会损害细胞内稳态，导致兴奋性毒性应激。大电导Ca2+-激活K+通道（BK通道）可能通过保护细胞免受过度兴奋的影响来保存髓鞘或促进其恢复。本文综述了兴奋性毒性应激、髓鞘形成和BK通道在MS病理中的作用，并探讨了BK通道激活作为一种治疗策略的可能性，以保护MS中的少突胶质细胞免受兴奋性毒性应激的影响。如果与免疫调节疗法并行使用，这可能减少神经功能障碍的进展。
review_content_zh:
本综述总结了当前关于兴奋性毒性应激、髓鞘形成和BK通道在多发性硬化症（MS）病理学中作用的文献。该主题及时且重要。手稿撰写良好。然而，存在一些问题：
1. 作者指出“保护髓鞘可能比再髓鞘化提供更好的神经保护策略”。事实上，该手稿主要集中在脱髓鞘，而非再髓鞘化。建议将标题中的再髓鞘化替换为脱髓鞘。
2. 该手稿专注于脱髓鞘，特别是在多发性硬化症中。总结当前关于成熟少突胶质细胞在MS及其动物模型中存活机制的文献非常重要。近期研究表明，PERK、NF-kB等信号通路在调节少突胶质细胞存活和MS及其动物模型中的脱髓鞘过程中发挥关键作用。这些研究应被引用并讨论。

reasons: The topic is timely and important.
The review was written fluently, clearly and the topics were discussed deeply enough.
The structure of the paper was clearly defined at the beginning of the text (page 3).

paper_title: Deep Generative Models for Offline Policy Learning: Tutorial, Survey, and Perspectives on Future Directions
paper_abstract: Deep generative models (DGMs) have demonstrated great success across various domains, particularly in generating texts and images using models trained from offline data. Similarly, data-driven decision-making also necessitates learning a generator function from the offline data to serve as the policy. Applying DGMs in offline policy learning exhibits great potential, and numerous studies have explored in this direction. However, this field still lacks a comprehensive review and so developments of different branches are relatively independent. In this paper, we provide the first systematic review on the applications of DGMs for offline policy learning. We cover five mainstream DGMs, including Variational Auto-Encoders, Generative Adversarial Networks, Normalizing Flows, Transformers, and Diffusion Models, and their applications in both offline reinforcement learning (offline RL) and imitation learning (IL). Offline RL and IL are two main branches of offline policy learning and are widely-adopted techniques for sequential decision-making. Notably, for each type of DGM-based offline policy learning, we distill its fundamental scheme, categorize related works based on the usage of the DGM, and sort out the development process of algorithms in that field. In addition, we provide in-depth discussions on DGMs and offline policy learning as a summary, based on which we present our perspectives on future research directions. This work offers a hands-on reference for the research progress in DGMs for offline policy learning, and aims to inspire improved DGM-based offline RL or IL algorithms. For convenience, we maintain a paper list on https://github.com/LucasCJYSDL/DGMs-for-Offline-Policy-Learning.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
This paper presents a survey of different deep generative models used for offline policy learning (offline RL and imitation learning). 5 types of models are discussed: VAE, GAN, Normalizing Flows, Transformers and Diffusion models. The paper first gives a background discussion for each of these model families, then for each of them a section is dedicated to discuss the relevant works in offline RL and imitation learning settings. The paper is the first review/survey paper on using deep generative models for offline policy learning, and serves as a tutorial for researchers interested in this topic.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
Strengths: - The paper is written and organized clearly and is easy to follow - The summary tables present a clear overview of different algorithms, the generative model variants that they used, and the evaluation tasks, which is quite useful. - Discussion section and table 13 provides insight on the main issues of each family of models and their extensions, which is interesting. Weaknesses: - As a survey paper, it provides limited technical novelty or results, the main contribution is in providing a tutorial and guidance for researchers interested in the related topics. - The survey itself does not have major weaknesses.

**Requested Changes:**
Would be nice to also have in the discussion section to compare these families of models in aspects such as general computation efficiency, implementation difficulty, training stability, difficult or easy to tune hyperparameters, etc.

**Claims And Evidence:**
Yes

**Audience:**
Yes
paper_title_zh: 离线策略学习的深度生成模型：教程、综述及未来方向展望
paper_abstract_zh: 深度生成模型（DGMs）在各个领域取得了显著成功，特别是在使用离线数据训练的模型生成文本和图像方面。同样，数据驱动的决策也需要从离线数据中学习生成器函数作为策略。将DGMs应用于离线策略学习展现出巨大潜力，众多研究已在这一方向上进行探索。然而，该领域仍缺乏全面的综述，不同分支的发展相对独立。本文首次系统地综述了DGMs在离线策略学习中的应用。我们涵盖了五种主流DGMs，包括变分自编码器、生成对抗网络、正则化流、Transformer和扩散模型，及其在离线强化学习（offline RL）和模仿学习（IL）中的应用。离线RL和IL是离线策略学习的两大主要分支，并被广泛用于序列决策。值得注意的是，对于每种基于DGM的离线策略学习，我们提炼了其基本方案，根据DGM的使用情况对相关工作进行分类，并梳理了该领域算法的发展过程。此外，我们基于DGMs和离线策略学习进行了深入讨论作为总结，并在此基础上提出了对未来研究方向的展望。这项工作为DGMs在离线策略学习中的研究进展提供了实用的参考，旨在激发改进的基于DGM的离线RL或IL算法。为方便起见，我们在https://github.com/LucasCJYSDL/DGMs-for-Offline-Policy-Learning上维护了一个论文列表。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
本文综述了用于离线策略学习（离线强化学习和模仿学习）的不同深度生成模型。讨论了5种类型的模型：变分自编码器（VAE）、生成对抗网络（GAN）、正则化流、Transformer和扩散模型。文章首先对每一类模型家族进行了背景讨论，然后针对每一类模型，分别用一个章节讨论了在离线强化学习和模仿学习设置中的相关研究。本文是首篇关于使用深度生成模型进行离线策略学习的综述/调研文章，并为对此话题感兴趣的科研人员提供了教程。

**优点与缺点：**
优点：
- 文章写作和组织清晰，易于理解。
- 摘要表格清晰地概述了不同算法、所使用的生成模型变体以及评估任务，非常有用。
- 讨论部分和表13提供了对每一类模型及其扩展主要问题的见解，颇具启发性。

缺点：
- 作为一篇综述文章，其技术新颖性或结果有限，主要贡献在于为对相关话题感兴趣的科研人员提供教程和指导。
- 综述本身没有重大缺点。

**请求的修改：**
希望在讨论部分也能对这些模型家族在诸如通用计算效率、实现难度、训练稳定性、超参数调优难易等方面进行比较。

**声明与证据：**
是

**受众：**
是

reasons: This paper presents a survey of different deep generative models used for offline policy learning (offline RL and imitation learning).
5 types of models are discussed: VAE, GAN, Normalizing Flows, Transformers and Diffusion models.

paper_title: A review of the therapeutic properties of dithiocarbamates
paper_abstract: The persistence of infectious diseases that continue to plague the world, as well as the formation of harmful substances within the human body, such as free radicals and reactive oxygen species (ROS) have sparked new research. Thus, the need for innovative approaches for developing new or modification of existing therapeutic agents. The design of biologically important metal complexes of dithiocarbamates (DTCs) has been made possible by recent advancements in innovative research. Dithiocarbamates are reduced thiuram disulfides with excellent complexing capabilities and have various applications. They are potent and work in tandem with the core metal ions of coordinating compounds to produce synergistic effects. Dithiocarbamates have many uses, including as antidotes for metal poisoning, cisplatin or carboplatin toxicity, and clinical trials for cancer, Lyme disease, human immunodeficiency virus and antibiotics. They exert anti-oxidant effect in cells. The understanding of the mechanisms of action of this therapeutic agent is important in drug repurposing. This review highlights the protective and therapeutic properties of dithiocarbamate compounds in biological systems.
review_content: The work of Ayangbenro et al. is an interesting and well-written summarized review that describes the therapeutic properties of dithiocarbamates. Mainly it highlights the protective and therapeutic properties of dithiocarbamate compounds in biological systems. It is a topic of great interest and I presume that it will be highly referenced by many authors working in drug discovery, especially those devoted to medicinal chemistry. The scheme followed describing the antioxidant properties of these compounds, treatment and prevention of organ damage, sepsis treatment and apoptosis, its limitations and conclusion is comprehensive and well-structured with up-to-date references containing the most essential data. In summary, a paper that I recommend for indexing. But my approval comes with some reservation due to minor points that should be considered prior to indexing and, under my point of view, would favour the understanding of the review. They refer to small editing changes I have already pointed out in the attached annotated manuscript.
paper_title_zh: 二硫代氨基甲酸盐的药用特性综述
paper_abstract_zh: 持续困扰世界的传染病以及人体内自由基和活性氧种（ROS）等有害物质的生成，激发了新的研究。因此，需要创新方法来开发新的或改进现有治疗剂。得益于创新研究的最新进展，设计具有重要生物学意义的二硫代氨基甲酸盐（DTCs）金属配合物成为可能。二硫代氨基甲酸盐是还原的硫脲二硫化物，具有出色的配位能力，并具有多种应用。它们效力强大，与配位化合物的核心金属离子协同作用，产生协同效应。二硫代氨基甲酸盐有多种用途，包括作为金属中毒、顺铂或卡铂毒性的解毒剂，以及用于癌症、莱姆病、人类免疫缺陷病毒和抗生素的临床试验。它们在细胞中发挥抗氧化作用。了解这种治疗剂的作用机制在药物再利用中具有重要意义。本综述重点介绍了二硫代氨基甲酸酯化合物在生物系统中的保护和治疗特性。
review_content_zh: Ayangbenro等人的工作是一篇有趣且文笔出色的综述，描述了二硫代氨基甲酸酯的 therapeutic properties。主要突出了二硫代氨基甲酸酯化合物在生物系统中的保护和治疗特性。这是一个备受关注的主题，我预计它将被许多从事药物发现，尤其是致力于药物化学研究的作者广泛引用。文中描述这些化合物的抗氧化特性、器官损伤的治疗与预防、败血症治疗和凋亡、其局限性及结论的框架全面且结构良好，引用了包含最关键数据的最新文献。总的来说，这是一篇我推荐进行索引的论文。但我的认可带有一些保留意见，因为有一些小问题在索引前应予以考虑，在我看来，这将有助于更好地理解这篇综述。这些问题涉及我在附带的注解手稿中已经指出的微小编辑改动。

reasons: However, it seems that the manuscript currently has a selective focus on the therapeutic effects of DTCs in liver, lungs, and kidney, but it lacks comprehensive coverage of the therapeutic effects of DTCs on sepsis.

The scheme followed describing the antioxidant properties of these compounds, treatment and prevention of organ damage, sepsis treatment and apoptosis, its limitations and conclusion is comprehensive and well-structured with up-to-date references containing the most essential data.

paper_title: Data publication consensus and controversies
paper_abstract: The movement to bring datasets into the scholarly record as first class research products (validated, preserved, cited, and credited) has been inching forward for some time, but now the pace is quickening. As data publication venues proliferate, significant debate continues over formats, processes, and terminology. Here, we present an overview of data publication initiatives underway and the current conversation, highlighting points of consensus and issues still in contention. Data publication implementations differ in a variety of factors, including the kind of documentation, the location of the documentation relative to the data, and how the data is validated. Publishers may present data as supplemental material to a journal article, with a descriptive “data paper,” or independently. Complicating the situation, different initiatives and communities use the same terms to refer to distinct but overlapping concepts. For instance, the term published means that the data is publicly available and citable to virtually everyone, but it may or may not imply that the data has been peer-reviewed. In turn, what is meant by data peer review is far from defined; standards and processes encompass the full range employed in reviewing the literature, plus some novel variations. Basic data citation is a point of consensus, but the general agreement on the core elements of a dataset citation frays if the data is dynamic or part of a larger set. Even as data publication is being defined, some are looking past publication to other metaphors, notably “data as software,” for solutions to the more stubborn problems.
review_content:
General Comments:
Note: This review was written by Parsons and accepted (with some modification) by Fox. Insights likely come from conversations between Fox and Parsons, errors from Parsons.

I am very glad the authors wrote this essay. It is a well-written, needed, and useful summary of the current status of “data publication” from a certain perspective. The authors, however, need to be bolder and more analytical. This is an opinion piece, yet I see little opinion. A certain view is implied by the organization of the paper and the references chosen, but they could be more explicit. The paper would be both more compelling and useful to a broad readership if the authors moved beyond providing a simple summary of the landscape and examined why there is controversy in some areas and then use the evidence they have compiled to suggest a path forward. They need to be more forthright in saying what data publication means to them, or what parts of it they do not deal with. Are they satisfied with the Lawrence et al. definition? Do they accept the critique of Parsons and Fox? What is the scope of their essay?

The authors take a rather narrow view of data publication, which I think hinders their analyses. They describe three types of (digital) data publication: Data as a supplement to an article; data as the subject of a paper; and data independent of a paper. The first two types are relatively new and they represent very little of the data actually being published or released today. The last category, which is essentially an “other” category, is rich in its complexity and encompasses the vast majority of data released. I was disappointed that the examples of this type were only the most bare-bones (Zenodo and Figshare). I think a deeper examination of this third category and its complexity would help the authors better characterize the current landscape and suggest paths forward.

Some questions the authors might consider: Are these really the only three models in consideration or does the publication model overstate a consensus around a certain type of data publication? Why are there different models and which approach is better for different situations? Do they have different business models or imply different social contracts? Might it also be worthy of typing “publishers” instead of “publications”? For example, do domain repositories vs. institutional repositories vs. publishers address the issues differently? Are these models sustaining models or just something to get us through the next 5-10 years while we really figure it out?

I think this oversimplification inhibited some deeper analysis in other areas as well. I would like to see more examination of the validation requirement beyond the lens of peer review, and I would like a deeper examination of incentives and credit beyond citation.

I thought the validation section of the paper was very relevant, but somewhat light. I like the choice of the term validation as more accurate than “quality” and it fits quite well with Callaghan’s useful distinction between technical and scientific review, but I think the authors overemphasize the peer-review style approach. The authors rightly argue that “peer-review” is where the publication metaphor leads us, but it may be a false path. They overstate some difficulties of peer-review (No-one looks at every data value? No, they use statistics, visualization, and other techniques.) while not fully considering who is responsible for what. We need a closer examination of different roles and who are appropriate validators (not necessarily conventional peers). The narrowly defined models of data publication may easily allow for a conventional peer-review process, but it is much more complex in the real-world “other” category. The authors discuss some of this in what they call “independent data validation,” but they don’t draw any conclusions.

Only the simplest of research data collections are validated only by the original creators. More often there are teams working together to develop experiments, sampling protocols, algorithms, etc. There are additional teams who assess, calibrate, and revise the data as they are collected and assembled. The authors discuss some of this in their examples like the PDS and tDAR, but I wish they were more analytical and offered an opinion on the way forward. Are there emerging practices or consensus in these team-based schemes? The level of service concept illustrated by Open Context may be one such area. Would formalizing or codifying some of these processes accomplish the same as peer-review or more? What is the role of the curator or data scientist in all of this? Given the authors’s backgrounds, I was surprised this role was not emphasized more. Finally, I think it is a mistake for science review to be the main way to assess reuse value. It has been shown time and again that data end up being used effectively (and valued) in ways that original experts never envisioned or even thought valid.

The discussion of data citation was good and captured the state of the art well, but again I would have liked to see some views on a way forward. Have we solved the basic problem and are now just dealing with edge cases? Is the “just-in-time identifier” the way to go? What are the implications? Will the more basic solutions work in the interim? More critically, are we overemphasizing the role of citation to provide academic credit? I was gratified that the authors referenced the Parsons and Fox paper which questions the whole data publication metaphor, but I was surprised that they only discussed the “data as software” alternative metaphor. That is a useful metaphor, but I think the ecosystem metaphor has broader acceptance. I mention this because the authors critique the software metaphor because “using it to alter or affect the academic reward system is a tricky prospect”. Yet there is little to suggest that data publication and corresponding citation alters that system either. Indeed there is little if any evidence that data publication and citation incentivize data sharing or stewardship. As Christine Borgman suggests, we need to look more closely at who we are trying to incentivize to do what. There is no reason to assume it follows the same model as research literature publication. It may be beyond the scope of this paper to fully examine incentive structures, but it at least needs to be acknowledged that building on the current model doesn’t seem to be working.

Finally, what is the takeaway message from this essay? It ends rather abruptly with no summary, no suggested directions or immediate challenges to overcome, no call to action, no indications of things we should stop trying, and only brief mention of alternative perspectives. What do the authors want us to take away from this paper?

Overall though, this is a timely and needed essay. It is well researched and nicely written with rich metaphor. With modifications addressing the detailed comments below and better recognizing the complexity of the current data publication landscape, this will be a worthwhile review paper. With more significant modification where the authors dig deeper into the complexities and controversies and truly grapple with their implications to suggest a way forward, this could be a very influential paper. It is possible that the definitions of “publication” and “peer-review” need not be just stretched but changed or even rejected.

Detailed comments:
  * The whole paper needs a quick copy edit. There are a few typos, missing words, and wrong verb tenses. Note the word “data” is a plural noun. E.g., Data are not software, nor are they literature. (NSICD, instead of NSIDC)
  * Page 2, para 2: “citability is addressed by assigning a PID.” This is not true, as the authors discuss on page 4, para 4. Indeed, page 4, para 4 seems to contradict itself. Citation is more than a locator/identifier
  * In the discussion of “Data independent of any paper” it is worth noting that there may often be linkages between these data and myriad papers. Indeed a looser concept of a data paper has existed for some time, where researchers request a citation to a paper even though it is not the data nor fully describes the data (e.g the CRU temp records)
  * Page 4, para 1: I’m not sure it’s entirely true that published data cannot involve requesting permission. In past work with Indigenous knowledge holders, they were willing to publish summary data and then provide the details when satisfied the use was appropriate and not exploitive. I think those data were “published” as best they could be. A nit, perhaps, but it highlights that there are few if any hard and fast rules about data publication.
  * Page 4, para 2: You may also want to mention the WDS certification effort, which is combining with the DSA via an RDA Working Group:
  * Page 4, para 2: The joint declaration of data citation principles involved many more organizations than Force11, CODATA, and DCC. Please credit them all (maybe in a footnote). The glory of the effort was that it was truly a joint effort across many groups. There is no leader. Force11 was primarily a convener.
  * Page 4, para 6: The deep citation approach recommended by ESIP is not to just to list variables or a range of data. It is to identify a “structural index” for the data and to use this to reference subsets. In Earth science this structural index is often space and time, but many other indices are possible--location in a gene sequence, file type, variable, bandwidth, viewing angle, etc. It is not just for “straightforward” data sets.
  * Page 5, para 5: I take issue with the statement that few repositories provide scientific review. I can think of a couple dozen that do just off the top of my head, and I bet most domain repositories have some level of science review. The “scientists” may not always be in house, but the repository is a team facilitator. See my general comments.
  * Page 5, para 10: The PDS system is only unusual in that it is well documented and advertised. As mentioned, this team style approach is actually fairly common
  * Page 6, para 3: Parsons and Fox don’t just argue that the data publication metaphor is limiting. They also say it is misleading. That should be acknowledged at least, if not actively grappled with.
paper_title_zh: 数据发布共识与争议
paper_abstract_zh: 将数据集作为一级研究产品（经过验证、保存、引用和认可）纳入学术记录的运动已经逐步推进了一段时间，但现在步伐正在加快。随着数据发布平台的增多，关于格式、流程和术语的显著争论仍在继续。在此，我们概述了正在进行的数据发布倡议和当前的讨论，突出共识点和仍有争议的问题。数据发布实施在多种因素上存在差异，包括文档的类型、文档相对于数据的位置以及数据的验证方式。出版商可能会将数据作为期刊文章的补充材料呈现，附带描述性的“数据论文”，或独立发布。使情况复杂的是，不同的倡议和社区使用相同的术语来指代不同但重叠的概念。例如，“已发布”一词意味着数据对几乎所有人公开并可引用，但可能并不暗示数据已经过同行评审。反过来，数据同行评审的含义远未明确；标准和流程涵盖了用于评审文献的全部范围，外加一些新颖的变体。基本的数据引用是一个共识点，但如果数据是动态的或属于更大的数据集，对数据集引用核心要素的普遍共识就会破裂。即使在数据发布正在被定义的同时，一些人已经在寻找超越发布的其他隐喻，尤其是“数据即软件”，以解决更顽固的问题。
review_content_zh:
总体评论：
注：本评论由Parsons撰写，经Fox接受（略有修改）。其中的洞见可能来自Fox与Parsons的对话，错误则由Parsons负责。

我很高兴作者撰写了这篇文章。这是一篇写得很好、必要且有用的关于“数据出版”当前状况的总结，从某种视角出发。然而，作者需要更大胆、更具分析性。这是一篇观点性文章，但我看到的观点却很少。文章的组织结构和所选参考文献暗示了一种特定的观点，但他们可以更明确一些。如果作者不仅仅提供对现状的简单总结，而是探讨某些领域存在争议的原因，并利用他们收集的证据提出前进的方向，那么这篇文章将对广大读者更具吸引力和实用性。他们需要更直截了当地说明数据出版对他们意味着什么，或者哪些部分他们没有涉及。他们对Lawrence等人的定义满意吗？他们接受Parsons和Fox的批评吗？他们文章的范畴是什么？

作者对数据出版的看法相当狭隘，我认为这阻碍了他们的分析。他们描述了三种（数字）数据出版类型：作为文章补充的数据；作为论文主题的数据；以及独立于论文的数据。前两种类型相对较新，它们代表的是今天实际出版或发布的数据中非常小的一部分。最后一类，本质上是一个“其他”类别，其复杂性丰富，涵盖了绝大多数发布的数据。我感到失望的是，这一类型的例子仅是最基本的（Zenodo和Figshare）。我认为对这第三类及其复杂性的深入探讨将有助于作者更好地描述当前状况并提出前进的方向。

作者可以考虑的一些问题：这些真的是唯一考虑的模型吗，还是出版模型夸大了围绕某种数据出版类型的共识？为什么存在不同的模型，哪种方法更适合不同的情况？它们有不同的商业模式或暗示不同的社会契约吗？是否也值得对“出版商”进行分类，而不仅仅是“出版物”？例如，领域存储库与机构存储库与出版商在处理问题上是否有所不同？这些模型是可持续的模型，还是仅仅是为了让我们在真正弄清楚之前度过接下来的5-10年？

我认为这种过度简化也抑制了其他领域的一些深入分析。我希望看到对验证要求的探讨超越同行评审的视角，并且希望对激励和信誉的探讨能超越引用的层面。

我认为文章的验证部分非常相关，但略显单薄。 我喜欢选择“验证”这一术语，认为它比“质量”更准确，并且与Callaghan对技术审查和科学审查的有用区分非常契合，但我认为作者过于强调了同行评审式的方法。作者正确地指出，“同行评审”是出版隐喻引导我们的方向，但这可能是一条错误的道路。他们夸大了一些同行评审的困难（没有人查看每一个数据值？不，他们使用统计、可视化和其他技术），而没有充分考虑谁应对什么负责。我们需要更仔细地审视不同的角色以及谁是合适的验证者（不一定是传统的同行）。狭义定义的数据出版模型可能很容易允许传统的同行评审过程，但在现实世界的“其他”类别中，情况要复杂得多。作者在他们所谓的“独立数据验证”中讨论了其中一些内容，但没有得出任何结论。

只有最简单的研究数据集是由原始创建者单独验证的。更常见的是，有团队合作开发实验、采样协议、算法等。还有额外的团队在数据收集和汇编过程中进行评估、校准和修订。作者在PDS和tDAR等示例中讨论了其中一些内容，但我希望他们能更具分析性，并提出关于前进方向的看法。在这些基于团队的方案中是否有新兴实践或共识？Open Context所展示的服务水平概念可能就是这样一个领域。将其中一些过程正式化或编码化是否能达到与同行评审相同或更好的效果？策展人或数据科学家在这一切中扮演什么角色？鉴于作者的背景，我对这一角色未被更多强调感到惊讶。最后，我认为将科学审查作为评估再利用价值的主要方式是一个错误。反复有研究表明，数据最终被有效使用（并受到重视）的方式是原始专家从未设想甚至认为有效的。

关于数据引用的讨论很好，很好地捕捉了当前技术水平，但我仍然希望看到一些关于前进方向的看法。我们是否已经解决了基本问题，现在只是在处理边缘案例？“即时标识符”是未来的方向吗？其影响是什么？更基本的解决方案在过渡期间会有效吗？更关键的是，我们是否过于强调引用在提供学术信用方面的作用？我很高兴作者引用了Parsons和Fox的论文，该论文质疑了整个数据出版隐喻，但我惊讶于他们只讨论了“数据作为软件”的替代隐喻。这是一个有用的隐喻，但我认为生态系统隐喻更广泛地被接受。我提到这一点是因为作者批评软件隐喻，因为“用它来改变或影响学术奖励系统是一个棘手的前景”。 然而，几乎没有迹象表明数据发布和相应的引用改变了这一系统。实际上，几乎没有证据表明数据发布和引用激励了数据共享或管理。正如克里斯汀·博格曼所建议的，我们需要更仔细地审视我们试图激励谁去做什么。没有理由假设它遵循与研究文献发布相同的模式。尽管全面审视激励结构可能超出了本文的范围，但至少需要承认，建立在当前模式之上的做法似乎并不奏效。

最后，这篇论文的结论是什么？它结束得相当突然，没有总结，没有提出方向或需要克服的即时挑战，没有行动号召，没有指出我们应该停止尝试的事情，只是简要提及了替代观点。作者希望我们从这篇论文中得到什么？

总体而言，这是一篇及时且必要的论文。它研究深入，文笔优美，隐喻丰富。通过修改以下详细评论中提到的问题，并更好地认识到当前数据发布环境的复杂性，这将是一篇有价值的综述文章。如果作者能更深入地探讨复杂性和争议，并真正应对其影响以提出前进方向，这可能会成为一篇非常有影响力的论文。可能“发布”和“同行评审”的定义不仅需要扩展，甚至需要改变或拒绝。

详细评论：
* 整篇论文需要快速校对。存在一些错别字、遗漏的词语和错误的动词时态。注意“data”是一个复数名词。例如，数据不是软件，也不是文献。（NSICD，而不是NSIDC）
* 第2页，第2段：“可引用性通过分配PID来解决。”这不正确，正如作者在第4页第4段中所讨论的。实际上，第4页第4段似乎自相矛盾。引用不仅仅是定位符/标识符。
* 在讨论“独立于任何论文的数据”时，值得指出的是，这些数据与众多论文之间可能经常存在关联。实际上，一个更宽松的数据论文概念已经存在一段时间了，研究人员要求引用一篇论文，即使它不是数据也没有完全描述数据（例如CRU温度记录）
* 第4页，第1段：我不确定发布的数据是否完全不能涉及请求许可。在以前与土著知识持有者的工作中，他们愿意发布汇总数据，然后在确信使用适当且非剥削性时提供详细信息。我认为那些数据是“发布”得最好的。这可能是个小问题，但它凸显了数据发布几乎没有硬性规定。
* 第4页，第2段：你可能还想提到WDS认证工作，它正在通过一个RDA工作组与DSA结合： * 第4页，第2段：数据引用原则的联合声明涉及的机构远不止Force11、CODATA和DCC。请对所有机构给予 credit（或许可以在脚注中）。这一努力的辉煌之处在于它确实是许多团体之间的真正联合努力。没有领导者。Force11主要是召集人。
  * 第4页，第6段：ESIP推荐的深度引用方法不仅仅是为了列出变量或数据范围。而是要为数据识别一个“结构索引”，并使用这一索引来引用子集。在地球科学中，这一结构索引通常是空间和时间，但许多其他索引也是可能的——基因序列中的位置、文件类型、变量、带宽、观察角度等。它不仅仅适用于“简单”的数据集。
  * 第5页，第5段：我不同意“很少有存储库提供科学审查”的说法。我能想到的有几十个，而且我敢打赌大多数领域存储库都有某种程度的科学审查。“科学家”可能不总是在内部，但存储库是一个团队促进者。见我的总体评论。
  * 第5页，第10段：PDS系统的独特之处仅在于它有良好的文档记录和宣传。如前所述，这种团队风格的方法实际上相当普遍。
  * 第6页，第3段：Parsons和Fox不仅仅认为数据出版隐喻是有限的。他们还认为这是误导性的。至少应该承认这一点，如果不是积极应对的话。

paper_title: Effects of aerobic exercise on event-related potentials related to cognitive performance: a systematic review
paper_abstract: Aerobic exercise interventions may affect different cognitive domains such as attention, working memory, inhibition, etc. However, neural mechanisms underlying this relationship, remains uncertain.
review_content: Reviewer 1 The paper is generally written well and easy to read. The topic is interesting and important. Sufficient background was provided in the introduction. Tables and figures are clear. There are some places that should be improved. 1. It would be good to include discussion on how ERP paradigms, features of study populations and dosage and lengths would affect the results. The authors have briefly mentioned some of these either in main text or table, it might be worth the address a little bit in discussion and consider how these would inform future research. Reply: We agree with the reviewer and have added a discussion of some of these features to the discussion 2. "Future studies should focus on comparing these aspects of aerobic exercise head-to-head". I am not sure what this means "head to head". Could you clarify. Reply: We apologize for the ambiguous language. We wished to convey the fact that these aspects needed to be compared directly in future studies. We have reformulated it in the manuscript. 3. As EEG is not very sensitive to structure change, it might be worth to link the current ERP findings with recent MRI findings in the discussion and see if there are consistent trend. Reply: This would certainly be useful, however MRI studies pre- to post exercise are lacking, but we have addressed this in the discussion. 4. There are similar systematic review on this topic which mentioned in the introduction. Should the authors highlight what additional knowledge has bee added by this review. Reply: We have added to the discussion in terms of addressing the referenced review in relation to what we believe the present review adds to the literature Experimental design See my comments above. Validity of the findings See above

paper_title: Biodesulfurization of Fossil Fuels: Analysis and Prospective
paper_abstract: Biodesulfurization (BDS) of fossil fuels is a promising method for treating the high content of sulfur in crude oils and their derivatives in the future, attributed to its environmental-friendly nature and the technical efficient ability to desulfurize the organosulfur compounds recalcitrant on other techniques. It was found that the bioreaction rate depends on the treated fluid, targeting sulfur compounds, and the microorganism applied. Also, many studies investigated the operation conditions, specificity, and biocatalysts modification to develop BDS efficiency. Furthermore, mathematical kinetics models were formulated to represent the process. In this review, the previous studies are analyzed and discussed. This review article is characterized by a clear picture of all BDS's experimental, industrial, procedural, theoretical, and hypothetical points.
review_content:
The article summarizes the main advantages and challenges of BDS, as well as the future research directions. The article points out that BDS is an environmentally friendly, low-cost, and high-efficiency method that can achieve ultra-low sulfur diesel (ULSD) standards, but it still needs to improve the reaction rate, biocatalyst stability and reusability, and engineering and commercialization efforts. I recommend accepting it with the following major changes that can complement the text content:
 1. Some details need to be modified, such as “B.T., DBT, DBTO2, M DBTSO2, MgSO4, BNT, DBS, 2,8 DMDBT, 2,6 DNDBT, DMDBT, thianthrene, and dibenzyl sulfide ” in page 4.
 2. Some abbreviations are not defined in the article: e.g.: BNT, 4,6-DB-DBT, 4-HDBT, etc. please check and correct them throughout the text.
 3. It has been more than thirty years since the first biodesulfurization bacterium was discovered, but the biodesulfurization technology has not been industrialized yet. Please summarize the existing problems in detail.

paper_title: Dissecting Loneliness in the Digital Age: An Insight into the Experiences of Medical Students Amid and Beyond the COVID-19 Pandemic
paper_abstract: This narrative review explores loneliness among medical students, particularly heightened during the COVID-19 pandemic. This review aims to narratively describe how the digital age, both pre- and post-pandemic, influences loneliness and to assess the psychological effects of the pandemic on medical students. Our literature search, adhering to SANRA guidelines, scrutinized studies published in the last ten years focusing on loneliness among medical students. Our findings reveal that medical students experienced significant loneliness during the pandemic, attributed to virtual learning environments and decreased social interactions. Notably, the transition to online education has mitigated and exacerbated feelings of isolation. The review also highlights the dual role of social media in either alleviating or intensifying loneliness, depending on usage patterns and platform types. Overall, our study underscores the need for targeted interventions and support systems to address the mental well-being of medical students in the digital age and beyond, providing crucial insights for future research and policy-making in educational and psychological support frameworks.
review_content:
Thank you for the invitation to review.

My review has a degree of bias, considering that the paper was initially written in 2023, reviewed in Q4 2024, and now myself.

Overall, the methodology was sufficient. It provided enough information for the narrative review to be generated.

The intervention slide provided contained imagery that might or might not be copyrighted. I agree with the previous reviewer that the authors should clearly state how the image was obtained.

The discussion is well elaborated for a narrative review. However, this is where my bias will occur. Considering the pandemic was two years ago, is the review still relevant? Do we still need to look into these interventions, as the review stated, or should we explore the topic with a fresh lens? I am not suggesting that the authors rewrite this. It is what it is for a 2023 paper. I am writing this here for readers to consider critically when using the information.

paper_title: Does evidence support the high expectations placed in precision medicine? A bibliographic review
paper_abstract:
Background : Precision medicine is the Holy Grail of interventions that are tailored to a patient’s individual characteristics. However, conventional clinical trials are designed to find differences in averages, and interpreting these differences depends on untestable assumptions. Although only an ideal, a constant effect of treatment would facilitate individual management. A direct consequence of a constant effect is that the variance of the outcome measure would be the same in the treated and control arms. We reviewed the literature to explore the similarity of these variances as a foundation for examining whether and how often precision medicine is definitively required. 
 Methods : We reviewed parallel clinical trials with numerical primary endpoints published in 2004, 2007, 2010 and 2013. We collected the baseline and final standard deviations of the main outcome measure. We assessed homoscedasticity by comparing the variance of the primary endpoint between arms through the outcome variance ratio (treated to control group). 
 Results : The review provided 208 articles with enough information to conduct the analysis. One out of five studies (n = 40, 19.2%) had statistically different variances between groups, implying a non-constant-effect. The adjusted point estimate of the mean outcome variance ratio (treated to control group) is 0.89 (95% CI 0.81 to 0.97). 
 Conclusions : The mean variance ratio is significantly lower than 1 and the lower variance was found more often in the intervention group than in the control group, suggesting it is more usual for treated patients to be stable. This observed reduction in variance might also imply that there could be a subgroup of less ill patients who derive no benefit from treatment. This would require further study as to whether the treatment effect outweighs the side effects as well as the economic costs. We have shown that there are ways to analyze the apparently unobservable constant effect.
review_content:
The authors have performed a review of a sample of clinical trials conducted every three years from 2004-2013 to examine whether there exists post-treatment heterogeneity in participants responses with premise that lack of heterogeneity suggests that precision medicine is not warranted.

While the question is one that should be asked. However, the study carried out is not suited to answering the question as it has been conducted in randomized trials where there is typically little heterogeneity. That is, the authors have performed a perfectly reasonable analysis that cannot answer the pertinent question. It is well known that randomized trials tend to be populated by homogenous population (more white, more male, etc.) – see, for example Oh et al. (2015) Diversity in Clinical and Biomedical Research: A Promise Yet to Be Fulfilled. PLoS Med 12(12): e1001918, Caplan & Friesen P (2017) Health disparities and clinical trial recruitment: Is there a duty to tweet? PLoS Biol 15(3): e2002040 and the references therein – or indeed many other papers on this topic. This may be in part a function of recruitment strategies and also by design, as trialists (particularly those testing new therapies) often determine inclusion criteria to target the (potentially homogeneous) segment of the population who might show the greatest response to the treatment. Thus, the authors have chosen to study a population that is likely to be homogeneous and not reflective of real-world clinical care. There are numerous examples covariate-tailored treatment algorithms, from the choice of hormonal therapies for women diagnosed with estrogen-receptor-positive, HER2-negative breast cancer to the choice of ACE inhibitors vs. calcium channel blockers for hypertension, that the authors choose to overlook as cases where we have learned about previous patients with particular characteristics to learn about future similar patients.
paper_title_zh: 证据是否支持对精准医疗的高度期望？——文献综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：精准医学是针对患者个体特征量身定制的干预措施的“圣杯”。然而，传统的临床试验旨在寻找平均差异，而这些差异的解释依赖于无法验证的假设。尽管只是一个理想状态，但治疗效果的恒定将有助于个体管理。恒定效果的一个直接后果是，治疗组和对照组的结局测量方差相同。我们回顾了文献，探讨这些方差的相似性，作为检验精准医学是否以及多常被明确需要的基石。

方法：我们回顾了2004年、2007年、2010年和2013年发表的具有数值主要终点的平行临床试验。我们收集了主要结局指标的基线和最终标准差。通过比较治疗组与对照组主要终点之间的方差（结局方差比）来评估同方差性。

结果：回顾提供了208篇包含足够信息进行分析的文章。五分之一的研究（n = 40，19.2%）在组间具有统计学上不同的方差，意味着非恒定效果。调整后的平均结局方差比（治疗组与对照组）的点估计为0.89（95% CI 0.81至0.97）。

结论：平均方差比显著低于1，且干预组比对照组更常出现较低方差，这表明治疗患者的稳定性更为常见。观察到的方差减少可能还意味着存在一个病情较轻的患者亚组，他们从治疗中获益不大。这需要进一步研究，以确定治疗效果是否超过副作用和经济成本。我们已经证明，有方法可以分析看似不可观察的恒定效果。
review_content_zh:
作者对2004年至2013年每三年进行一次的临床试验样本进行了回顾，以考察参与者治疗后是否存在反应异质性，其前提是缺乏异质性表明精准医学没有必要。

尽管这个问题是应该提出的，然而，所进行的研究并不适合回答这个问题，因为它是在随机试验中进行的，而随机试验中通常异质性很小。也就是说，作者进行了一个完全合理的分析，但无法回答相关的问题。众所周知，随机试验往往由同质人群组成（更多白人、更多男性等）——例如，参见Oh等人（2015）的《临床和生物医学研究中的多样性：一个尚未实现的承诺》。PLoS Med 12(12): e1001918，Caplan & Friesen P（2017）的《健康差异和临床试验招募：是否有责任发推？》。PLoS Biol 15(3): e2002040及其中的参考文献——或者 indeed 许多其他关于这一主题的论文。这在一定程度上可能是招募策略和设计的结果，因为试验者（尤其是那些测试新疗法的人）通常确定纳入标准，以针对可能对治疗反应最大的（潜在同质的）人群部分。因此，作者选择研究的群体可能是同质的，并不能反映现实世界的临床护理。有许多协变量定制治疗算法的例子，从选择激素疗法用于诊断为雌激素受体阳性、HER2阴性乳腺癌的女性，到选择ACE抑制剂与钙通道阻滞剂用于高血压的治疗，作者选择忽略这些案例，即我们通过了解具有特定特征的既往患者来了解未来类似患者的情况。

reasons: It is well known that randomized trials tend to be populated by homogenous population (more white, more male, etc.) – see, for example Oh et al. (2015) Diversity in Clinical and Biomedical Research: A Promise Yet to Be Fulfilled.

There are numerous examples covariate-tailored treatment algorithms, from the choice of hormonal therapies for women diagnosed with estrogen-receptor-positive, HER2-negative breast cancer to the choice of ACE inhibitors vs. calcium channel blockers for hypertension, that the authors choose to overlook as cases where we have learned about previous patients with particular characteristics to learn about future similar patients.

PLoS Med 12(12): e1001918, Caplan & Friesen P (2017) Health disparities and clinical trial recruitment: Is there a duty to tweet? PLoS Biol 15(3): e2002040 and the references therein – or indeed many other papers on this topic.
Also, the writing is fairly poor, which is surprising, since Dr. Senn is one of the best writers I have ever had the pleasure of reading.
The methods involve only variability, yet the conclusions are about precision medicine.
It is not entirely clear what the one has to do with the other.

paper_title: Elder abuse in Saudi Arabia: A systematic review
review_content:
The manuscript does a meta-analysis of the mention of elder abuse in Saudi Arabia. I think the argument would be better accompanied by an introduction literature review to set up the Saudi culture for readers who may be unfamiliar. What aspects of that society might be related to the experience of abuse, neglect or exploitation among those in the elder adult generation?

The limitation of using just one database PubMed was not explained. Rather than explain it, why not use them to search for articles from Saudi Arabia and see if any others can be discovered?

A major message for this research would be to encourage further research to study elder mistreatment in this target Arab country. We need a proper lead up to why we should be concerned, or what protective factors might exist. We should be aware that societal prohibitions related to sexual expression in general, might lead elders to under report sexual assaults, etc. Perhaps oppression based on gender might lead to isolation of elders, particularly the women. Women may be the designated caregivers for sick elders. What happens if a family does not have daughters-in law or female offspring?
But by far, the biggest issue is the paucity of research about later life experiences in this country.
paper_title_zh: 沙特阿拉伯老年人虐待：系统综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：老年人虐待是一个全球性的常见问题，且绝对是可预防的。应对老年人虐待的第一步是通过研究其发生率并承认其为一个普遍问题。然而，在沙特阿拉伯，关于老年人虐待的研究较为缺乏。在这篇综述中，我们探讨了沙特阿拉伯老年人虐待的社会-法医问题。

方法：系统检索了PubMed数据库中从建库至2022年7月1日关于沙特阿拉伯老年人虐待的文章。检索词包括“elder abuse”、“elderly abuse”、“geriatric abuse”、“aged abuse”、“senior abuse”和“elder maltreatment”。此外，为了检出沙特阿拉伯的报告研究，还加入了以下检索词：“Saudi Arabia”、“KSA”和“Kingdom of Saudi Arabia”。对检索结果进行筛选，纳入了沙特阿拉伯关于老年人虐待的研究，排除了其他国家的研究以及针对其他年龄组虐待的研究。

结果：发现收容所中极高比例的老年人曾遭受虐待，尤其是心理虐待，这导致了一系列心理健康问题，如焦虑、抑郁和睡眠障碍。报告显示，对老年人虐待的高意识水平以及对老年人的高度责任感。

结论：鉴于老年人在沙特阿拉伯人口中占较大比例，且社区高度以家庭为中心，建议增加针对全国范围内老年人虐待的研究力度，并制定有效的国家项目，以确保在沙特阿拉伯预防老年人虐待。
review_content_zh:
该手稿对沙特阿拉伯提及老年人虐待的文献进行了元分析。我认为，如果能辅以一篇介绍性文献综述，为不熟悉沙特文化的读者设定背景，论证将更为有力。该社会的哪些方面可能与老年一代遭受虐待、忽视或剥削的经历相关？

仅使用PubMed一个数据库的限制并未得到解释。与其解释这一点，为何不利用它来搜索来自沙特阿拉伯的文章，看看是否还能发现其他相关文献？

这项研究的主要信息应是鼓励进一步研究这一目标阿拉伯国家的老年人受虐问题。我们需要一个恰当的引言，说明为何应关注这一问题，或可能存在的保护因素。我们应意识到，与性表达相关的社会禁忌可能使老年人低报性侵犯等事件。基于性别的压迫可能使老年人，尤其是女性老年人，陷入孤立。女性可能是病弱老年人的指定照顾者。如果一个家庭没有儿媳或女性后代，会发生什么情况？
但迄今为止，最大的问题是该国关于晚年生活经历的研究极为匮乏。

reasons: I think the argument would be better accompanied by an introduction literature review to set up the Saudi culture for readers who may be unfamiliar.
What aspects of that society might be related to the experience of abuse, neglect or exploitation among those in the elder adult generation?
The limitation of using just one database PubMed was not explained.
Rather than explain it, why not use them to search for articles from Saudi Arabia and see if any others can be discovered?

paper_title: Is butyrate a natural alternative to dexamethasone in the management of CoVID-19?
paper_abstract: Coronavirus disease 2019 (CoVID-19) caused by Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus 2 has affected more than 100 million lives. Severe CoVID-19 infection may lead to acute respiratory distress syndrome and death of the patient, and is associated with hyperinflammation and cytokine storm. The broad spectrum immunosuppressant corticosteroid, dexamethasone, is being used to manage the cytokine storm and hyperinflammation in CoVID-19 patients. However, the extensive use of corticosteroids leads to serious adverse events and disruption of the gut-lung axis. Various micronutrients and probiotic supplementations are known to aid in the reduction of hyperinflammation and restoration of gut microbiota. The attenuation of the deleterious immune response and hyperinflammation could be mediated by short chain fatty acids produced by the gut microbiota. Butyric acid, the most extensively studied short chain fatty acid, is known for its anti-inflammatory properties. Additionally, butyric acid has been shown to ameliorate hyperinflammation and reduce oxidative stress in various pathologies, including respiratory viral infections. In this review, the potential anti-inflammatory effects of butyric acid that aid in cytokine storm depletion, and its usefulness in effective management of critical illness related to CoVID-19 have been discussed.
review_content:
The review article by Nithin et al. discusses whether butyrate can be a natural alternative to dexamethasone in the management of COVID-19. The manuscript is well written and with a clear explanation of purpose. The authors illustrate divergent signaling pathways associated with the pathophysiology of COVID-19. They also point out the issues that dexamethasone has and why butyrate can be an alternative. Listed below are some of my concerns:
 1. The authors mention many benefits of butyrate in this review. I suggest the authors should also mention whether there are any side effects of butyrate in specific groups, such as pregnant women and those with underlying conditions. Such a description would enable a more comprehensive assessment of this compound.
 2. The authors provided a schematic of pro-inflammatory intracellular signaling pathways and in same schematic describe the mechanism of action of butyrate. There are many signaling pathways in this schematic and readers are easy to get confused. I suggest the authors simplify the schematic or separate it into two different schematics, one for butyrate regulation and another one for the regulation of pro-inflammatory mediators.
paper_title_zh: 丁酸是否为治疗COVID-19的天然替代品？
paper_abstract_zh: 2019冠状病毒病（CoVID-19）由严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2引起，已影响超过1亿人的生活。严重的CoVID-19感染可能导致急性呼吸窘迫综合征和患者死亡，并与超炎症和细胞因子风暴相关。广谱免疫抑制剂皮质类固醇，地塞米松，正被用于管理CoVID-19患者的细胞因子风暴和超炎症。然而，皮质类固醇的广泛使用会导致严重的不良事件和肠道-肺轴的破坏。已知各种微量营养素和益生菌补充剂有助于减少超炎症和恢复肠道微生物群。由肠道微生物群产生的短链脂肪酸可能介导有害免疫反应和超炎症的减弱。丁酸是研究最为广泛的短链脂肪酸，以其抗炎特性而闻名。此外，丁酸已被证明可以改善多种病理学中的超炎症并减少氧化应激，包括呼吸道病毒感染。在这篇综述中，讨论了丁酸在耗尽细胞因子风暴中的潜在抗炎作用，以及其在有效管理与CoVID-19相关的危重病中的有用性。
review_content_zh:
Nithin等人撰写的综述文章讨论了丁酸盐是否可以作为治疗COVID-19的天然替代品，以取代地塞米松。该手稿撰写质量高，目的阐述清晰。作者们阐述了与COVID-19病理生理学相关的不同信号通路。他们还指出了地塞米松存在的问题以及为何丁酸盐可以成为替代品。以下是我的一些担忧：
1. 作者在综述中提到了丁酸盐的许多益处。我建议作者也应提及丁酸盐在特定群体（如孕妇和有基础疾病者）中是否存在任何副作用。这样的描述将有助于对该化合物进行更全面的评估。
2. 作者提供了一个促炎细胞内信号通路的示意图，并在同一示意图中描述了丁酸盐的作用机制。该示意图中包含许多信号通路，读者容易混淆。我建议作者简化该示意图，或将其分为两个不同的示意图，一个用于丁酸盐调控，另一个用于促炎介质的调控。

reasons: There are several new publications that discuss the role of butyrate in COVID-19 pathogenesis which could be added to make this a comprehensive review like J Li et al. (2021)1; Sarkar, P et al. (2020)2; Wang L et al. (2017)3.
There are many signaling pathways in this schematic and readers are easy to get confused.
I suggest the authors simplify the schematic or separate it into two different schematics, one for butyrate regulation and another one for the regulation of pro-inflammatory mediators.
The manuscript is well written and with a clear explanation of purpose.
Future prospective at end would certainly increase the quality of the manuscript.
Authors mentioned the usefulness of probiotics in management of tissue inflammation, some more clear idea on mechanism to mitigate the inflammation, particularly the viral load is demanded.
Chemistry of butyrate and dexamethasone and its structure activity relationship in preventing the cytokine storm is necessary.

paper_title: Potential applications of personality assessments to the management of non-human primates: A review of 10 years of study
paper_abstract: Studies of primate personality have become increasingly common over the past three decades. Recently, studies have begun to focus on the health, welfare and conservation implications of personality, and the potential applications of incorporating quantitative personality assessments into animal management programmes. However, this literature is disparate and dispersed across a multitude of settings and scientific disciplines. We conducted a review of nonhuman primate personality studies relevant to these issues published since 2010. The databases ScienceDirect, PubMed and Web of Science were used to identify relevant articles. After eliminating irrelevant or duplicate papers, 68 studies were selected. Our review reveals that, while primate personality research is carried out on a range of species, there is strong taxonomic bias. While 28 species appeared within the reviewed literature, 51% of studies were carried out on just five species. Further, the most common research focus (43%) was validating new assessment methods or describing personality in different species, rather than exploring the links between personality and animal welfare using existing validated methods. However, among the remaining studies that did explore the role of animal personality in husbandry, health, and welfare, we identified increased progression towards integrating personality data into various aspects of animal management. Evidence suggests the assessment of personality may benefit social group management, enrichment practices, training protocols, health and welfare monitoring, and conservation planning for endangered species. We argue that further research which develops our understanding of primate personality and its influence in these areas will provide a valuable tool to inform existing animal management practices.
review_content: Reviewer 2 The review seems to have missed some papers, which I thought should be there […] I suspect there are other papers, but I will leave the task of finding them to the authors, unless, of course, these and the other papers were omitted for reasons that were not made clear (to me). RESPONSE: Having repeated the literature search process, a number of papers were indeed missed. These papers have now been incorporated into the review accordingly, increasing the number of papers from 58 to 68. It may however be that some papers were excluded due to focusing largely on the evolution of personality, which was a slightly difficult area to navigate as some studies in the method validation category did indeed discuss evolutionary and genetic components of personality but were included due to their practical implications (i.e. studies which compared behaviour and trait rating methods as well as evolutionary aspects). In lines 170-171, the authors cite King and Figueredo as the originators of the Hominoid Personality Questionnaire (the HPQ). The HPQ is based on the questionnaire used in their 1997 paper (the Chimpanzee Personality Questionnaire) in that it is an extension of this questionnaire. RESPONSE: Apologies, this has now been remedied. LL192 – 193 now includes the correct reference. In lines 266-272, and perhaps further, the authors refer to sociability. Here the writing would lead a reader to believe that sociability is the same as extraversion. This blurs some distinctions that have been noted, both in the key papers, but also in a review of the field by Weiss (2017, J Pers. https://doi.org/10.1111/jopy.12310. Specifically, depending on the species, a single factor (sociability) loads on social traits or two factors comparable to the Big Five factors of extraversion and agreeableness load on these traits, although bonobos (see the 2015 paper cited above) show a different configuration. I don't think the authors need to get into the nitty gritty of it all, so they could simply refer to personality factors associated with social traits, and then just name the different factors when citing the relevant studies. paper_title_zh: 人格评估在非人类灵长类动物管理中的潜在应用：十年研究综述
paper_abstract_zh: 灵长类动物个性研究在过去三十年中变得越来越普遍。近年来，研究开始关注个性的健康、福利和保育意义，以及将定量个性评估纳入动物管理计划的潜在应用。然而，这一文献分散且跨越了多种环境和科学学科。我们对自2010年以来发表的与这些问题相关的非人类灵长类动物个性研究进行了综述。使用ScienceDirect、PubMed和Web of Science数据库识别相关文章。在排除无关或重复的论文后，共选取了68项研究。我们的综述显示，尽管灵长类动物个性研究涉及多种物种，但存在强烈的分类学偏见。尽管有28种物种出现在综述文献中，但51%的研究仅针对五种物种进行。此外，最常见的 research focus (43%) 是验证新的评估方法或描述不同物种的个性，而不是使用现有验证方法探索个性与动物福利之间的联系。然而，在剩余的探讨动物个性在饲养、健康和福利中作用的研究中，我们发现将个性数据整合到动物管理的各个方面中的进展有所增加。证据表明，个性评估可能有利于社会群体管理、丰富实践、训练协议、健康和福利监测，以及濒危物种的保育规划。我们认为，进一步研究灵长类动物个性及其在这些领域的影响，将为现有的动物管理实践提供宝贵的工具。
review_content_zh: 审稿人2：该综述似乎遗漏了一些论文，我认为这些论文应该被包含在内[…]我怀疑还有其他论文，但除非这些和其他论文的遗漏有未明确说明的原因（对我来说），否则我将把寻找这些论文的任务留给作者。回应：经过重复文献检索过程，确实遗漏了一些论文。这些论文现在已相应地被纳入综述中，使论文数量从58篇增加到68篇。然而，可能有一些论文因为主要关注人格的演变而被排除，这是一个稍微难以界定的领域，因为方法验证类别中的一些研究确实讨论了人格的进化和遗传成分，但由于其实际应用（即比较行为和特质评分方法以及进化方面）而被纳入。在第170-171行，作者引用King和Figueredo作为类人猿人格问卷（HPQ）的创始人。HPQ基于他们在1997年论文（黑猩猩人格问卷）中使用的问卷，是该问卷的扩展。回应：抱歉，现已更正。LL192-193现在包含了正确的参考文献。在第266-272行，或许还有其他地方，作者提到了社交性。这里的写作会让读者认为社交性与外向性相同。这模糊了一些在关键论文中以及Weiss（2017, J Pers. https://doi.org/10.1111/jopy.12310）对这一领域的综述中已经注意到的区别。具体来说，根据物种的不同，单一因素（社交性）要么负载于社交特质上，要么两个与五大人格因素中的外向性和宜人性相当的因素负载于这些特质上，尽管倭黑猩猩（参见上述2015年论文）显示出不同的配置。我认为作者不需要深入探讨所有细节，因此他们可以简单地提及与社交特质相关的人格因素，然后在引用相关研究时命名不同的因素。回应：感谢这一澄清。我们已按建议重新措辞以避免混淆（LL308-312）。在第374行，作者提到了“方面”，但不清除他们指的是什么。他们是指所谓的因素、领域、维度，例如人类的外向性或其他五大维度之一，还是指较低层次的构念，例如五大人格中的每个方面的“热情”方面或外向性？无论情况如何，作者在此需要保持术语的一致性，或许可以简要定义任何新术语。回应：‘方面’已被替换为‘维度’以保持清晰和一致性。所有其他同义词的引用也已替换为‘维度’，现已在LL56-58中定义。在摘要中，我认为我会删除“广泛”，这是真的，但文本的其他部分已经暗示了这一点。事实上，尽可能多地省略*ly词汇是个好主意。回应：按建议更改。我一直认为“非人类”不应加连字符，因为它不是一个复合词。回应：按建议更改。第42行，我会省略“它被”。回应：按建议更改。第44行，“整合”改为“整合中”。回应：按建议更改，L43。第47行，此处及他处作者使用了因果语言（“预测”），这在研究不是真正的实验时是个问题。我会更谦虚，使用“相关”和“关联”等术语。回应：按建议更改。第55行，作者需要指出这些测量是可靠和经过验证的。在此，我认为作者应该提供来自心理测量学和构念效度文献的定义。1955年Cronbach和Meehl的论文（https://doi.org/10.1037/h0040957）和1959年Campbell和Fiske的论文（https://doi.org/10.1037/h0046016）很好地定义了效度，但许多教科书处理也会很好。可靠性也已被广泛讨论。回应：谢谢，按建议添加。两个术语的定义已包含在引言中（LL60-66）。第58行，我会省略“现有的”。回应：按建议更改，L67。第59行：此处需要“动物”一词吗？回应：按建议更改，L68。第64行：此处“验证”一词有必要吗？回应：按建议更改，L72-73。第82行：我认为“众多”一词是多余的，可以省略。回应：按建议更改，L95。第92行：考虑省略此行。回应：按建议更改，L106。第97行：我会省略“然后”一词。回应：按建议更改，L111。第106行：我会将“具有普遍性”改为“泛化”。此处，一个定义也会很好。回应：按建议更改。‘泛化’一词现已在引言中定义，并添加了关于泛化挑战和复杂性的参考文献（LL87-89）。第149行：我会省略“不同”一词。回应：按建议更改，L165。第173-174行：我会修订文本，使其读作“……每个都有其优缺点”和“我们已概述”。回应：按建议更改，L193。第189行：如果作者能在此处引用一个例子，那也很好。回应：按建议更改，L210-211。第214-216行：此处一些例子会有所帮助。回应：按建议更改，L235-237。第217行：我认为此处可以有一个更好的过渡句。回应：我已调整段落，希望此处有更好的过渡，LL240-242。第241行：请引用提出这一观点的人。回应：按建议更改。引用了Coleman（2012），LL264-266。第250行：我不会提及“类型”，因为人格特质、因素等最好被视为连续体。因此，提及“在……方面较高或较低的个体”。回应：按建议更改，LL273-274。第254行：考虑人类文献显示的内容是否值得？换句话说，这是未来工作的一个有前途的方向吗？回应：LL260-274现在简要纳入了人类文献关于人格和攻击性行为的发现，及其对灵长类动物管理的可能影响。第298-299行：我会在此处及全文使用主动语态。回应：按建议更改。第306行：我会重写这句话，去掉“采取整体方法，即”文本。回应：按建议更改，LL340-342。第326-330行：请缩短或拆分这句话。回应：按建议更改，LL361-364。第334行：我会将其改写为“害羞-大胆连续体”。回应：按建议更改，LL369。第337行：在此，我会力求在使用的标签上保持一致。所以如果之前提到了“害羞-大胆”，就继续使用这个标签。回应：按建议更改，LL371。第351行：作者具体指的是什么“深入”？也就是说，哪些方面需要更深入地研究？回应：重新措辞并在LL387-390中扩展。第358行：我会改写为“自愿参与”。回应：按建议更改，L394。第488-494行：我认为这一部分可以引用一些关于可遗传人格变异是常态的事实，并提供一些机制，这些机制可能在野生种群中支持这一点。这对于重新引入计划和繁殖等将是关键。回应：引用了人格遗传性（LL526-529）。第496行：我认为“一些”一词可能可以删除。回应：按建议更改，L535。第538-539行：为了清晰起见，最好将这类事情表述为“从某事‘转向’某事”。回应：按建议更改，LL620-624。

paper_title: Coagulase-negative staphylococci as an evolving mastitis causing organism in cows: A review
paper_abstract: The present review attempts to address the emergence of a fast-growing mastitis causing pathogen – coagulase-negative staphylococci (CNS) – and its multi-facet roles in dairy farms. CNS is divided into numerous species, but only a few succeed in bovine mastitis. The two predominant CNS species causing mastitis are Staphylococcus chromogenes and Staphylococcus simulans . These two mostly known CNS affects dairy cows at varied parities and at different lactation stages. CNS have been judged to be the most common bovine mastitis isolate in several countries of the world. However, CNS may not likely be as pathogenic as the other primary mastitis pathogens such as Staphylococcus aureus and its infection mostly remains subclinical. Conversely, CNS is capable of triggering persistent infections among dairy herds, resulting in reduced milk quality and high milk somatic cell count (SCC). One negative impact of CNS infection in dairy herds is that it can destroy cow udder tissue, hereby leading to a drop in milk production of dairy cows. CNS mastitis has a high cure rate when treated with anti-biotics as their infection in cows are not known to be a therapeutic problem. Judging from several literatures, it cannot be said whether CNS species act as an ecological or contagious pathogens. Regulator procedures, including pre- and post-milking teat disinfection, may reduce contagious mastitis pathogens of CNS infections in the dairy herd. Phenotypic methods for identification of CNS are not adequately dependable, and molecular techniques of identification may be better substitute for identification. Dairy farmers may benefit greatly from more empirical research on the epidemiology of CNS mastitis and more reliable methods for species identification.
review_content: This is a review article on CNS that seems to have been quite complete at the time it was written, but unfortunately it is not updated. The article cites good references, but the vast majority of them are from 10 or more years ago. Since then, many changes have occurred, both in terms of CNS identification, such as the advent of Maldi-Tof mass spectrometry, and in the protocols for treating livestock with antimicrobials, due to the current great concern with antimicrobial resistance in humans, animals and the environment.
paper_title_zh: 凝固酶阴性葡萄球菌作为奶牛乳腺炎致病菌的演变：综述
paper_abstract_zh: 本综述旨在探讨一种快速增长的乳腺炎致病菌——凝固酶阴性葡萄球菌（CNS）的出现及其在奶牛场中的多方面作用。CNS分为多种物种，但仅有少数能在牛乳腺炎中成功定殖。导致乳腺炎的两个主要CNS物种是产色葡萄球菌和模拟葡萄球菌。这两种广为人知的CNS在不同胎次和不同泌乳阶段的奶牛中均有影响。CNS已被判定为世界上多个国家最常见的牛乳腺炎分离株。然而，CNS可能不如其他主要乳腺炎致病菌（如金黄色葡萄球菌）那样具有致病性，其感染大多呈亚临床状态。相反，CNS能够引发奶牛群中的持续性感染，导致牛奶质量下降和体细胞计数（SCC）升高。CNS感染对奶牛群的负面影响之一是它能破坏奶牛的乳腺组织，从而导致奶牛产奶量下降。使用抗生素治疗CNS乳腺炎时，治愈率较高，因为其在奶牛中的感染并未被视为治疗难题。从多篇文献来看，尚不能确定CNS物种是作为生态性还是接触性致病菌。包括预挤奶和后挤奶乳头消毒在内的监管措施，可能减少奶牛群中CNS感染的接触性乳腺炎致病菌。用于鉴定CNS的表型方法不够可靠，分子鉴定技术可能是更好的替代方法。奶牛养殖者可能从更多关于CNS乳腺炎流行病学的实证研究以及更可靠的物种鉴定方法中获益匪浅。
review_content_zh: 这是一篇关于中枢神经系统（CNS）的综述文章，撰写时似乎相当全面，但遗憾的是未进行更新。文章引用了良好的参考文献，但其中绝大多数是10年或更早以前的。自那时以来，无论是在CNS鉴定方面，如基质辅助激光解吸电离飞行时间质谱（Maldi-Tof mass spectrometry）的出现，还是在因当前对人类、动物和环境中的抗菌药物耐药性的巨大关注而导致的用于治疗牲畜的抗菌药物协议方面，都发生了许多变化。

paper_title: Exploring the anti-inflammatory activities, mechanism of action and prospective drug delivery systems of tocotrienol to target neurodegenerative diseases
paper_abstract: A major cause of death in the elderly worldwide is attributed to neurodegenerative diseases, such as AD (Alzheimer’s disease), PD (Parkinson’s disease), ALS (Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis), FRDA (Friedreich’s ataxia), VaD (Vascular dementia) etc. These can be caused due to multiple factors such as genetic, physiological problems like stroke or tumor, or even external causes like viruses, toxins, or chemicals. T3s (tocotrienols) exhibit various bioactive properties where it acts as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, anti-tumorigenic, and cholesterol lowering agent. Since T3 interferes with and influences several anti-inflammatory mechanisms, it aids in combating inflammatory responses that lead to disease progression. T3s are found to have a profound neuroprotective ability, however, due to their poor oral bioavailability, their full potential could not be exploited. Hence there is a need to explore other drug delivery techniques, especially focusing on aspects of nanotechnology. In this review paper we explore the anti-inflammatory mechanisms of T3 to apply it in the treatment of neurodegenerative diseases and also discusses the possibilities of nano methods of administering tocotrienols to target neurodegenerative diseases.
review_content:
The article, "Exploring the anti-inflammatory activities, mechanism of action and prospective drug delivery systems of tocotrienol to target neurodegenerative diseases" is well-written. The paper is an important addition to the literature.
They can further read various articles on neurodegenerative disorders in recent years relevant to drug delivery.
There are a few grammatical mistakes in the manuscript, could you correct these errors for clarity of content?
More examples need to be incorporated in the manuscript in various delivery systems.
It can be indexed after minor revision.
paper_title_zh: 探索生育三烯酚的抗炎活性、作用机制及其针对神经退行性疾病的潜在药物递送系统
paper_abstract_zh: 全球范围内老年人死亡的主要原因之一是神经退行性疾病，如阿尔茨海默病（AD）、帕金森病（PD）、肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）、弗里德reich共济失调（FRDA）、血管性痴呆（VaD）等。这些疾病可由多种因素引起，如遗传因素、生理问题如中风或肿瘤，甚至外部原因如病毒、毒素或化学物质。生育三烯酚（T3s）具有多种生物活性，包括抗氧化、抗炎、抗肿瘤和降胆固醇作用。由于T3干扰并影响多种抗炎机制，它有助于对抗导致疾病进展的炎症反应。研究发现T3s具有显著的神经保护能力，然而，由于其口服生物利用度低，其全部潜力未能得到充分利用。因此，有必要探索其他药物递送技术，特别是关注纳米技术方面。在这篇综述中，我们探讨了T3的抗炎机制，以应用于神经退行性疾病的 treatment，并讨论了利用纳米方法给药生育三烯酚以靶向治疗神经退行性疾病的可能性。

paper_title: Patient-centered care interventions to reduce the inappropriate prescription and use of benzodiazepines and zdrugs: a systematic review
paper_abstract: Background: Benzodiazepines (BZDs) and z-drugs are effective drugs, but they are prescribed excessively worldwide. Guidelines recommend a maximum treatment duration of eight weeks. Although these drugs are effective in the short term, long-term BZD therapy is associated with considerable adverse effects, the development of tolerance, and, finally, addiction. However, there are different interventions in terms of patientcentered care that aim to reduce the use of BZDs and z-drugs as well as assist health care professionals (HCPs) to prevent the inappropriate prescription of BZDs. Aim: The aim of this systematic review was to identify interventions that promote patient-centered treatments for inappropriate BZD and z-drug use as well as analyze the effectiveness of these interventions in reducing the inappropriate use of these drugs. Methods: To identify relevant studies, the PubMed, EMBASE, PsycInfo, Psyndex and Cochrane Library databases were searched. Studies with controlled designs focusing on adult patients were included. Trials with chronically or mentally ill patients were excluded if long-term BZD and z-drug use was indicated. Study extraction was performed based on the Cochrane Form for study extraction. To assess the quality of the studies, we used a tool based on the Cochrane Collaboration's tool for assessing the risk of bias in randomized trials. Results: We identified 7 068 studies and selected 20 for systematic review. Nine interventions focused on patients, nine on HCPs, and two on both patients and HCPs. Intervention types ranged from simple to multifaceted. Patient-centered interventions that provided patient information effectively increased the appropriate use of BZDs. The educational approaches for HCPs that aimed to achieve appropriate prescription reported inconsistent results. The methods that combined informing patients and HCPs led to a significant reduction in BZD use. Conclusions: This is the first review of studies focused on patient-centered
review_content: Reviewer 1 (Anonymous) Basic reporting This paper is a well structured and quality submission. The authors have taken a lot of time and effort preparing it. There are some aspects, however, that require clarification and addressing. 1. The non-English background of the authors is obvious with non-current terms used in some sections. E.g in abstract line 33 ‘side effect’ as opposed to ‘adverse effect’. In the introduction line 58 the word ‘tranquilizers’ is not in common use. May I suggest the use of the term ‘anxiolytic’ or ‘anxiolytic/hypnotics’ as an alternate. ‘Time horizon’, line 274, in the results section is also a term that is not in common use. In the discussion section, the word ‘inadequate’ line 333, should be replaced with ‘inappropriate’. The term ‘inadequate’ needs to be replaced by ‘inappropriate’ throughout the text. It’s used again in line 360 of the discussion. The use of the term ‘elderly’ is not current any more (line 378) and needs to be replaced with ‘older’. Thank you very much for carefully reading the text. We have changed the terms according to your recommendations. 2. Some of the background information about benzodiazepines and z-drugs is not correct and needs to be corrected. In the abstract it is stated (line 32) that long-term therapy is associated with considerable side effects. It needs to be stressed that short-term therapy is also associated with considerable side effects, including falls, language impairment, confusion, cognitive impairment and ataxia. The statement regarding risks being associated with long-term use only is also made in line 62 - intro. A statement regarding tolerance to the effects of benzodiazepines is needed in this section. Thank you for these valuable comments. We amended the text accordingly. See lines: 69-73. There is also a line saying that z-drugs have similar pharmacological effects (Intro - line 61) to benzodiazepines. This is not true. Z-drugs have a different GABA receptor binding site and do not possess anxiolytic properties - so this statement is not correct. We removed this statement. See line: 68. 3. The results section needs review as parts are not relevant, specific outcomes are not mentioned and some statements are unclear. We have specified the result section (for example, clear description of the sample size or explicit presentation of the results). See lines: 175-344. 4. Table 2 is separately labelled ‘Table 1’ on its header page. We have changed the number accordingly. 5. Finally, the referencing of journal names is inconsistent. Abbreviated versions are used alongside fully spelt non-abbreviated namings. Capital letters are also missing when Journal names are fully listed. A good edit for the correct style is needed. Thank you very much for your suggestions, we have checked and corrected the references part carefully. Experimental design The methodology of the review is a strength and well described in sufficient detail. The research question is well defined, relevant and meaningful. However, 1. In the methods section there is no inclusion of the search term ‘hypnot*’ (hypnotics) which is odd and may have resulted in some papers being missed. Sorry for the mistake, we actually used the term ‘hypnot*’ in our search syntax, but oversaw to include it in the text. We corrected the search term list accordingly. See line: 136. 2. In the eligibility part of the methods line 121 it states that studies were excluded if they focused on BZD use for mentally ill patients (e.g. psychiatric diagnoses such as panic disorder or schizophrenia). This needs to be re-defined. Surely generalised anxiety disorder or sleep disturbance are psychiatric diagnoses as per the DSM-6 – In this case all studies would have to be excluded. Do the authors mean serious psychiatric disorders? Panic disorder would be a common diagnosis in older adults. You are right, we excluded studies focusing on serious psychiatric disorders. Anxiety disorder (and symptoms; also panic disorder) as well as sleep disorder were indeed included in the analysis. We have changed the text. See lines: 144-149. Validity of the findings The validity is good and table data consistent with the studies. Interpretation is good. the conclusion links well to the introduction. Just a few points: 1. In the results section the authors confuse matters when they include antipsychotics in the discussion of the intervention results. E.g. Line 272 provides an example of this. “Meader et al investigated if an intervention could change the intake rate of antipsychotics…they found a reduction in antipsychotic dose (including BZD).“ It is not clear what the author means here and I question why the inclusion of antipsychotics in this results section is relevant to this paper? Thank you very much for this valuable comment. You are right, the main question dealt with antipsychotic drugs. BZD was only incidentally considered in this study. We therefore decided to omit this paper. The results section was changed accordingly. 2. When the interventions are discussed it would be clearer if the subject matter was confined to benzodiazepine use and the resulting outcome of the intervention. E.g. In the results section line 292, more detail is needed about the size of the decrease in drug use and whether the ‘drug use’ referred to was actually benzodiazepine use. In line 307 for this study there is no specific mention of benzodiazepines at all. We have specified and changed the description. See lines: 303-310; 317-321. 3. More detail and clarification is needed with line 310 which is the last sentence starting with 'Compared with a control group….' We have specified and changed the results: See lines: 321-326. 4. Line 292, Smith is Alysia (i.e. female) so ‘his’ should be ‘her’. The information provided here in this discussion part stating that there was no effect of the intervention directly contradicts the information provided on Table 2 which reports a significant reduction in BZD use. Which outcome is it? Please make this clear. Thank you! We have clarified and changed this part: see line: 310-315. (we have changed the information in table 2). Comments for the Author A good proof reading by a native English speaker would assist this submission. The discussion section should also concentrate on the subject matter at hand and summarise the outcomes. The review was corrected by the AJE. (Please see certificate). We have restructured the discussion part and tried focused on the approach of patient-centered care.
paper_title_zh: 以患者为中心的干预措施减少苯二氮卓类药物和Z类药物的不当处方和使用：系统综述
paper_abstract_zh: 背景：苯二氮卓类药物（BZDs）和z类药物是有效的药物，但全球范围内存在过度处方现象。指南建议最大治疗时长为八周。尽管这些药物在短期内有效，但长期使用BZD治疗与显著的不良反应、耐受性的发展以及最终成瘾相关。然而，存在不同的以患者为中心的干预措施，旨在减少BZDs和z类药物的使用，并协助医疗保健专业人员（HCPs）预防BZDs的不当处方。目的：本系统综述的目的是识别促进针对不当BZD和z类药物使用的以患者为中心的治疗干预措施，并分析这些干预措施在减少这些药物不当使用方面的有效性。方法：为识别相关研究，检索了PubMed、EMBASE、PsycInfo、Psyndex和Cochrane Library数据库。纳入具有对照设计且关注成年患者的研究。排除长期使用BZD和z类药物指征的慢性或精神疾病患者的试验。研究提取基于Cochrane研究提取表进行。为评估研究的质量，我们使用了基于Cochrane协作网评估随机试验偏倚风险的工具。结果：我们识别了7068项研究，并选取了20项进行系统综述。9项干预措施针对患者，9项针对HCPs，2项针对患者和HCPs。干预类型从简单到多方面不等。提供患者信息的以患者为中心的干预措施有效增加了BZDs的适当使用。针对HCPs的教育方法在实现适当处方方面报告了不一致的结果。结合告知患者和HCPs的方法显著减少了BZD的使用。结论：这是首次针对以患者为中心的研究综述。
review_content_zh:
### 审稿人1（匿名）的基本报告

这篇论文结构良好，质量上乘。作者花费了大量时间和精力进行准备。然而，有些方面需要澄清和改进。

1. 作者的非英语背景在一些章节中使用的非当前术语中显而易见。例如，在摘要第33行中使用了“副作用”而非“不良反应”。在引言第58行中，“镇静剂”一词并不常用。建议使用“抗焦虑药”或“抗焦虑/催眠药”作为替代。在结果部分第274行的“时间范围”也是一个不常用的术语。在讨论部分，第333行的“不充分”应替换为“不适当”。全文中“不充分”一词应替换为“不适当”，该词在第360行再次出现。第378行的“老年人”一词已不再使用，应替换为“年长者”。非常感谢您仔细阅读文本。我们已根据您的建议更改了这些术语。

2. 关于苯二氮卓类药物和Z类药物的一些背景信息不正确，需要更正。在摘要中（第32行）提到长期治疗与显著的副作用相关。需要强调的是，短期治疗也与显著的副作用相关，包括跌倒、语言障碍、混淆、认知障碍和共济失调。第62行（引言）中也提到风险仅与长期使用相关。这一部分需要加入关于对苯二氮卓类药物效果耐受性的陈述。感谢这些宝贵的评论。我们已相应地修改了文本。见第69-73行。还有一行提到Z类药物与苯二氮卓类药物具有相似的药理作用（引言第61行）。这是不正确的。Z类药物具有不同的GABA受体结合位点，并不具备抗焦虑特性，因此这一陈述不正确。我们已删除这一陈述。见第68行。

3. 结果部分需要审查，因为部分内容不相关，未提及具体结果，有些陈述不清楚。我们已明确结果部分（例如，明确描述样本量或明确呈现结果）。见第175-344行。

4. 表2在页眉上单独标记为“表1”。我们已相应更改了编号。

5. 最后，期刊名称的引用不一致。缩写版本与非缩写全称并用。当期刊名称全列时，缺少大写字母。需要良好的编辑以符合正确的风格。非常感谢您的建议，我们已仔细检查并更正了参考文献部分。

### 实验设计

综述的方法论是一个强项，描述得足够详细。研究问题定义明确、相关且有意义。然而，

1. 在方法部分未包含搜索词“hypnot*”（催眠药），这很奇怪，可能导致一些论文被遗漏。对不起，我们实际上在搜索语法中使用了“hypnot*”一词，但未在文本中包含。我们已相应更正了搜索词列表。见第136行。

2. 在方法部分的资格部分第121行提到，如果研究专注于精神疾病患者（如恐慌症或精神分裂症等精神诊断）使用BZD，则被排除。这需要重新定义。广义焦虑症或睡眠障碍根据DSM-6也是精神诊断——在这种情况下，所有研究都应被排除。作者是指严重精神疾病吗？恐慌症在老年人中是一个常见诊断。您是对的，我们排除了专注于严重精神疾病的研究。焦虑症（及症状；也包括恐慌症）以及睡眠障碍确实包含在分析中。我们已更改文本。见第144-149行。

### 研究发现的效度

效度良好，表格数据与研究报告一致。解释良好，结论与引言联系紧密。只有几点：

1. 在结果部分，作者在讨论干预结果时混淆了抗精神病药物。例如，第272行提供了这种混淆的例子。“Meader等人研究了干预是否能改变抗精神病药物的摄入率……他们发现抗精神病药物剂量减少（包括BZD）。”这里作者的意思不清楚，我质疑为什么在结果部分包含抗精神病药物与这篇论文相关？非常感谢这一宝贵的评论。您是对的，主要问题涉及抗精神病药物。BZD在这项研究中只是附带考虑。因此，我们决定省略这篇论文。结果部分已相应更改。

2. 当讨论干预时，如果主题限于苯二氮卓类药物的使用和干预结果，会更清晰。例如，在结果部分第292行，需要更多关于药物使用减少幅度的细节，以及“药物使用”是否实际上是指苯二氮卓类药物的使用。在第307行，这项研究根本没有具体提到苯二氮卓类药物。我们已明确并更改了描述。见第303-310行；第317-321行。

3. 第310行（以“与对照组相比……”开头的最后一句）需要更多细节和澄清。我们已明确并更改了结果：见第321-326行。

4. 第292行，Smith是Alysia（即女性），所以“他”应改为“她”。这里提供的讨论部分信息与表2报告的BZD使用显著减少直接矛盾。哪个结果是正确的？请明确这一点。谢谢！我们已澄清并更改了这一部分：见第310-315行（我们已更改表2中的信息）。

### 对作者的建议

paper_title: Biosensors for therapeutic drug monitoring: a review
paper_abstract: Therapeutic drug monitoring (TDM) is a crucial and essential step for patient care when an accurate medication dosage is necessary. High-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) and immunoassays are commonly used methods for TDM, but they are expensive and incapable of real-time monitoring. Biosensor technology is believed to have the potential to perform TDM effectively. Biosensors are flexible and can be tailored to individual patient needs. This article reviews the development of biosensors for TDM, including the types of biosensors that have been fabricated and the drugs they have successfully monitored. Biosensor technology is expected to have a bright future, particularly for real-time monitoring and integration with internet of things (IoT) systems.
review_content:
Comments

I have a few major concerns
  * This manuscript describes ways to perform TDM, starting with the statement that this is 'essential and necessary'. Well, that is not true, or you have to review that. Now you can get the feeling we are forced to use biosensors and TDM based on an unjustified argument.
  * I checked several references and found in some cases (see below) that statements are not in line with the result of the reference, or the reference is also a review, clinical guide, or something else, but not original work
Introduction

The authors state that TDM is essential and necessary in the first paragraph followed by the statement that it will optimize treatment outcome. Now nobody will deny that correct dosing is an important activity in medicine, but whether TDM improves outcome is too my knowledge not common sense. They use a 'clinical guide' as reference, but doubt whether this will underline this statement. I feel we have to see the potential of TDM, and the necessity to examine its effects on outcome, and other endpoints, but just saying it is essential and necessary is, for now, untrue.

Explain internet of things based TDM systems

'Furthermore, biosensors can potentially aid in the real-time monitoring of deadly diseases, greatly assisting medical experts in their treatment' This statement is far too blunt. The reference they use here (5) has a far more nuanced view on this topic

Figure 1; what do the authors mean with 'clinical judgement'?

Guideline paragraph

The psychiatry of the human body? Might be physiology?

TDM for antibiotics

Why should microneedle the preferred method of tracking? I would see direct measurement in the circulation, or at the place of infection, is the preferred method. Furthermore, for beta-lactam, they do not measure the antibiotic, but metabolic changes with might be caused by antibiotics, in healthy humans.

Digoxin is not an antibiotic.

Conclusion

Strange phrases such as 'that TDM can do with biosensors
paper_title_zh: 治疗药物监测的生物传感器：综述
paper_abstract_zh: 治疗药物监测（TDM）是在需要准确药物剂量时对病人护理至关重要且必不可少的一步。高效液相色谱（HPLC）和免疫测定是TDM常用的方法，但它们成本高昂且无法进行实时监测。生物传感器技术被认为具有有效执行TDM的潜力。生物传感器灵活且可根据个体患者需求定制。本文综述了用于TDM的生物传感器的发展，包括已制备的生物传感器类型及其成功监测的药物。预计生物传感器技术将拥有光明的前景，特别是在实时监测和与物联网（IoT）系统整合方面。
review_content_zh:
评论

我有几个主要担忧：
* 这篇手稿描述了执行TDM的方法，开篇即声明这是“必要且必需的”。然而，这并不正确，或者你需要重新审视这一点。现在给人一种感觉，我们被迫使用生物传感器和TDM，基于一个未经证实的论点。
* 我检查了几个参考文献，发现有些情况下（见下文）所述内容与参考文献的结果不符，或者参考文献本身也是综述、临床指南或其他类型的文献，而非原创工作。

引言

作者在第一段中声称TDM是必要且必需的，随后又表示它将优化治疗效果。诚然，正确的剂量在医学中是一项重要活动，但据我所知，TDM是否能改善结果并非常识。他们引用了一份“临床指南”作为参考，但怀疑这能否支撑这一论点。我认为我们需要看到TDM的潜力，以及检验其对结果和其他终点的必要性的研究，但仅凭说它是必要且必需的，目前来看并不真实。

解释基于物联网的TDM系统

“此外，生物传感器可以潜在地帮助实时监测致命疾病，极大地协助医疗专家进行治疗。”这一陈述过于直白。他们在此处引用的参考文献（5）对这一话题有着更为细致的观点。

地高辛不是抗生素。

结论

出现了一些奇怪的短语，如“TDM可以借助生物传感器做到”。

paper_title: An examination of the structural linkages between households and community health services in realization of accelerated primary healthcare delivery in Kisumu County, Kenya: a systematic review
paper_abstract:
Background 
     The provision of community health services (CHS) is critical in accelerating primary health care delivery to vulnerable and deprived populations. This systematic review study has been conducted to interrogate the interrelationship between households and community health services in accelerating primary healthcare delivery synthesizing the available empirical studies. The findings are to inform a primary research on structural linkages between households and CHS in Kisumu County, Kenya. 
   
   
     Methods 
     This study applied a descriptive approach using a systematic review technique to provide context and substance to the two main research questions: (1) how does the interaction between households and CHWs affect utilization of CHS to promote equity and right to health? (2) How do health-seeking behaviours of households influence their decision-making regarding choices of CHS? We screened the literature from Google scholar, JSTOR, SAGE and EBSCO based on our inclusion criteria, resulting in 21 studies. These studies were assessed for quality and eligibility and data extracted based on relevance to the research study. 
   
   
     Results 
     Households place primacy on trust and confidentiality in the interaction with CHWs and this affects uptake of CHS. The social determinants of health are also critical in influencing the health-seeking behaviour of households and individuals and their choice of CHS. The successful models of CHS share the characteristic of community ownership and participation and provides for comprehensive health care teams. 
   
   
     Conclusion 
     CHS are critical for the acceleration of primary health care delivery. It forms an important pathway for the achievement of universal health coverage, which is an outcome required for Sustainable Development Goal 3 on health.
review_content:
REVIEW

Title: An examination of the structural linkages between households and community health services in realisation of accelerated primary healthcare delivery in Kisumu County, Kenya: a systematic review

Major comments:
In reference to your topic, it will be advisable to put into context the meaning of structural linkages between households and community health services in your introduction.

Abstract
Keep the abstract as brief as possible, with a precise, to-the-point example on critical issues that need to be highlighted in the abstract

The review has not answered the stated research questions, especially regarding Kisumu County.

“We screened the literature from Google Scholar, JSTOR, SAGE, and EBSCO based on our inclusion criteria, resulting in 21 studies. These studies were assessed for quality and eligibility, and data was extracted based on relevance to the research study."

***Unnecessary sentence in the abstract***

The introduction
Help the reader understand the interpretation of structural linkages between households and community health services from your research point of view. The introduction does link to the title of the study and the research question of the paper mostly sounds more like a world review of CHW services as opposed to what is stated in the research title. paper_title_zh: 对肯尼亚基苏木郡加速初级卫生保健服务实现过程中家庭与社区卫生服务之间结构联系的考察：一项系统综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景
社区健康服务（CHS）的提供对于加速向脆弱和贫困人口提供初级卫生保健至关重要。本研究通过系统综述方法，探讨了家庭与社区健康服务在加速初级卫生保健提供中的相互关系，综合了现有的实证研究。研究结果将为肯尼亚基苏木县家庭与CHS之间结构性联系的基础研究提供信息。

方法
本研究采用描述性方法，利用系统综述技术，为两个主要研究问题提供背景和实质内容：（1）家庭与社区卫生工作者（CHW）的互动如何影响CHS的利用，以促进公平和健康权利？（2）家庭的健康寻求行为如何影响其关于CHS选择的决策？我们根据纳入标准从Google学术、JSTOR、SAGE和EBSCO筛选文献，最终确定了21项研究。对这些研究的质量和资格进行了评估，并根据与研究的相关性提取了数据。

结果
家庭在与CHW互动中重视信任和保密，这影响了CHS的接受度。健康的社会决定因素在影响家庭和个人的健康寻求行为及其对CHS的选择方面也至关重要。成功的CHS模式具有社区所有和参与的特征，并提供了全面的卫生保健团队。

结论
CHS对于加速初级卫生保健的提供至关重要。它是实现全民健康覆盖的重要途径，而全民健康覆盖是可持续发展目标3中健康成果的必要条件。
