paper_title: Microservice security: a systematic literature review
paper_abstract: Microservices is an emerging paradigm for developing distributed systems. With their widespread adoption, more and more work investigated the relation between microservices and security. Alas, the literature on this subject does not form a well-defined corpus: it is spread over many venues and composed of contributions mainly addressing specific scenarios or needs. In this work, we conduct a systematic review of the field, gathering 290 relevant publications-at the time of writing, the largest curated dataset on the topic. We analyse our dataset along two lines: a) quantitatively, through publication metadata, which allows us to chart publication outlets, communities, approaches, and tackled issues; b) qualitatively, through 20 research questions used to provide an aggregated overview of the literature and to spot gaps left open. We summarise our analyses in the conclusion in the form of a call for action to address the main open challenges.
review_content: Reviewer 2 Comment 2.1 However, I would like to see an explicit motivation on the exclusion of the grey literature. (please see next comment) Comment 2.2 I would like to authors to explicitly motivate why they did not include grey literature in their survey. Especially in a field like microservices which is driven by practitioners this may provide complementary perspective. Perhaps there would be blog posts on ”React & recover Techniques” and ”DevSecOps” which makes the call for action even more worthwhile. We agree it was a necessary clarification. We added the motivation in the second paragraph of section 3.1, explaining our choice of focusing only on published and peer-reviewed articles to avoid the pitfalls also highlighted in the widely cited work by Soldani [1]: “it is very difficult to uniquely measure the quality of grey literature when conducting a systematic, controllable and replicable secondary study”. Comment 2.3 They way to authors list papers in the bibliography is very annoying to look up references. In the end I resorted to a search on the digital PDF document while reading the article in paper form. 2 Citations start with the family name of the first author followed by the year (e.g. Casale et al.[2016]) However in the bibliography the first name comes first, family name comes second followed by all other author names; title, misc and the year at the very end of the entry. (i.e. Giuliano Casale, Cristina Chesta, ... Cloud Forward, pages 34–42, 2016). The alphabetical sorting of the references is thus hard to infer and scanning the list is counterintuitive. Note that some authors have multiple first names (e.f. Mohammad Bany Taha) which makes it even more difficult to discern the alphabetical sorting of the references. The authors also split the reference section in two subsection (References + Publications from the Dataset). So scanning from the end of the bibliography was awkward. (Looking for the entry ”Wuyts 538 et al. [2018]” I started from the back and did not find it on the first attempt. Only the PDF search revealed what was happening) We acknowledge that navigating the large set of references can be sometimes not straightforward. There are two aspects to consider. We still believe that the set of papers we presented as related work, to put our paper in context, are better left in a separate list with respect to the papers we included as the subject of our review. We are grateful to the PeerJ CS editors, who allowed us to substantially exceed the page limit and permitted us to put all the references to the reviewed papers directly in the bibliography, rather than in the supplemental materials. As far as the bibliography presentation is concerned, we follow the journal guidelines and we will be happy to comply with the editor requests in case style changes are needed. Comment 2.4 ”Methodology.” Don’t use the term ”methodology” for what is a method, it is inflation of words. The postfix -OLOGY stands for ”study of”. (i.e. biology = the study of the living organisms; psychology = is the study of the human mind; geology = is the study of the earth). Thus methodology is ”the study of the methods”. We thank the reviewer for the useful insight, we have revised the paper replacing “methodology” with “method” (also double-checking that it was the most appropriate word for the concept) as suggested. Comment 2.5 lines 101-102 ”We analysed these publications to collect statistical and objective answers”. There is no such thing as an ”objective” answer. The very fact that you classified papers already implies a subjective interpretation. I would suggest to replace ”objective” by this by ”transparant”. Agreed, fixed as suggested. Comment 2.6 Line 360-361 ”This is reflected by the sharp increase in the number of publications since 2014.” I am not convinced by this argument. The overall number of publications in computers science is steadily increasing, so the absolute number of papers does not say much. 3 We have computed the fractions of papers published on microservices, using the data from https://dblp.org/statistics/publicationsperyear.html to estimate the number of publications in computer science per year. The fraction of the publications on microservices, year by year from 2014 until 2020 is: 0,0008%, 0,0015%, 0,0055%, 0,0111%, 0,0168%, 0,0252%, 0,0314%. The publications on microservices are therefore steadily increasing in percentage over all the publications in computer science. We have added this information in Section 5.1, providing in Figure 2(a-b) an illustration of this quantitive backing to our statement.
paper_title_zh: 微服务安全：系统文献综述
paper_abstract_zh: 微服务是开发分布式系统的一种新兴范式。随着其广泛采用，越来越多的研究探讨了微服务与安全之间的关系。然而，关于这一主题的文献并未形成一个明确定义的知识体系：它分散在多个平台上，主要由针对特定场景或需求的研究贡献组成。在本文中，我们对该领域进行了系统综述，收集了290篇相关出版物——在撰写本文时，这是该主题上最大的精选数据集。我们沿着两条线索分析我们的数据集：a）定量分析，通过出版物元数据，这使我们能够绘制出版物渠道、社区、方法以及所解决的问题；b）定性分析，通过20个研究问题，用于提供文献的综合概述，并发现遗留的空白。我们在结论中总结了我们的分析，并以行动号召的形式提出，以应对主要未解决的挑战。
review_content_zh:
**审稿人2的评论2.1**  
然而，我希望看到对排除灰色文献的明确动机。（请参见下一条评论）

**评论2.2**  
我希望作者能明确说明为什么他们在综述中没有包含灰色文献。特别是在像微服务这样由实践者驱动的领域，这可能提供了一个互补的视角。也许会有关于“反应与恢复技术”和“DevSecOps”的博客文章，这使得行动号召更加有价值。我们同意这是一个必要的澄清。我们在第3.1节的第二段中添加了动机，解释了我们选择仅关注已发表和同行评审的文章，以避免Soldani [1]在其广泛引用的工作中也强调的陷阱：“在进行系统、可控和可复制的二次研究时，很难唯一地衡量灰色文献的质量”。

**评论2.3**  
作者在参考文献中列出论文的方式非常令人烦恼，查找参考文献很不方便。最后，我在阅读纸质文章时，不得不通过搜索数字PDF文档来查找。2 引用以第一作者姓氏开头，后跟年份（例如，Casale等人[2016]）。然而，在参考文献中，名字在前，姓氏在后，接着是所有其他作者的名字；标题、杂项和年份在条目的最后（即Giuliano Casale, Cristina Chesta, ... Cloud Forward, 页码34–42, 2016）。因此，参考文献的字母排序难以推断，浏览列表也很不直观。需要注意的是，有些作者有多个名字（例如，Mohammad Bany Taha），这使得参考文献的字母排序更加难以辨别。作者还将参考文献部分分为两个子部分（参考文献 + 数据集中的出版物）。因此，从参考文献的末尾开始扫描很不方便。（查找条目“Wuyts 538等人[2018]”时，我从后往前找，第一次没有找到。只有通过PDF搜索才发现问题所在）我们承认，浏览大量参考文献有时可能不太直接。有两个方面需要考虑。我们仍然认为，我们将作为相关工作呈现的论文，以将我们的论文置于背景中，最好还是单独列出来，与我们作为综述对象的论文分开。我们感谢PeerJ CS的编辑们，他们允许我们大幅超出页数限制，并允许我们将所有被评论文献的参考文献直接放在参考文献中，而不是放在补充材料中。至于参考文献的呈现方式，我们遵循期刊的指南，如果需要风格上的更改，我们将乐于遵守编辑的要求。

**评论2.4**  
“方法论。”不要用“方法论”这个词来指代方法，这是词汇的膨胀。-OLOGY后缀表示“研究”（例如，生物学=对生物体的研究；心理学=对人类心灵的研究；地质学=对地球的研究）。因此，方法论是“对方法的研究”。我们感谢审稿人提供的宝贵见解，我们已根据建议修订了论文，将“方法论”替换为“方法”（并再次检查这是否是对该概念最合适的词）。

**评论2.5**  
第101-102行“我们分析了这些出版物以收集统计和客观答案”。不存在所谓的“客观”答案。你们对论文进行分类这一事实本身就意味着主观解释。我建议将“客观”替换为“透明”。同意，已按建议修改。

**评论2.6**  
第360-361行“这反映在自2014年以来出版物数量的急剧增加。”我不太相信这个论点。计算机科学领域的出版物总数一直在稳步增加，所以绝对数量并不能说明太多问题。3 我们已经计算了微服务出版物的比例，使用https://dblp.org/statistics/publicationsperyear.html的数据来估计每年计算机科学的出版物数量。从2014年到2020年，微服务出版物的年度比例分别为：0.0008%，0.0015%，0.0055%，0.0111%，0.0168%，0.0252%，0.0314%。因此，微服务出版物在计算机科学所有出版物中的比例稳步增加。我们已在第5.1节中添加了这些信息，并在图2(a-b)中提供了这一量化支持的说明。

paper_title: A Survey on Self-Supervised Representation Learning
paper_abstract: Learning meaningful representations is at the heart of many tasks in the field of modern machine learning. Recently, a lot of methods were introduced that allow learning of image representations without supervision. These representations can then be used in downstream tasks like classification or object detection. The quality of these representations is close to supervised learning, while no labeled images are needed. This survey paper provides a comprehensive review of these methods in a unified notation, points out similarities and differences of these methods, and proposes a taxonomy which sets these methods in relation to each other. Furthermore, our survey summarizes the most-recent experimental results reported in the literature in form of a meta-study. Our survey is intended as a starting point for researchers and practitioners who want to dive into the field of representation learning.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
The paper is more like a simple grouping of existing methods, but lacking more in-depth thinking. I expect the authors to provide more understandings on the development of unsupervised representation learning methods. By summarizing the previous works, can we arrive at some conclusions to guide the development of representation learning? The current version of paper could bring few insights to the community and a through improvement is needed.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
1. This paper reviews existing representation learning methods and paradigms, as well as datasets used for benchmarking. 2. Each pretext task is intuitively and clearly illustrated for better understanding.

**Requested Changes:**
1. Since Y usually corresponds to the label, I recommend using H to represent the feature/representation. 2. Why BarlowTwins and VICReg belong to information maximization methods? I feel they are more based on feature regularization. 3. I think it would be better to introduce different methods over time. For example, contrastive learning methods are proposed before Teacher-student and MAE, but the authors introduce them reversely. 4. Instead of simply listing different methods, it is important to make comparisons between different ones. For example, what is the relationship between CPC, CMC, and SimCLR? What are in common? What are different? 5. Why in DeepCluster it is possible for all data points to be grouped into a single cluster? 6. The paper is more like a simple grouping of existing methods but lacks more in-depth thinking. I expect the authors to provide more understanding on the development of unsupervised representation learning methods. By summarizing the previous works, can we arrive at some conclusions to guide the development of representation learning? The current version of the paper could bring a few insights to the community and a thorough improvement is needed.

**Claims And Evidence:**
Yes

**Audience:**
Yes

**Rebuttal Comments:**
Author's Response to Reviewer mwJF: > Strengths: > - This paper reviews existing representation learning methods and paradigms, as well as datasets used for benchmarking. > - Each pretext task is intuitively and clearly illustrated for better understanding. > We are happy that you found our description intuitive and clear! We hope that we could further improve our work by including your valuable feedback. > Requested Changes: > - Since Y usually corresponds to the label, I recommend using H to represent the feature/representation. We agree that it is often the case that y is the label in a supervised setting. The reasoning behind our notation is that we use three consecutive letters x, y, and z for input, representation, and projection, respectively. By doing so, we want to stress the sequential nature of these three, i.e., input -> representation -> projection. We hope that we could convince the reviewer that this notation has some benefit over the proposed notation (x, h, z). If this is an acceptance blocker, we would reconsider our choice but for now we prefer our notation. > - Why BarlowTwins and VICReg belong to information maximization methods? I feel they are more based on feature regularization. We agree that these methods are based on feature regularization and occasionally classified as feature decorrelation (as a form of regularization) methods in the literature but view this regularization as a technique serving the overall intention of information maximization, which ultimately aligns with the goal of preventing information collapse. This is also in line with the stated objectives and intuitions in the publications of Barlow Twins and VICReg. To emphasize the relation between the terms, we updated the introduction in Section 3 accordingly. > - I think it would be better to introduce different methods over time. For example, contrastive learning methods are proposed before Teacher-student and MAE, but the authors introduce them reversely. Thank you for this suggestion! We agree that introducing the different sections in the order in which they were introduced in the literature makes sense. The reasoning behind our ordering is that we wanted to start with the pretext-task methods as they are the easiest to understand (as you also pointed out). We found these methods appropriate to gently introduce the reader to the topic. We hope that the intuition that we (hopefully) conveyed in the pretext-task section (Section 2) makes it easier to understand more complex methods like information-maximization methods (Section 3), teacher-student methods (Section 4), or contrastive methods (Section 5). Furthermore, we think that Figure 21 also nicely shows the order in which the methods were introduced in the literature. > - Instead of simply listing different methods, it is important to make comparisons between different ones. For example, what is the relationship between CPC, CMC, and SimCLR? What are in common? What are different? We extended Section 5 on contrastive method with an additional Subsection 5.6 to compare the discussed methods. We choose to build a table which highlights the important aspects of every method. It includes negative sampling strategies, selection of the similarity measure, number of positive pairs among others. > - Why in DeepCluster it is possible for all data points to be grouped into a single cluster? Achieving a reasonable solution in Eq. 61 already requires reasonable cluster assignments from the clustering approach in Step 1. Without avoiding underrepresented (or empty) cluster assignments, it is easy to see that assigning all data points to a single cluster would result in a trivial solution. To make this more clear, we have updated the formulation in the paper: "However, due to the choice of $k$-means in DeepCluster it is quite possible to obtain underrepresented cluster assignments that would lead to trivial solutions, i.e., constant representations are learned and consequently the minimum is achieved in both optimization steps." > - The paper is more like a simple grouping of existing methods but lacks more in-depth thinking. I expect the authors to provide more understanding on the development of unsupervised representation learning methods. By summarizing the previous works, can we arrive at some conclusions to guide the development of representation learning? The current version of the paper could bring a few insights to the community and a thorough improvement is needed. We did a literature review and included some works that discuss interesting connections between different methods. Please refer to the new Sections 3.4, 4.5, 5.7, 6.4.
paper_title_zh: 自监督表示学习综述
paper_abstract_zh: 学习有意义的表示是现代机器学习领域许多任务的核心。近年来，引入了大量方法，允许无监督地学习图像表示。这些表示随后可用于下游任务，如分类或目标检测。这些表示的质量接近于监督学习，而无需标记图像。本文作为一篇综述论文，对这些方法进行了统一符号下的全面回顾，指出了这些方法的相似性和差异性，并提出了一种将这些方法相互关联的分类法。此外，我们的综述以元研究的形式总结了文献中报道的最新实验结果。我们的综述旨在为希望深入了解表示学习领域的研究人员和从业者提供一个起点。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
本文更像是对现有方法的简单归类，但缺乏更深入的分析。我希望作者能对无监督表示学习方法的发展提供更多见解。通过总结前人工作，我们能否得出一些指导表示学习发展的结论？当前版本的论文对社区的贡献有限，需要进行彻底的改进。

**优点与不足：**
1. 本文综述了现有的表示学习方法及范式，以及用于基准测试的数据集。
2. 每个前置任务都直观且清晰地进行了说明，以便更好地理解。

**建议修改：**
1. 由于Y通常对应标签，我建议使用H来表示特征/表示。
2. 为什么BarlowTwins和VICReg属于信息最大化方法？我觉得它们更多是基于特征正则化。
3. 我认为按时间顺序介绍不同方法会更好。例如，对比学习方法在Teacher-student和MAE之前提出，但作者却反序介绍。
4. 仅仅列出不同方法是不够的，重要的是进行方法间的比较。例如，CPC、CMC和SimCLR之间的关系是什么？有何共同点？有何不同？
5. 为什么在DeepCluster中，所有数据点可能被归入一个单一簇？
6. 本文更像是对现有方法的简单归类，但缺乏更深入的分析。我希望作者能对无监督表示学习方法的发展提供更多见解。通过总结前人工作，我们能否得出一些指导表示学习发展的结论？当前版本的论文对社区的贡献有限，需要进行彻底的改进。

**主张与证据：**
是

**受众：**
是

**反驳意见：**
作者对评审mwJF的回应：
> 优点：
> - 本文综述了现有的表示学习方法及范式，以及用于基准测试的数据集。
> - 每个前置任务都直观且清晰地进行了说明，以便更好地理解。
> 我们很高兴您认为我们的描述直观且清晰！我们希望通过纳入您宝贵的反馈，进一步改进我们的工作。
> 建议修改：
> - 由于Y通常对应标签，我建议使用H来表示特征/表示。我们同意在监督设置中y通常是标签。我们使用x、y和z三个连续字母分别表示输入、表示和投影，背后的原因是强调这三者的顺序性，即输入 -> 表示 -> 投影。我们希望说服评审这种表示法比提议的表示法（x, h, z）有一定优势。如果这是接受障碍，我们会重新考虑我们的选择，但目前我们更倾向于我们的表示法。
> - 为什么BarlowTwins和VICReg属于信息最大化方法？我觉得它们更多是基于特征正则化。我们同意这些方法基于特征正则化，文献中偶尔将其归类为特征去相关（作为正则化的一种形式）方法，但我们将这种正则化视为服务于信息最大化总体意图的技术，最终目的是防止信息坍塌。这也与Barlow Twins和VICReg出版物中所述的目标和直觉一致。为强调这些术语之间的关系，我们相应更新了第3节的引言。
> - 我认为按时间顺序介绍不同方法会更好。例如，对比学习方法在Teacher-student和MAE之前提出，但作者却反序介绍。感谢这一建议！我们同意按文献中引入的顺序介绍不同部分是有意义的。我们之所以这样排序，是因为我们想从前置任务方法开始，因为它们最容易理解（如您所指出的）。我们认为这些方法适合温和地引导读者进入主题。我们希望在第2节（前置任务部分）中传达的直觉能更容易理解更复杂的方法，如信息最大化方法（第3节）、教师-学生方法（第4节）或对比方法（第5节）。此外，我们认为图21也很好地展示了文献中引入这些方法的顺序。
> - 仅仅列出不同方法是不够的，重要的是进行方法间的比较。例如，CPC、CMC和SimCLR之间的关系是什么？有何共同点？有何不同？我们在第5节对比方法中增加了一个子节5.6，以比较所讨论的方法。我们选择构建一个表格，突出每种方法的重要方面。包括负采样策略、相似度度量选择、正对数量等。
> - 为什么在DeepCluster中，所有数据点可能被归入一个单一簇？在方程61中实现合理解决方案 already requires reasonable cluster assignments from the clustering approach in Step 1. Without avoiding underrepresented (or empty) cluster assignments, it is easy to see that assigning all data points to a single cluster would result in a trivial solution. 为使这一点更清晰，我们更新了论文中的表述：“然而，由于DeepCluster中选择k-means，很可能获得代表性不足的簇分配，导致平凡解，即学习到常数表示，从而在两个优化步骤中都达到最小值。”
> - 本文更像是对现有方法的简单归类，但缺乏更深入的分析。我希望作者能对无监督表示学习方法的发展提供更多见解。通过总结前人工作，我们能否得出一些指导表示学习发展的结论？当前版本的论文对社区的贡献有限，需要进行彻底的改进。我们进行了文献综述，并纳入了一些讨论不同方法间有趣联系的工作。请参考新的第3.4节、第4.5节、第5.7节和第6.4节。

paper_title: Mutation extraction tools can be combined for robust recognition of genetic variants in the literature
paper_abstract: As the cost of genomic sequencing continues to fall, the amount of data being collected and studied for the purpose of understanding the genetic basis of disease is increasing dramatically. Much of the source information relevant to such efforts is available only from unstructured sources such as the scientific literature, and significant resources are expended in manually curating and structuring the information in the literature. As such, there have been a number of systems developed to target automatic extraction of mutations and other genetic variation from the literature using text mining tools. We have performed a broad survey of the existing publicly available tools for extraction of genetic variants from the scientific literature. We consider not just one tool but a number of different tools, individually and in combination, and apply the tools in two scenarios. First, they are compared in an intrinsic evaluation context, where the tools are tested for their ability to identify specific mentions of genetic variants in a corpus of manually annotated papers, the Variome corpus. Second, they are compared in an extrinsic evaluation context based on our previous study of text mining support for curation of the COSMIC and InSiGHT databases. Our results demonstrate that no single tool covers the full range of genetic variants mentioned in the literature. Rather, several tools have complementary coverage and can be used together effectively. In the intrinsic evaluation on the Variome corpus, the combined performance is above 0.95 in F-measure, while in the extrinsic evaluation the combined recall performance is above 0.71 for COSMIC and above 0.62 for InSiGHT, a substantial improvement over the performance of any individual tool. Based on the analysis of these results, we suggest several directions for the improvement of text mining tools for genetic variant extraction from the literature.
review_content:
The authors have done the formidable job of running five programs that search for mutations in English text on 10 annotated full text articles (they call this "intrinsic") and also on articles that have been annotated by curators of two databases ("extrinsic"). The results make sense, they analyze them well, the article is very readable and the methods are suitable. The conclusions are relevant for everyone who is developing mutation mining tools, probably most users of text mining algorithms, and they are well justified.

Why I have reservations: The authors were able to conduct this study thanks to a great practice in bioinformatics, namely to provide the source code of the program used in a scientific article. They were able to download the source code of at least three programs from other websites or supplemental data and were even able to benchmark a program which has not been published yet in an article (SETH), and found that it led the field. This shows how the state of the art progresses by sharing code (even without publications) - the authors did not have to write their own mutation finding tool, they could run existing programs on a new corpus.

However, it is hard to understand why the authors do not do the same. Anyone who would like to inspect or extend the results of this article would have to redo the same work again: write parsers for five programs, convert both corpora, put the main corpus into a suitable format, including downloading some files from EuropePMC, others from PMC, and write a program to evaluate the differences.

I fully agree with Referee 1 (Philippe Thomas) that when claims about performance of open source programs are made that have been written by various teams, then at least the corpus + annotations have to be added as a supplemental file. Otherwise it is very hard for a field to improve their algorithms and validate claims made in the benchmark.

In this case, the code for running the mutation detection programs should also be provided. Philippe Thomas' (the author of SETH) comment that the results of SETH should have been better for a particular case can only be answered by looking at the code, the version (or the github commit ID in case of pre-publication code) the authors used and the converter, to find out where the differences come from. For a reader, it is currently impossible to validate the observation about SETH. This could be really easy to change, if the authors just attached their corpus+program as a supplemental file or on github, like most other authors in this field today.
paper_title_zh: "突变提取工具可以结合使用以实现对文献中遗传变异的稳健识别"
paper_abstract_zh: 随着基因组测序成本的持续下降，为理解疾病遗传基础而收集和研究的数据量正在急剧增加。许多与这些努力相关的源信息仅可通过非结构化来源（如科学文献）获得，并且需要投入大量资源手动整理和结构化文献中的信息。因此，已经开发出多种系统，旨在利用文本挖掘工具自动从文献中提取突变和其他遗传变异。我们对现有公开可用的从科学文献中提取遗传变异的工具进行了广泛调查。我们不仅考虑单一工具，而是考虑了多种不同的工具，分别和组合应用这些工具在两种情境中。首先，在内在评估情境中进行比较，测试这些工具在识别手动注释论文语料库（Variome语料库）中特定遗传变异提及的能力。其次，在外在评估情境中进行比较，基于我们之前对文本挖掘支持COSMIC和InSiGHT数据库整理的研究。我们的结果表明，没有单一工具能够覆盖文献中提及的所有遗传变异。相反，几种工具具有互补的覆盖范围，可以有效地结合使用。在Variome语料库的内在评估中，组合性能的F值超过0.95，而在外在评估中，COSMIC的组合召回性能超过0.71，InSiGHT的组合召回性能超过0.62，这显著优于任何单一工具的性能。基于对这些结果的分析，我们提出了几个改进从文献中提取遗传变异的文本挖掘工具的方向。
review_content_zh:
作者们完成了一项艰巨的任务，即在10篇注释完整的英文文本文章（他们称之为“内在”）以及由两个数据库的策展人注释的文章（“外在”）上运行五个搜索突变的程序。结果是有意义的，他们分析得很好，文章非常易读，方法也适宜。结论对开发突变挖掘工具的每个人都具有相关性，可能对大多数文本挖掘算法的用户也是如此，并且这些结论得到了很好的论证。

我为何有所保留：作者之所以能够进行这项研究，得益于生物信息学中的一项优良实践，即在科学文章中提供所用程序的源代码。他们能够从其他网站或补充数据中下载至少三个程序的源代码，甚至能够对尚未在文章中发表（SETH）的程序进行基准测试，并发现它在领域中领先。这展示了通过共享代码（即使没有出版物）如何推进前沿技术的发展——作者无需编写自己的突变查找工具，他们可以在新的语料库上运行现有程序。

然而，很难理解为什么作者不采取同样的做法。任何想要检查或扩展这篇文章结果的人都需要重新做同样的工作：为五个程序编写解析器，转换两个语料库，将主语料库放入合适的格式，包括从EuropePMC下载一些文件，从PMC下载其他文件，并编写一个程序来评估差异。

我完全同意审稿人1（Philippe Thomas）的观点，当对由不同团队编写的开源程序的性能提出主张时，至少应将语料库+注释作为补充文件添加。否则，该领域很难改进其算法并验证基准测试中的主张。

在这种情况下，还应提供运行突变检测程序的代码。Philippe Thomas（SETH的作者）评论称SETH在特定情况下的结果应该更好，这只能通过查看作者使用的代码、版本（或预发表代码的github提交ID）和转换器来回答，以找出差异的来源。对于读者来说，目前无法验证关于SETH的观察结果。如果作者像该领域大多数其他作者一样，将他们的语料库+程序作为补充文件或放在github上，这将很容易改变。

paper_title: Nelfinavir and other protease inhibitors in cancer: mechanisms involved in anticancer activity
paper_abstract: Objective: To review the mechanisms of anti-cancer activity of nelfinavir and other protease inhibitors (PIs) based on evidences reported in the published literature. Methods: We extensively reviewed the literature concerning nelfinavir (NFV) as an off target anti-cancer drug and other PIs. A classification of PIs based on anti-cancer mode of action was proposed. Controversies regarding nelfinavir mode of action were also addressed. Conclusions: The two main mechanisms involved in anti-cancer activity are endoplasmic reticulum stress-unfolded protein response pathway and Akt inhibition. However there are many other effects, partially dependent and independent of those mentioned, that may be useful in cancer treatment, including MMP-9 and MMP-2 inhibition, down-regulation of CDK-2, VEGF, bFGF, NF-kB, STAT-3, HIF-1 alfa, IGF, EGFR, survivin, BCRP, androgen receptor, proteasome, fatty acid synthase (FAS), decrease in cellular ATP concentration and upregulation of TRAIL receptor DR5, Bax, increased radiosensitivity, and autophagy. The end result of all these effects is slower growth, decreased angiogenesis, decreased invasion and increased apoptosis, which means reduced proliferation and increased cancer cells death. PIs may be classified according to their anticancer activity at clinically achievable doses, in AKT inhibitors, ER stressors and Akt inhibitors/ER stressors. Beyond the phase I trials that have been recently completed, adequately powered and well-designed clinical trials are needed in the various cancer type settings, and specific trials where NFV is tested in association with other known anti-cancer pharmaceuticals should be sought, in order to find an appropriate place for NFV in cancer treatment. The analysis of controversies on the molecular mechanisms of NFV hints to the possibility that NFV works in a different way in tumor cells and in hepatocytes and adipocytes.
review_content:
This is a highly informative and comprehensive review on our current knowledge about the anti-cancer mechanism of nelfinavir. It also deals with the pros and cons of a possible repurposing of nelfinavir (and other HIV PIs) for cancer treatment.

The following amendments and corrections are suggested:

Proteasome: In the abstract, the proteasome is listed among the factors to be “down-regulated” by nelfinavir. Is the proteasome “downregulated” or “inhibited” in its activity? This might be a slight semantic inaccuracy but is important because it reflects different molecular mechanisms. The same applies to Akt, which, according to the author, is mentioned to be “inhibited” in some phrases and to be “downregulated” (as a protein?) by nelfinavir in other phrases.

Independent of this, there is also a controversy in the literature about the ability of nelfinavir to inhibit proteasomal activity. Some authors observed inhibition of proteasomal enzyme activity by HIV PIs, whereas proteasomal target genes such as HIFalpha and cyclins have unexpectedly not been described to accumulate in the presence of PIs. Instead, as mentioned in this review, several of these proteasomal target proteins were found to be downregulated by nelfinavir treatment.

Using yeast terminology (HAC1) to introduce human ER stress mechanisms might confuse the reader.

Fig.1: How does ER stress lead to proteasome inhibition?

I have problems with the author’s proposed classification of PIs into ER stress inducers and Akt inhibitors (Abstract and Conclusion). Ritonavir is listed as an ER stressor only (conclusions “9”), but has been identified by several researchers to cause both ER stress and Akt inhibition. Furthermore, according to our experience, the ability of PIs to reduce Akt activity appears to be dependent on the cell line(s) used. Our group also observed enhanced Akt phosphorylation by nelfinavir in cell lines with low endogenous Akt activity, and Akt activation is also a known response to ER stress.

A combination of nelfinavir with mTOR inhibitors is suggested by the author. There are some independent recent reports indicating that nelfinavir also acts as an mTOR inhibitor.

The ability of nelfinavir to induce oxidative stress should be mentioned, because this may represent one of the reasons why nelfinavir may exert ER stress or other anti-cancer effects. (Fig. 2, for example, suggests undefined “protease inhibition” as the only mechanism of nelfinavir-induced ER stress).

Some typos in the text and in the figures should be corrected (hidroxychloroquine; phosphorilation; endothelial (=endoplasmic?) reticulum; Bc12 (=bcl2? Fig. 5)).
paper_title_zh: 奈非那韦及其他蛋白酶抑制剂在癌症中的作用：抗癌活性的相关机制
paper_abstract_zh:
**摘要**

**目的**：基于已发表文献中的证据，综述奈非那韦及其他蛋白酶抑制剂（PIs）的抗肿瘤活性机制。

**方法**：我们广泛回顾了关于奈非那韦（NFV）作为非靶向抗肿瘤药物及其他PIs的文献。提出了基于抗肿瘤作用模式的PIs分类，并探讨了关于奈非那韦作用机制的争议。

**结论**：抗肿瘤活性的两个主要机制是内质网应激-未折叠蛋白反应途径和Akt抑制。然而，还有许多其他效应，部分依赖于或独立于上述机制，可能对癌症治疗有益，包括MMP-9和MMP-2抑制、CDK-2、VEGF、bFGF、NF-kB、STAT-3、HIF-1α、IGF、EGFR、survivin、BCRP、雄激素受体、蛋白酶体、脂肪酸合成酶（FAS）的下调，细胞内ATP浓度降低，TRAIL受体DR5、Bax的上调，放射敏感性增加和自噬。所有这些效应的最终结果是生长减慢、血管生成减少、侵袭性降低和凋亡增加，这意味着增殖减少和癌细胞死亡增加。PIs可根据其在临床可达到剂量下的抗肿瘤活性分为AKT抑制剂、ER应激剂和AKT抑制剂/ER应激剂。除了最近完成的I期试验外，还需要在各类癌症环境中进行充分-powered和良好设计的临床试验，并应寻求特定试验，测试NFV与其他已知抗肿瘤药物联合使用，以找到NFV在癌症治疗中的适当位置。对NFV分子机制争议的分析提示，NFV在肿瘤细胞和肝细胞及脂肪细胞中可能以不同方式发挥作用。
review_content_zh:
这是一篇关于我们目前对奈非那韦抗癌机制了解的高度信息性和综合性综述。它还探讨了将奈非那韦（及其他HIV蛋白酶抑制剂）重新用于癌症治疗的利弊。

建议进行以下修订和更正：

蛋白酶体：在摘要中，蛋白酶体被列为奈非那韦“下调”的因素之一。蛋白酶体的活性是被“下调”还是“抑制”？这可能是一个轻微的语义不准确，但很重要，因为它反映了不同的分子机制。同样适用于Akt，根据作者的说法，在某些短语中被提及为“抑制”，而在其他短语中则被提及为被奈非那韦“下调”（作为蛋白质？）。

与此独立的是，文献中关于奈非那韦抑制蛋白酶体活性的能力也存在争议。一些作者观察到HIV蛋白酶抑制剂抑制蛋白酶体酶活性，而蛋白酶体靶基因如HIFalpha和细胞周期蛋白在蛋白酶抑制剂存在下却未如预期般积累。相反，正如本综述中提到的，这些蛋白酶体靶蛋白中有几个被发现通过奈非那韦处理被下调。

使用酵母术语（HAC1）来介绍人类内质网应激机制可能会使读者混淆。

图1：内质网应激如何导致蛋白酶体抑制？

我对作者提出的将蛋白酶抑制剂分类为内质网应激诱导剂和Akt抑制剂的分类方法有疑问（摘要和结论）。利托那韦仅被列为内质网应激因子（结论“9”），但已被多个研究者识别为同时引起内质网应激和Akt抑制。此外，根据我们的经验，蛋白酶抑制剂减少Akt活性的能力似乎依赖于所使用的细胞系。我们的团队还观察到奈非那韦在低内源性Akt活性的细胞系中增强了Akt磷酸化，而Akt激活也是内质网应激的已知反应。

作者建议将奈非那韦与mTOR抑制剂联合使用。有一些独立的最新报告指出，奈非那韦也作为mTOR抑制剂发挥作用。

应提及奈非那韦诱导氧化应激的能力，因为这可能是奈非那韦发挥内质网应激或其他抗癌效应的原因之一。（例如，图2仅将未定义的“蛋白酶抑制”作为奈非那韦诱导内质网应激的唯一机制）。

文本和图表中的一些错别字应予以更正（hidroxychloroquine；phosphorilation；endothelial (=endoplasmic?) reticulum；Bc12 (=bcl2? 图5)）。

paper_title: Assessing pooled prevalence of exclusive breastfeeding practice and addressing principal barriers to its practice in North African countries: A systematic review and meta-analysis
review_content:
The authors present a systematic review and meta-analysis of published studies up to February 2023 regarding the prevalence of exclusive breastfeeding of infants <6 months old and associated factors in North Africa. (This is not a living systematic review).
The objectives, the methods, statistical approaches, results, discussion and conclusion are nicely described.
Below are some additional comments:
- Even though the full PICO may not be applied, participants and outcomes should be clearly defined in the search strategies. Should describe study population of infants under 6 months old and their mothers in the search for evidence.
- The discussion regarding factors that may explain the low adherence and practice of EBF in NA should cite proper evidence/sources for each factors listed. Similarly for factors/ explanation for disparities and inequalities.
paper_title_zh: 评估北非国家纯母乳喂养实践的合并患病率及解决其主要障碍：系统综述与荟萃分析
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：
纯母乳喂养（EBF）是全球公共卫生的优先事项。根据世界卫生组织（WHO）的数据，全球在婴儿出生后前六个月内的纯母乳喂养率仍然较低，尤其是在低收入和中等收入国家。在这篇系统综述（SR）和荟萃分析（MA）中，我们考察了北非（NA）国家在婴儿出生后前六个月内纯母乳喂养的汇总流行率和影响因素的现有证据。

方法：
本SR和MA遵循系统综述和荟萃分析的首选报告项目（PRISMA）指南。系统检索了国际数据库。纳入标准包括在北非国家（突尼斯、阿尔及利亚、摩洛哥、利比亚、埃及、苏丹）进行的关于母乳喂养流行率的研究。荟萃分析使用R（版本4.2.3）进行。

结果：
共有16项研究，总计7,849名参与者被纳入分析。北非国家在婴儿出生后前六个月内纯母乳喂养的全球汇总流行率为29.0%（CI95% [18.0; 42.0]），结果异质性较大（Tau2 = 1.41，I2 = 99%，p < 0.01）。突尼斯的纯母乳喂养率最低（11%），而苏丹（63%）和摩洛哥（48%）最高。在婴儿至少6个月大时，纯母乳喂养至前六个月的流行率为30.0%（CI95% [14.0; 52.0]）。

考察了纯母乳喂养实践的障碍，包括母亲的受教育水平、母亲就业情况和分娩方式。然而，未发现具有统计学意义的因素。

结论：
北非国家的纯母乳喂养率低于WHO的推荐标准。需要共同努力并采用多维方法来促进和支持纯母乳喂养实践。北非各国的纯母乳喂养率差异较大，促进和支持这一实践的努力需要具有针对性，并针对每个国家独特的挑战和机遇进行定制。实施婴儿友好医院倡议可以有助于改善该地区的母乳喂养实践。
review_content_zh:
作者对截至2023年2月发表的关于北非地区6个月以下婴儿纯母乳喂养的流行率及其相关因素的文献进行了系统综述和荟萃分析。（这不是一个动态系统综述）。
研究目标、方法、统计方法、结果、讨论和结论都得到了很好的描述。
以下是一些额外评论：
- 尽管可能未完全应用PICO框架，但在搜索策略中应明确界定参与者和结果。应在证据搜索中描述6个月以下婴儿及其母亲的研究人群。
- 在讨论可能解释北非地区纯母乳喂养低依从性和实践的因素时，应为列出的每个因素引用适当的证据/来源。同样，对于差异和不平等的因素/解释也应如此。

reasons: Even though the full PICO may not be applied, participants and outcomes should be clearly defined in the search strategies.
Should describe study population of infants under 6 months old and their mothers in the search for evidence.
The discussion regarding factors that may explain the low adherence and practice of EBF in NA should cite proper evidence/sources for each factors listed.
Similarly for factors/ explanation for disparities and inequalities.
The objectives, the methods, statistical approaches, results, discussion and conclusion are nicely described.
The objectives, the methods, statistical approaches, results, discussion and conclusion are nicely described.

paper_title: A review on diabetes mellitus: complications, synthetic anti-diabetic agents and herbal treatment
paper_abstract:
Background 
    Diabetes mellitus is a metabolic disorder with multiple symptoms and complications. The management of these conditions involve the use of synthetic anti-diabetic agents, natural products and medicinal plants. Synthetic anti-diabetic agents are associated with side effects whereas medicinal plants have minimal side effects and are less expensive. The aim of this work is to highlight various (i) complications associated with diabetes (ii) synthetic anti-diabetic agents used for treatment (iii) medicinal plants as anti-diabetic agents. 
  
  
    Methods 
    Electronic databases such as Web of Science, Google Scholar, Science Direct, Springer, Pub Med, Medline and Scopus were searched to identify complications linked with diabetes, synthetic anti-diabetic agents, and herbs used in the management of diabetes mellitus. 
  
  
    Results 
    The present article is an updated review of the published literature on types of diabetes and their complications, synthetic anti-diabetic drugs and medicinal herbs used for management of diabetes. 
  
  
    Conclusions 
    Given the complications associated with diabetes mellitus, a search for medicinal herbs with anti-diabetic properties will be useful in the management of this disease.
review_content:
The title accurately reflects the content of the manuscript. However, consider specifying the scope of the review, such as including "A Comprehensive Review" to emphasize the depth of coverage.
The content specially the management section need to elaborate in detail. The mechanism of action of the plants will increase the strength of the paper. Currently the paper looks like preliminary data. It need to be reworked in detail. The merits and demerits of using herbal druhs, their dosing and toxicity studies need to documented properly.
paper_title_zh: 糖尿病综述：并发症、合成抗糖尿病药物及草药治疗
paper_abstract_zh:
背景
糖尿病是一种具有多种症状和并发症的代谢紊乱疾病。这些病症的管理涉及使用合成抗糖尿病药物、天然产物和药用植物。合成抗糖尿病药物伴随有副作用，而药用植物副作用较小且成本较低。本研究的目的是突出以下几个方面：(i)与糖尿病相关的并发症；(ii)用于治疗的合成抗糖尿病药物；(iii)作为抗糖尿病药物的药用植物。

方法
通过检索Web of Science、Google Scholar、Science Direct、Springer、Pub Med、Medline和Scopus等电子数据库，识别与糖尿病相关的并发症、合成抗糖尿病药物以及用于管理糖尿病的草药。

结果
本文是对已发表文献的更新综述，涉及糖尿病类型及其并发症、合成抗糖尿病药物以及用于管理糖尿病的药用植物。

结论
鉴于与糖尿病相关的并发症，寻找具有抗糖尿病特性的药用植物将有助于该疾病的管理。

paper_title: A Survey on the Possibilities & Impossibilities of AI-generated Text Detection
paper_abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized the domain of natural language processing (NLP) with remarkable capabilities of generating human-like text responses. However, despite these advancements, several works in the existing literature have raised serious concerns about the potential misuse of LLMs such as spreading misinformation, generating fake news, plagiarism in academia, and contaminating the web. To address these concerns, a consensus among the research community is to develop algorithmic solutions to detect AI-generated text. The basic idea is that whenever we can tell if the given text is either written by a human or an AI, we can utilize this information to address the above-mentioned concerns. To that end, a plethora of detection frameworks have been proposed, highlighting the possibilities of AI-generated text detection. But in parallel to the development of detection frameworks, researchers have also concentrated on designing strategies to elude detection, i.e., focusing on the impossibilities of AI-generated text detection. This is a crucial step in order to make sure the detection frameworks are robust enough and it is not too easy to fool a detector. Despite the huge interest and the flurry of research in this domain, the community currently lacks a comprehensive analysis of recent developments. In this survey, we aim to provide a concise categorization and overview of current work encompassing both the prospects and the limitations of AI-generated text detection. To enrich the collective knowledge, we engage in an exhaustive discussion on critical and challenging open questions related to ongoing research on AI-generated text detection.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
This papers provides a comprehensive survey of the nascent problem of AI-generated text detection. The survey categorizes recent work on AI-generated text detection into methods showing possibilities of detection, such as watermarking and zero-shot techniques, and methods revealing impossibilities, like paraphrasing attacks. The paper provides a comprehensive taxonomy and analysis of detection schemes, attack strategies, theoretical insights, real-world applications, and open challenges. The paper is well written and is easy to read. I enjoyed reading this paper!

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
**Pros**: - The paper provides a comprehensive taxonomy and analysis of recent work on AI-generated text detection. Categorizing methods into "towards possibilities" and "towards impossibilities" offers a useful framework. - Thoroughly reviewing detection schemes like watermarking, zero-shot, and classifier-based methods gives a good overview of current techniques. Discussing attack schemes like paraphrasing, generative, copy-paste, and spoofing attacks highlights vulnerabilities. - Connecting theoretical insights from recent studies provides useful context. The sample complexity analysis showing detection improves with more text is an important insight. - The discussion of open questions identifies critical challenges like evaluating detectors, improving robustness, and leveraging prompt knowledge. This will help guide future work. - Examples illustrating detection scenarios and requirements in areas like social media, academia, and customer support are insightful. **Cons**: - More comparison between the detection schemes on criteria like usability, accuracy, robustness would further highlight their tradeoffs. - While paraphrasing attacks are analyzed in depth, discussions of generative and spoofing attacks could be expanded. - The arguments around possibilities vs impossibilities could be presented in a more balanced manner, as both highlight important caveats. - More empirical evidence demonstrating the effectiveness of detection schemes on real datasets would strengthen the claims.

**Requested Changes:**
- Expand the comparison between detection schemes on criteria like usability, accuracy, and robustness. A table could help summarize. - Provide more details and examples for generative and spoofing attacks. - Aim for a balanced presentation of arguments around possibilities and impossibilities. Both have merits and limitations depending on the context. - Include empirical evidence on real datasets for key detection schemes to substantiate claims of effectiveness. - Shorten repetitive details when reviewing methods to improve flow and highlight novel contributions. Overall, this is a comprehensive survey analyzing an important emerging field. Addressing the above suggestions would further improve quality and value to readers. I appreciate the authors' work and hope these comments are helpful.

**Broader Impact Concerns:**
None.

**Claims And Evidence:**
Yes

**Audience:**
Yes

**Rebuttal Comments:**
Response to Reviewer akKj: **General Response** : We sincerely appreciate the reviewer's detailed feedback on our paper, highlighting that our work produces a comprehensive taxonomy and analysis of recent work on AI-generated text detection. We want to thank the reviewer for acknowledging that our survey's theoretical and practical insights, including the open questions illustration of detection scenarios, are critical and can help in future research. **Response to Requested Changes** >Requested Changes 1 : Expand the comparison between detection schemes ... table could help summarize. Include empirical evidence on real datasets ... to substantiate claims of effectiveness. **Response to Requested Changes 1:** We agree that empirical evidence on real-world datasets for various SOTA detection schemes is critical to substantiate claims of effectiveness. Hence, we evaluate popular open-source LLMs using state-of-the-art Post-hoc detectors on Xsum, SQuAD and WP datasets in Table 1 (newly added), and the values are obtained by reproducing the results in [A]. [A] Hu, Xiaomeng, Pin-Yu Chen, and Tsung-Yi Ho. "Radar: Robust ai-text detection via adversarial learning." arXiv preprint arXiv:2307.03838 (2023). >Provide more details and examples for generative and spoofing attacks. **Response to Requested Changes 2:** As requested, we have added additional descriptions regarding the generative and spoofing attacks in Section 5.2 and Section 5.4 with examples and applications in Detection Scenarios Section 6.6. For example - The generative attacks are made by instructing the model to generate emojis after each token or prompting the model to replace all ‘a’ with ‘e’, which evades the detection by the watermark detector by randomizing the red lists. Similarly, we highlight the effectiveness of various spoofing attacks on all detection schemes. >Requested Changes 3 : Aim for a balanced presentation .... possibilities and impossibilities. **Response to Requested Changes 3:** We have added more details and context in Section 3 in the *Hidden Possibilities of Text Detection* in favor of both possibilities and impossibilities, emphasizing that the claim of possibility or impossibility requires additional context about the problem.
paper_title_zh: 关于人工智能生成文本检测的可能性与不可能性的综述
paper_abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）凭借其生成类人文本回复的显著能力，彻底改变了自然语言处理（NLP）领域。然而，尽管取得了这些进步，现有文献中的多项研究已对LLMs的潜在滥用提出了严重关切，例如传播虚假信息、生成假新闻、学术抄袭以及污染网络。为应对这些关切，研究社区达成共识，即开发算法解决方案以检测AI生成的文本。其基本思路是，只要我们能判断给定文本是由人类还是AI所写，我们就可以利用这一信息来解决上述问题。为此，已提出了大量检测框架，突显了AI生成文本检测的可能性。但与此同时，研究人员也专注于设计规避检测的策略，即关注AI生成文本检测的不可能性。这是确保检测框架足够稳健且不易被欺骗的关键步骤。尽管该领域的研究兴趣浓厚且成果频出，但目前社区仍缺乏对近期发展的全面分析。在本综述中，我们旨在对当前工作提供一个简洁的分类和概述，涵盖AI生成文本检测的前景和局限性。为丰富集体知识，我们深入讨论了与AI生成文本检测持续研究相关的关键且具有挑战性的开放性问题。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
本文对AI生成文本检测这一新兴问题进行了全面的综述。该综述将近期关于AI生成文本检测的研究分为两类：展示检测可能性的方法，如水印和零样本技术；以及揭示检测不可能性的方法，如改写攻击。论文提供了检测方案、攻击策略、理论见解、实际应用和开放挑战的全面分类和分析。文章写作质量高，易于阅读。我非常享受阅读这篇论文！

**优点和缺点：**
**优点**：
- 论文提供了对近期AI生成文本检测工作的全面分类和分析。将方法分为“趋向可能性”和“趋向不可能性”提供了一个有用的框架。
- 对水印、零样本和基于分类器的检测方案进行了彻底的回顾，给出了当前技术的良好概述。讨论了改写、生成、复制粘贴和欺骗攻击等攻击方案，突显了漏洞。
- 将近期研究的理论见解联系起来，提供了有用的背景。样本复杂性分析显示，随着文本量的增加，检测效果提升，这是一个重要的见解。
- 对开放问题的讨论识别了关键挑战，如评估检测器、提高鲁棒性和利用提示知识。这将有助于指导未来的工作。
- 通过社交媒体、学术界和客户支持等领域的示例，说明了检测场景和要求，具有洞察力。

**缺点**：
- 在可用性、准确性和鲁棒性等标准上，对检测方案进行更多比较，将进一步突出其权衡。
- 虽然对改写攻击进行了深入分析，但对生成和欺骗攻击的讨论可以扩展。
- 关于可能性和不可能性的论证可以以更平衡的方式呈现，因为两者都突显了重要的注意事项。
- 更多实证证据，展示检测方案在真实数据集上的有效性，将加强论点。

**请求的修改：**
- 扩展在可用性、准确性和鲁棒性等标准上对检测方案的比较。一个表格可以帮助总结。
- 为生成和欺骗攻击提供更多细节和示例。
- 力求在可能性和不可能性的论证上呈现平衡。两者在不同情境下都有其优点和局限性。
- 包含关键检测方案在真实数据集上的实证证据，以支持有效性的主张。
- 在回顾方法时缩短重复细节，以改善流程并突出新颖贡献。

总体而言，这是一篇分析重要新兴领域的全面综述。解决上述建议将进一步提高论文的质量和价值。我感谢作者的工作，希望这些评论有所帮助。

**更广泛的影响关切：**
无。

**主张和证据：**
是。

**受众：**
是。

**反驳评论：**
对评审员akKj的回应：
**总体回应**：我们衷心感谢评审员对我们论文的详细反馈，指出我们的工作对近期AI生成文本检测工作进行了全面的分类和分析。我们感谢评审员认可我们综述中的理论和实践见解，包括开放问题的说明和检测场景的示例，这些都是关键性的，并有助于未来的研究。

**对请求修改的回应**
>请求的修改1：扩展检测方案之间的比较……表格可以帮助总结。包含真实数据集上的实证证据……以支持有效性的主张。
**对请求修改1的回应**：我们同意在真实数据集上对各种最先进检测方案的实证证据是支持有效性主张的关键。因此，我们在表1（新添加）中评估了流行的开源LLM，使用最先进的后验检测器在Xsum、SQuAD和WP数据集上进行评估，结果是通过复现[A]中的结果获得的。[A] Hu, Xiaomeng, Pin-Yu Chen, and Tsung-Yi Ho. "Radar: Robust ai-text detection via adversarial learning." arXiv preprint arXiv:2307.03838 (2023).

>为生成和欺骗攻击提供更多细节和示例。
**对请求修改2的回应**：如所请求，我们在第5.2节和第5.4节中添加了关于生成和欺骗攻击的额外描述，并在第6.6节的检测场景中提供了示例和应用。例如——生成攻击通过指示模型在每个标记后生成表情符号，或提示模型将所有‘a’替换为‘e’，从而通过随机化红名单来规避水印检测器的检测。同样，我们突显了各种欺骗攻击对所有检测方案的有效性。

>请求的修改3：力求在可能性和不可能性的论证上呈现平衡。
**对请求修改3的回应**：我们在第3节的“文本检测的隐藏可能性”中添加了更多细节和背景，支持可能性和不可能性，强调可能或不可能的主张需要关于问题的额外背景。

paper_title: Why do proteins aggregate? “Intrinsically insoluble proteins” and “dark mediators” revealed by studies on “insoluble proteins” solubilized in pure water
paper_abstract: In 2008, I reviewed and proposed a model for our discovery in 2005 that unrefoldable and insoluble proteins could in fact be solubilized in unsalted water. Since then, this discovery has offered us and other groups a powerful tool to characterize insoluble proteins, and we have further addressed several fundamental and disease-relevant issues associated with this discovery. Here I review these results, which are conceptualized into several novel scenarios. 1) Unlike 'misfolded proteins', which still retain the capacity to fold into well-defined structures but are misled to 'off-pathway' aggregation, unrefoldable and insoluble proteins completely lack this ability and will unavoidably aggregate in vivo with ~150 mM ions, thus designated as 'intrinsically insoluble proteins (IIPs)' here. IIPs may largely account for the 'wastefully synthesized' DRiPs identified in human cells. 2) The fact that IIPs including membrane proteins are all soluble in unsalted water, but get aggregated upon being exposed to ions, logically suggests that ions existing in the background play a central role in mediating protein aggregation, thus acting as 'dark mediators'. Our study with 14 salts confirms that IIPs lack the capacity to fold into any well-defined structures. We uncover that salts modulate protein dynamics and anions bind proteins with high selectivity and affinity, which is surprisingly masked by pre-existing ions. Accordingly, I modified my previous model. 3) Insoluble proteins interact with lipids to different degrees. Remarkably, an ALS-causing P56S mutation transforms the β-sandwich MSP domain into a helical integral membrane protein. Consequently, the number of membrane-interacting proteins might be much larger than currently recognized. To attack biological membranes may represent a common mechanism by which aggregated proteins initiate human diseases. 4) Our discovery also implies a solution to the 'chicken-and-egg paradox' for the origin of primitive membranes embedded with integral membrane proteins, if proteins originally emerged in unsalted prebiotic media.
review_content:
The abstract is fine but I think the title is somehow misleading. The review does not give an answer as to why proteins aggregate and how pathological aggregations can be reversed or prohibited. The title should be more specific and scientific (avoid ‘dark mediators’).

  * Article content: The self-assembly of proteins is a very important problem not only from a folding point of view, but also from evolutionary or pathological aspects. The proposal that pure water can prohibit or reverse aggregation is interesting. I do not feel the presented results are convincing enough to provide a deeper insight into the mechanism of the aggregation phenomenon.

  * Conclusions are made based on a few examples and miss robust statistical tests on larger databases. For example, low-complexity sequences that are unstructured and insoluble, or proteins with high-complexity sequences that are unstructured and insoluble. Protein disorder is associated with a particular composition of amino acids, and has many other characteristics that are easy to detect. Intrinsically disordered (ID) proteins however are soluble, in many cases ID segments help to solubilize aggregation-prone regions.

    The relationship between ID and aggregation is controversial. Aggregation-prone regions also have a particular composition (for example see R. Pomès et al., 2006 for differences between elastic and aggregating sequences). This review does not reflect the complexity of the theme and often runs into simplified conclusions in this respect.

  * I would like to see the mechanism for how ions mediate aggregation and what the impact of their removal is. The relationship between ions and protein structure has been analyzed by various authors, and these works would be worth a mention (e.g. B. M. Pettitt et al., PMID: 19548651, PMID: 20151732, PMID: 20306490)

  * The author argues for ‘specific binding’ of ions. It is obvious from various other works that ions bind at particular locations, but specificity has not been demonstrated clearly in this paper. Would ions make a difference between a WT protein and a single mutant?

  * I think that the conclusions go beyond the scope and validity of the results, in particular ‘birth, transformation and death of proteins’. This process is so complex and presented in an over-simplified manner here. How ID, which is identified here as one of the main factors, is related to degradation for example?

  * How can pure water reverse the effect of aggregation promoting ions? Just removing the ions does not guarantee that the protein will find its correct folding pathway. What about the hydrophobic patches in general? Will they still dislike water and try to avoid?

  * I would strongly argue with the expression ‘dark mediators’. Ions are not dark. By neutron scattering and some modern SAXS data we can have detailed structural information on them.

  * What would be the real practical application of the work?

  * I feel the evolutionary arguments are rather speculative. There are some studies on ID evolution, maybe a good point to start with.

Overall, I feel the review – although many experimental data are presented – to be speculative and conclusions are not supported with robust analysis. The proposal is interesting but should be corroborated more. I also miss a general mechanistic picture, with thermodynamic and structural arguments given.
paper_title_zh: 为什么蛋白质会聚集？“内在不溶性蛋白质”和“暗中介物”通过研究在纯水中溶解的“不溶性蛋白质”得以揭示
paper_abstract_zh: 2008年，我回顾并提出了一个模型，解释了我们在2005年的发现，即不可复性和不溶性蛋白质实际上可以在无盐水中溶解。自那时起，这一发现为我们和其他研究组提供了一个强大的工具来表征不溶性蛋白质，并且我们进一步解决了与这一发现相关的几个基本和疾病相关的问题。在此，我回顾了这些结果，并将其概念化为几个新的情景。1）与“错误折叠的蛋白质”不同，后者仍保留折叠成明确定义结构的能力，但被误导至“偏离路径”的聚集，不可复性和不溶性蛋白质完全缺乏这种能力，并且在体内不可避免地与约150 mM的离子聚集，因此在此被指定为“内在不溶性蛋白质（IIPs）”。IIPs可能在很大程度上解释了在人类细胞中发现的“浪费合成的”DRiPs。2）包括膜蛋白在内的IIPs在无盐水中均可溶，但在暴露于离子时会发生聚集，这逻辑上表明背景中存在的离子在介导蛋白质聚集方面起着核心作用，从而充当“暗中介”。我们对14种盐的研究证实，IIPs缺乏折叠成任何明确定义结构的能力。我们发现盐调节蛋白质动态，阴离子以高选择性和亲和力结合蛋白质，这一现象被预先存在的离子掩盖。因此，我修改了我之前的模型。3）不溶性蛋白质与脂质的相互作用程度不同。值得注意的是，一个导致ALS的P56S突变将β-三明治MSP结构域转变为螺旋型整合膜蛋白。因此，与膜相互作用的蛋白质数量可能远大于目前所认知的。攻击生物膜可能代表了聚集蛋白质引发人类疾病的常见机制。4）我们的发现还暗示了解决“先有鸡还是先有蛋悖论”的方案，即如果蛋白质最初出现在无盐的前生物介质中，那么嵌入整合膜蛋白的原始膜起源问题。
review_content_zh:
摘要没问题，但我觉得标题有些误导性。这篇综述并没有回答蛋白质为何聚集以及如何逆转或防止病理性聚集的问题。标题应该更具体、更科学（避免使用“暗中介”）。

* 文章内容：蛋白质的自组装不仅从折叠角度来看是一个非常重要的问题，从进化或病理学角度也是如此。纯水可以防止或逆转聚集的提议很有趣。但我认为所呈现的结果不足以提供对聚集现象机制的深入见解。

* 结论基于少数例子得出，缺乏在大数据库上的稳健统计测试。例如，低复杂度序列的无结构和不溶性蛋白质，或高复杂度序列的无结构和不溶性蛋白质。蛋白质无序与特定氨基酸组成相关，并具有许多其他易于检测的特征。然而，内在无序（ID）蛋白质是可溶的，在很多情况下ID片段有助于溶解易于聚集的区域。

  ID与聚集之间的关系是有争议的。易于聚集的区域也有特定的组成（例如参见R. Pomès等，2006年关于弹性序列和聚集序列差异的研究）。这篇综述没有反映主题的复杂性，并经常在这方面得出简化的结论。

* 我希望看到离子如何介导聚集的机制以及去除它们的影响。离子与蛋白质结构之间的关系已由多位作者分析，这些工作值得提及（例如B. M. Pettitt等，PMID: 19548651, PMID: 20151732, PMID: 20306490）。

* 作者主张离子的“特异性结合”。从其他多项工作中可以看出，离子在特定位置结合，但本文并未明确展示特异性。离子会对野生型蛋白质和单突变体有区别吗？

* 我认为结论超出了结果的范围和有效性，尤其是“蛋白质的诞生、转化和死亡”。这一过程非常复杂，而在此被过度简化了。例如，本文确定ID是主要因素之一，但它与降解有何关系？

* 纯水如何逆转促进聚集的离子的效应？仅仅去除离子并不能保证蛋白质找到正确的折叠路径。普遍存在的疏水斑块怎么办？它们仍然会排斥水并试图避免吗？

* 我强烈反对使用“暗中介”这一表达。离子并不暗。通过中子散射和一些现代SAXS数据，我们可以获得它们的详细结构信息。

* 这项工作的实际应用是什么？

* 我觉得进化论点相当推测性。有一些关于ID进化的研究，或许可以作为起点。

总的来说，尽管呈现了许多实验数据，但我认为这篇综述具有推测性，结论缺乏稳健分析的支持。提议很有趣，但需要更多佐证。我也缺少一个包含热力学和结构论据的总体机制图。

reasons: The relationship between ions and protein structure has been analyzed by various authors, and these works would be worth a mention (e.g. B. M. Pettitt et al., PMID: 19548651, PMID: 20151732, PMID: 20306490)
There are some studies on ID evolution, maybe a good point to start with.
I do not feel the presented results are convincing enough to provide a deeper insight into the mechanism of the aggregation phenomenon.
This review does not reflect the complexity of the theme and often runs into simplified conclusions in this respect.
I think that the conclusions go beyond the scope and validity of the results, in particular ‘birth, transformation and death of proteins’.
This process is so complex and presented in an over-simplified manner here.
Overall, I feel the review – although many experimental data are presented – to be speculative and conclusions are not supported with robust analysis.
The proposal is interesting but should be corroborated more.
Conclusions are made based on a few examples and miss robust statistical tests on larger databases.
The author argues for ‘specific binding’ of ions. It is obvious from various other works that ions bind at particular locations, but specificity has not been demonstrated clearly in this paper.
The abstract is fine but I think the title is somehow misleading.
The title should be more specific and scientific (avoid ‘dark mediators’).
I would strongly argue with the expression ‘dark mediators’.
Ions are not dark.
The review does not give an answer as to why proteins aggregate and how pathological aggregations can be reversed or prohibited.
I also miss a general mechanistic picture, with thermodynamic and structural arguments given.
I would like to see the mechanism for how ions mediate aggregation and what the impact of their removal is.
How can pure water reverse the effect of aggregation promoting ions?

paper_title: Interpretation of mRNA splicing mutations in genetic disease: review of the literature and guidelines for information-theoretical analysis
paper_abstract: The interpretation of genomic variants has become one of the paramount challenges in the post-genome sequencing era. In this review we summarize nearly 20 years of research on the applications of information theory (IT) to interpret coding and non-coding mutations that alter mRNA splicing in rare and common diseases. We compile and summarize the spectrum of published variants analyzed by IT, to provide a broad perspective of the distribution of deleterious natural and cryptic splice site variants detected, as well as those affecting splicing regulatory sequences. Results for natural splice site mutations can be interrogated dynamically with Splicing Mutation Calculator, a companion software program that computes changes in information content for any splice site substitution, linked to corresponding publications containing these mutations. The accuracy of IT-based analysis was assessed in the context of experimentally validated mutations. Because splice site information quantifies binding affinity, IT-based analyses can discern the differences between variants that account for the observed reduced (leaky) versus abolished mRNA splicing. We extend this principle by comparing predicted mutations in natural, cryptic, and regulatory splice sites with observed deleterious phenotypic and benign effects. Our analysis of 1727 variants revealed a number of general principles useful for ensuring portability of these analyses and accurate input and interpretation of mutations. We offer guidelines for optimal use of IT software for interpretation of mRNA splicing mutations.
review_content:
The paper by Caminsky et al. is a welcome and timely review of the complexities of pre-mRNA splicing, the relationship between splicing mutations, detection thereof by IT and/or laboratory, and new challenges posed by next generation sequencing.

It is a rather lengthy and somewhat intimidating review, and I can imagine that many readers, even interested ones, may not make it all the way to the end, certainly not in one session. On the other hand, the review paper is likely to reside on the desk of molecular laboratory directors and and other genetics professionals with an interest in the molecular aspects of genetics.

The review is well written, and the order to topics discussed is logical. Maybe the introduction to splicing is a little short, e.g. little space is dedicated to discussing the spliceosome. The review of the various splice 'sensing' software, and the technology underlying these was in depth.

The relationship between IT predicting splice mutations and laboratory studies to confirm the actual results of aberrant splicing was very well done, and the discussion of NMD and other causes of technical issues relating to demonstrating mutant mRNA resulting from splicing mutations was delightful.

The discussion about laboratory standards (also related to ACMG recommendations) regarding splicing was excellent.

Lastly, the discussion of the impact of splicing mutations and IT in the era of large datasets, including NGS was concise and accurate.

In summary, this review ought to be mandatory reading for all genetics professionals in molecular laboratories, incl. those involved in whole exome/genome sequencing.

The figures were well-selected, and the tables were helpful.

One minor remark: I would mention PLP1 as the gene associated with Pelizaeus-Merzbacher disease (p6, R, middle para).
paper_title_zh: 遗传病中mRNA剪接突变的解读：文献综述及信息论分析指南
paper_abstract_zh: 基因组变异的解释已成为后基因组测序时代的主要挑战之一。在这篇综述中，我们总结了近20年来信息理论（IT）在解释罕见和常见疾病中改变mRNA剪接的编码和非编码突变方面的应用研究。我们汇编并总结了通过信息理论分析的已发表变异谱，以提供关于检测到的有害自然和隐秘剪接位点变异分布的广泛视角，以及影响剪接调控序列的变异。自然剪接位点突变的结果可以通过Splicing Mutation Calculator这一配套软件程序动态查询，该程序计算任何剪接位点替换的信息内容变化，并与包含这些突变的相应出版物链接。信息理论分析的准确性在实验验证突变的背景下进行了评估。由于剪接位点信息量化了结合亲和力，基于信息理论的分析可以区分导致观察到的减少（渗漏）与完全废除mRNA剪接的变异之间的差异。我们通过比较自然、隐秘和调控剪接位点的预测突变与观察到的有害表型和良性效应，扩展了这一原则。我们对1727个变异的分析揭示了一些通用原则，有助于确保这些分析的便携性和突变输入与解释的准确性。我们提供了关于最优使用信息理论软件解释mRNA剪接突变的指导方针。
review_content_zh:
Caminsky等人撰写的论文是对前mRNA剪接复杂性的及时且受欢迎的综述，探讨了剪接突变之间的关系、通过信息技术和/或实验室检测这些突变的方法，以及新一代测序技术带来的新挑战。

这是一篇相当长且有些令人望而生畏的综述，我可以想象，即使是感兴趣的读者，也可能无法一次性完整阅读完毕。另一方面，这篇综述论文很可能会出现在分子实验室主任和其他对遗传学分子方面感兴趣的遗传学专业人士的案头。

综述撰写得很好，讨论主题的顺序逻辑清晰。或许对剪接的介绍略显简短，例如，对剪接体的讨论篇幅较小。对各种剪接“感知”软件及其背后技术的综述则非常深入。

关于信息技术预测剪接突变与实验室研究确认异常剪接实际结果之间的关系处理得非常好，对NMD（无义介导的mRNA降解）及其他与展示剪接突变导致的突变mRNA相关的技术问题的讨论令人愉悦。

关于剪接的实验室标准（也与ACMG建议相关）的讨论非常出色。

最后，对大数据时代（包括新一代测序）剪接突变和信息技术影响的讨论简明且准确。

总之，这篇综述应成为所有分子实验室遗传学专业人士，包括那些参与全外显子/全基因组测序的人士的必读材料。

图表选择得当，表格也很有帮助。

一个小建议：我会提到PLP1基因与佩利措伊斯-梅茨巴赫病相关（第6页，右栏，中间段落）。

The review of the various splice 'sensing' software, and the technology underlying these was in depth.

The relationship between IT predicting splice mutations and laboratory studies to confirm the actual results of aberrant splicing was very well done, and the discussion of NMD and other causes of technical issues relating to demonstrating mutant mRNA resulting from splicing mutations was delightful.
The discussion about laboratory standards (also related to ACMG recommendations) regarding splicing was excellent.
Lastly, the discussion of the impact of splicing mutations and IT in the era of large datasets, including NGS was concise and accurate.

paper_title: Technological innovation for workload allocation in nursing care management: an integrative review
paper_abstract:
Background 
     Technology reduces the nursing workload, improve the quality care processes, patient’s safety, and avoid staff burnout. Innovative technologies are disrupting healthcare systems by improving the efficiency of processes and management. There is a discussion on the benefits, challenges, and barriers of these technologies and considering human factors of nursing management. The aim was to analyze the influence of technologies on the distribution of workload for nursing care management. 
   
   
     Methods 
     An integrative literature review was performed. Four databases were searched: Scopus, Scielo, PUBMED, and CINALH following PRISMA guidelines. Articles published from January 2016 to December 2020, published in English, Spanish and Portuguese were included. Studies were excluded when they were not original research, did not met the quality criteria or they did not answer the research questions. Quality appraisal was performed using the Crowe Critical Appraisal Tool version 1.4 (CCAT). Two reviewers independently examined the title and abstract for eligibility according to the inclusion and exclusion criteria. 
   
   
     Results 
     2818 potentially relevant articles were found, but once the inclusion and exclusion criteria in the abstracts were analyzed, 177 remained for evaluation. After following the PRISMA Guidelines, 35 studies were included in the review. Three categories were identified: Nursing workload; Information technologies and technological means for management; Technology acceptance. 
   
   
     Conclusions 
     Technology has the potential to improve care management by estimating nurse workload in ICUs and non-critical units, but scientific evidence is more detailed in the former type of services. The literature provides insights about the factors that factors and the barriers that promote the technology acceptance and usability. We did not find studies comparing technologies and no scientific evidence proving improvements in care.
review_content:
The authors conducted an integrated review of the literature to analyze technology-based tools for their use and impact on nursing workload models, burnout predictors and outcomes as well as factors that influence technology acceptance by nursing professionals. PRSIMA guidelines were used to inform the methods for the literature review. The flowchart of the screening process was accurately and clearly presented. All selected papers were summarized in Table 1 and elaborated upon in the results section. The discussion that followed included a summary of key findings to address the study aims. The conclusions aligned well with the results and discussion sections.

While the overall structure of the paper is adequate, the paper could be improved significantly with a few revisions.
 1. The main issue is the need to clearly and consistently articulate the study aims and align these aims with the study title. In the abstract, the aims include an analysis of nursing workload models, predictors of nursing burnout and outcomes and the acceptance of new technologies for nursing care management. Each of these aims seem divergent and each has a large body of literature. Considering the title of the paper, I think something is missing in the explanation of the study aims. I have assumed that aim is in fact the one that I have noted in the first paragraph i.e. the use and impact of technological innovations or tools for nursing care management which includes those used for nursing workload models, the impact of technological innovations on predictors and outcomes of burnout and overall nursing acceptance of these technological tools. In effect, I am assuming that the authors are intending to report on the integration of all of these concepts – technology and nursing workload, burnout and user acceptance. Therefore, the research questions on page 3 need to be more explicit. For RQ1, a suggested revision would be, “ What methods are used to calculate nursing workload?”. The concept of nursing workload should also be defined i.e. are you referring to nursing workload measurement? RQ2 is unclear and seems to overlap with RQ1. RQ3 is stated clearly. Any changes made to improve clarity should be reflected in the abstract, methods and remaining sections of the paper.
 2. The search strategy was described but the inclusion and exclusion criteria for the selection of papers should be elaborated upon with sufficient detail that someone else could replicate the study. The authors stated “Articles related with technology that didn’t analyze the impact of nursing workload or didn’t present technologies were excluded.” This is helpful and lead me to conclude that articles needed to address the integration of technology on nursing workload, burnout and nursing acceptance. This needs to be stated more explicitly.
 3. The organization and content of Table 1 needs to be revised to reflect the study aims. Some papers only address one of the concepts of interest but not necessarily the integration of technology and nursing workload, burnout and acceptance. I think that this might be due to the content provided in the ‘outcomes’ column. Perhaps the content selected for this column could be revised to reflect this aim more clearly. Also, the order in which papers are presented does not seem to follow any rules (not listed in chronological or alphabetical order) nor listed by the concept of interest. For example, the column header for ‘Predictors of nursing burnout’ lists a paper by Hope et al. but the paper summary does not mention burnout. On the next page (p.7), the column header is ‘Nursing Workload Models’ but there is a paper by Dall’Ora on burnout. It would be useful to have clear subheadings the reflect the order of the concepts as presented in the aim statement. Also, it is not clear why some papers were selected as there is no mention of technology in the summaries. Perhaps more clarity in the aim statement, inclusion/exclusion criteria and revisions to the ‘outcomes’ column would help to justify the papers selected and reported in this table.
 4. The concept map is very useful and helps the reader to understand the results of the content analysis. I have two suggestions for your consideration.
     1. In the middle column, I would consider nursing workload models and information technologies to be the main elements of nursing care management. I think that burnout predictors and outcomes would better fall within the third column as they are not a type of management tool. Similarly, I think technology acceptance would better fit under the third column as well as it is not an element of nursing care management but instead is a factor related to technologies.
     2. Suggest adding a 4th column to list the authors for the papers where related evidence for the theme was found. This will help the reader with understanding the results and discussion sections as well.
 5. Other recommended edits – There are places that require further editing to improve the sentence structure but I have not listed them here (available if requested). The abstract requires the most work (primarily the background and methods sections) as there are duplicate phrases or unclear sentences. Also, human factors is mentioned in the background section but is not discussed anywhere in the paper.
Overall, I think this is a useful research report that adds to our understanding of the impact of technology on nursing workload. I think the proposed revisions will add to the uptake and use of this review.
paper_title_zh: 护理管理中工作量分配的技术创新：综合性回顾
paper_abstract_zh:
背景
技术可以减轻护理工作负担，提高护理质量流程，保障患者安全，并避免员工倦怠。创新技术通过提高流程和管理的效率，正在颠覆医疗保健系统。目前有关于这些技术的益处、挑战和障碍的讨论，并考虑护理管理中的人为因素。本研究旨在分析技术对护理管理工作负担分配的影响。

方法
进行了一项综合文献回顾。检索了四个数据库：Scopus、Scielo、PUBMED和CINALH，遵循PRISMA指南。纳入了2016年1月至2020年12月期间以英语、西班牙语和葡萄牙语发表的文章。排除了非原创研究、不符合质量标准或未回答研究问题的研究。使用Crowe关键评估工具1.4版（CCAT）进行质量评估。两名评审员根据纳入和排除标准独立检查标题和摘要的资格。

结果
共找到2818篇潜在相关文章，但在分析摘要中的纳入和排除标准后，有177篇留待评估。遵循PRISMA指南后，共有35项研究纳入回顾。确定了三个类别：护理工作负担；信息技术和管理技术手段；技术接受度。

结论
技术有潜力通过估算ICU和非重症单元的护士工作负担来改善护理管理，但科学证据在前一类服务中更为详细。文献提供了关于促进技术接受和使用因素及障碍的见解。我们未找到比较技术的相关研究，也没有科学证据证明护理质量的改善。
review_content_zh:
作者对文献进行了综合回顾，以分析基于技术的工具在护理工作量模型、职业倦怠预测因子和结果以及影响护理人员接受技术的因素方面的使用和影响。PRSIMA指南用于指导文献回顾的方法。筛选过程的流程图准确且清晰地呈现。所有选定的论文在表1中进行了总结，并在结果部分进行了详细阐述。随后的讨论包括了对关键发现的总结，以解决研究目标。结论与结果和讨论部分很好地一致。

尽管论文的整体结构是合理的，但通过一些修订可以显著提升论文质量。
1. 主要问题是需要清晰且一致地阐述研究目标，并将这些目标与论文标题对齐。在摘要中，研究目标包括分析护理工作量模型、职业倦怠的预测因子和结果以及护理管理中新技术的接受情况。每个目标似乎都有所偏离，且每个目标都有大量的文献支持。考虑到论文标题，我认为在解释研究目标时有所缺失。我假设研究目标实际上是我第一段中提到的，即技术革新或工具在护理管理中的使用和影响，包括用于护理工作量模型的工具、技术革新对职业倦怠预测因子和结果的影响以及护理人员对这些技术工具的整体接受情况。实际上，我假设作者意图报告所有这些概念的整合——技术、护理工作量、职业倦怠和用户接受。因此，第3页的研究问题需要更加明确。对于RQ1，建议的修订是：“计算护理工作量使用了哪些方法？”护理工作量的概念也应定义，即你是指护理工作量测量吗？RQ2不清楚，似乎与RQ1重叠。RQ3表述清晰。任何为提高清晰度所做的更改应在摘要、方法和论文其余部分中体现。
2. 搜索策略已描述，但选择论文的纳入和排除标准应详细阐述，以便他人能够复制研究。作者指出“与 technology 相关但未分析护理工作量影响或未呈现技术的文章被排除。”这很有帮助，并使我得出结论，文章需要解决技术对护理工作量、职业倦怠和护理接受的整合。这需要更明确地陈述。
3. 表1的组织和内容需要修订以反映研究目标。一些论文只涉及其中一个概念，但不一定涉及技术、护理工作量、职业倦怠和接受的整合。我认为这可能是由于“结果”列中提供的内容所致。或许可以修订该列的内容，以更清晰地反映这一目标。此外，论文的呈现顺序似乎没有遵循任何规则（既不是按时间顺序也不是按字母顺序排列），也没有按感兴趣的概念排列。例如，“职业倦怠预测因子”列标题列出了Hope等人的论文，但论文摘要中未提及倦怠。在下一页（第7页），“护理工作量模型”列标题下却有Dall’Ora关于倦怠的论文。如果有清晰的子标题反映目标陈述中呈现的概念顺序将很有用。此外，不清楚为什么选择了一些论文，因为摘要中未提及技术。或许更清晰地阐述目标、纳入/排除标准以及对“结果”列的修订，将有助于证明所选论文的合理性并在此表中报告。
4. 概念图非常有用，帮助读者理解内容分析的结果。我有两点建议供您考虑。
   1. 在中间列，我认为护理工作量模型和信息技术是护理管理的主要元素。我认为职业倦怠预测因子和结果更适合放在第三列，因为它们不是一种管理工具。同样，我认为技术接受也更适合放在第三列，因为它不是护理管理的元素，而是与技术相关的因素。
   2. 建议添加第四列，列出找到相关主题证据的论文作者。这将帮助读者理解结果和讨论部分。
5. 其他建议的编辑——有些地方需要进一步编辑以改进句子结构（如有需要可提供）。摘要需要最多的工作（主要是背景和方法部分），因为存在重复的短语或不清晰的句子。此外，背景部分提到了人因工程，但论文中未进行讨论。
总体而言，我认为这是一份有用的研究报告，增进了我们对技术对护理工作量影响的理解。我认为所提议的修订将有助于提升这篇综述的采纳和使用。

paper_title: The use of medicinal marijuana for treating Cerebral Palsy: a literature review
paper_abstract:
Background 
 Recent studies have established that Medicinal Marijuana (MM) is beneficial in the treatment of spasms, sleep, and pain in adult patients with varying medical diagnoses and symptoms. However, MM has rarely been used for the treatment of Cerebral Palsy (CP) complications in adults. The aim of this literature review was to explore MM interventions globally, with a focus on identifying the best practice with MM for the treatment of complications of CP. 
 
 
 Methods 
 A literature search was performed using keywords and synonyms related to MM treatment and CP complications. Inclusions and exclusions were scoped to scholarly peer reviewed academic literature published 2019 to 2021 located in the Deakin Library collection. A screening process confirmed criteria adherence and identified additional papers in referencing. The papers were appraised and evaluated to ensure selections do not have perceived or actual bias. 
 
 
 Results 
 From 409 publications, 27 papers were selected for review because they investigated the benefits of MM treatment for patients with sleep, pain, and spasm complications. There was no literature found on the use of MM for adults with CP. 
 
 
 Discussion 
 Recent research has demonstrated that with an informed understanding of MM treatment adult patients with varying medical diagnoses and symptoms can use MM to manage sleep disruption and improve relaxation. Therefore, there are potential benefits for the use of MM in treating spasticity, pain, sleep and improvement of quality of life, and social and emotional wellbeing in adult patients with CP. No funding was sort or provided for this review and the results are specific to adults with CP, so they are not to be generalized to other populations.
review_content:
As an information professional, I have limited my comments below to those relating to the methodology and citations of the paper.

Methods
While the title of this article says it is a literature review, throughout the text the terms used is systematic review (SR), and several practices (e.g., use of a PRISMA flow chart, PRISMA checklist) suggest the authors attempted some aspects of a SR. However, the methods as outlined here are not those of a systematic review and should not be written as such.

In brief, some of the issues are:

1. An extremely limited time frame of 2 years and the authors included only material available in their specific library collection. This is not how SRs are completed as they must locate ALL evidence on a specific topic.

2. Lack of use of any subject terms specific to individual databases, such as MESH or CINAHL search terms

3. Lack of any reproducible search strategy for any database (although really all databases search strategies should be provided). Listing only the keywords is not sufficient. A quick search in MEDLINE using more advanced search terms quickly found several papers that would have been relevant to this article.

4. The authors write “The first and second named authors of this paper both individually completed the entire search and screening process concluding with the same outcome.”. This is not how systematic reviews are completed. There is one search done, and then at least two authors need to conduct screening individually, and then come together at the end to resolve conflicts.

5. The inclusion or exclusion criteria listed are not appropriate in that they do not focus on the studies themselves. They are just focused on study type, but not what the study is about. Also what is listed in the text for inclusion (e.g., must have a keyword) is not what is talked about in Table 3.

6. The screening process was not conducted according to SR suggested processes. The authors indicate that they used the presence of a keyword in specific lines or parts of a paper to decide whether to include or not include. Again, this doesn’t align with their stated inclusion criteria and is not correct SR screening methodology.

7. The authors note that their study is unique in that is focused on an adult population. This is not strictly true, but the authors still could have included content or summaries now what the research on medical marijuana on children with cerebral palsy suggests

8. While I did not conduct an examination of every reference cited, there were several written in the text that are not accurate. For example, the authors write “Even though cannabis is the most commonly used illicit drug in the world today (Zhand & Milin, 2018), […]. However, that article does not actually report that finding. Zhang & Milin instead link out to a different study. I would also argue that both of these articles are outdated (2018 and 2015 respectively), especially in light of recent legislative changes to cannabis in places like the US, Canada, and Australia. The authors should look for more updated references for their content.

9. There are numerical errors in the PRISMA flow chart. I also note that there are grammatical and spelling errors throughout the text.

—
Ultimately, I think this article needs to be more clearly reclassified as a literature review. All instances of the word ‘systematic’ should be removed so as not to give casual readers a false sense of what they are looking at, and so as not to confuse indexing procedures. I would also urge the authors to both broaden their years (2-3 years is not even sufficient for a literature review) and where they are searching. The fact that they found no literature on the topic strongly suggests that they need to adjust their search parameters. I applaud the authors for attempting to use a more transparent and comprehensive process for their search but as it was conducted it is not sufficient or exhaustive enough for either a systematic review or a comprehensive literature review.
paper_title_zh: 药用大麻治疗脑瘫的文献综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景
近期研究表明，药用大麻（MM）在治疗成人患者的痉挛、睡眠和疼痛方面具有益处，这些患者具有不同的医疗诊断和症状。然而，MM很少用于治疗成人脑瘫（CP）并发症。本文献综述的目的是探讨全球范围内的MM干预措施，重点识别使用MM治疗CP并发症的最佳实践。

方法
通过使用与MM治疗和CP并发症相关的关键词和同义词进行文献检索。纳入和排除范围限定为2019年至2021年间发表在迪肯图书馆收藏的学术同行评审文献。通过筛选过程确认符合标准，并在参考文献中识别额外文献。对文献进行评估和评价，以确保所选文献没有感知或实际的偏见。

结果
从409篇出版物中，选取了27篇进行综述，因为它们研究了MM治疗对睡眠、疼痛和痉挛并发症患者的益处。未发现关于MM用于成人CP患者的文献。

讨论
近期研究已证明，在对MM治疗有深入了解的情况下，具有不同医疗诊断和症状的成人患者可以使用MM来管理睡眠障碍并改善放松。因此，MM在治疗成人CP患者的痉挛、疼痛、睡眠以及提高生活质量、社会和情感福祉方面具有潜在益处。本综述未寻求或获得资助，且结果特定于成人CP患者，因此不应推广到其他人群。
review_content_zh:
作为信息专业人士，我将以下评论限于与论文的方法论和引用相关的内容。

方法
尽管本文标题表明这是一篇文献综述，但全文使用的术语是系统综述（SR），并且一些做法（例如，使用PRISMA流程图、PRISMA清单）表明作者尝试了系统综述的某些方面。然而，这里概述的方法并不是系统综述的方法，不应如此撰写。

简而言之，一些问题包括：

1. 极其有限的时间范围仅为2年，且作者仅包括其特定图书馆收藏的材料。这不是系统综述的完成方式，因为系统综述必须定位特定主题的所有证据。

2. 未使用任何特定于个别数据库的主题术语，如MESH或CINAHL搜索术语。

3. 缺乏任何数据库的可复制搜索策略（尽管实际上应提供所有数据库的搜索策略）。仅列出关键词是不够的。在MEDLINE中使用更高级的搜索术语进行快速搜索，很快找到了几篇与本文相关的论文。

4. 作者写道：“本文的第一和第二作者均独立完成了整个搜索和筛选过程，得出了相同的结果。”这不是系统综述的完成方式。只需进行一次搜索，然后至少需要两位作者分别进行筛选，最后再一起解决冲突。

5. 列出的纳入或排除标准不适当，因为它们没有关注研究本身。它们只关注研究类型，而不关注研究内容。此外，文本中列出的纳入标准（例如，必须有关键词）与表3中讨论的内容不一致。

6. 筛选过程未按照系统综述建议的过程进行。作者表示，他们使用论文特定行或部分中关键词的存在来决定是否纳入。这再次与他们的纳入标准不符，且不是正确的系统综述筛选方法。

7. 作者指出，他们的研究独特之处在于关注成年人群。这并不完全正确，但作者仍然可以包括关于医用大麻对脑瘫儿童研究的现有内容或总结。

8. 虽然我没有检查每个引用的参考文献，但文本中有几处不准确。例如，作者写道：“尽管大麻是当今世界上最常使用的非法药物（Zhand & Milin, 2018），[…]”。然而，该文章实际上并未报告这一发现。Zhang & Milin而是链接到另一项研究。我还会认为这两篇文章都已过时（分别为2018年和2015年），尤其是在美国、加拿大和澳大利亚等地最近对大麻立法进行修改的情况下。作者应寻找更多更新的参考文献。

9. PRISMA流程图中有数字错误。我还注意到文本中存在语法和拼写错误。

——
最终，我认为这篇文章需要更清楚地重新归类为文献综述。所有“系统”一词的实例都应删除，以免给普通读者造成误解，并避免混淆索引程序。我还敦促作者扩大他们的年份范围（2-3年甚至不足以进行文献综述）和搜索范围。他们未找到该主题的文献强烈表明他们需要调整搜索参数。我赞赏作者尝试使用更透明和全面的搜索过程，但按其目前的执行情况，既不足以进行系统综述，也不足以进行全面的文献综述。

paper_title: Milestones achieved in response to drought stress through reverse genetic approaches
paper_abstract: Drought stress is the most important abiotic stress that constrains crop production and reduces yield drastically. The germplasm of most of the cultivated crops possesses numerous unknown drought stress tolerant genes. Moreover, there are many reports suggesting that the wild species of most of the modern cultivars have abiotic stress tolerant genes. Due to climate change and population booms, food security has become a global issue. To develop drought tolerant crop varieties knowledge of various genes involved in drought stress is required. Different reverse genetic approaches such as virus-induced gene silencing (VIGS), clustered regularly interspace short palindromic repeat (CRISPR), targeting induced local lesions in genomes (TILLING) and expressed sequence tags (ESTs) have been used extensively to study the functionality of different genes involved in response to drought stress. In this review, we described the contributions of different techniques of functional genomics in the study of drought tolerant genes.
